title: Associate Creative Director
description:
**About Remedy Edge Spain:**



Welcome to Remedy Edge Spain. We activate potential, amplify with creativity, and accelerate outcomes. Remedy Edge brings strategic thinking and bold communications to healthcare — cutting through the noise to move people and change results. We don't do comfortable. We do cutting edge. Join us and GET THE EDGE.


**About the role:**



We are looking for an experienced **Associate Creative Director (ACD)** to join our creative international team. In this role, you will lead the development of integrated healthcare campaigns, partnering with cross\-functional teams to deliver innovative, high\-quality creative solutions from concept through execution.


**Key responsibilities:**


* Develop strong creative concepts and integrated campaigns across multiple channels and formats.
* Lead the creative development of projects from initial concept through final execution, ensuring excellence in both visual and verbal communication.
* Transform complex healthcare and scientific information into clear, engaging, and impactful creative solutions.
* Partner with Creative Directors to define and maintain the creative vision and quality of the work.
* Lead, inspire and mentor creative teams, including art directors, copywriters and designers.
* Provide clear, constructive creative feedback that elevates the overall quality of the work.
* Collaborate closely with Strategy, Account, Medical and Production teams.
* Present and defend creative ideas confidently to internal stakeholders and clients.
* Manage multiple projects, priorities and deadlines without compromising creative standards.
* Take ownership of projects, proactively identify challenges and help drive work forward efficiently.


**About you:**



A **creative leader first and foremost**: someone with exceptional conceptual thinking, strong creative instincts, and the ability to recognize, develop and elevate great ideas.



Whether your roots are in **Art, Copy, or both**, you should be comfortable overseeing and guiding all aspects of the creative process, inspiring multidisciplinary teams and taking ownership of projects from concept to execution.



We're looking for someone with the ambition to push the work forward, the creative craft to make it exceptional, and the leadership skills to bring teams along the journey and deliver outstanding results.


**Skills \& Experience**


* **7\-8 years of creative experience in healthcare communications.**
* Strong background in either **Art Direction, Copywriting, or both**, with a portfolio demonstrating outstanding conceptual thinking and creative craft.
* Experience developing integrated campaigns across a variety of channels and touchpoints.
* Strong experience working with pharmaceutical, biotech, medical or health\-related brands.
* **Native\-level English is essential.**
* **Proven ability to lead creative teams and projects.**
* Excellent conceptual thinking, communication and presentation skills.
* Strong expertise in visual storytelling, narrative development, creative strategy and content creation.
* Ability to understand complex scientific information and translate it into compelling creative communications.
* Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Good understanding of healthcare regulatory and compliance requirements.
* Collaborative, proactive and solution\-oriented mindset.

  


*Omnicom Health is committed to hiring and developing exceptional talent. We agree that talent is uniquely distributed, and we're focused on developing inclusive teams that can bring the best solutions to everything we do. We strongly believe that celebrating what makes us different makes us better together. Join us—we look forward to getting to know you. We will process your personal data in accordance with our* *Recruitment Privacy Notice**.*

**About ElevenLabs**
--------------------


ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.


We launched in January 2023 with the first human\-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses \- from fast\-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B \- multiples of 11, always.  

  

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

* ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
* ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70\+ languages.
* ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.


Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team \- builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex\-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

**How we work**
---------------

* **High\-velocity:** Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
* **Impact not job titles:** We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
* **AI first:** We use AI to move faster with higher\-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
* **Excellence everywhere:** Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
* **Global team:** We prioritize your talent, not your location.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* **Innovative culture:** You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
* **Growth paths:** Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact \- beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
* **Learning \& development**: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
* **Social travel**: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
* **Annual company offsite:** Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location \- past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
* **Co\-working**: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co\-working stipend.

**About the role**
------------------


ElevenReader is our fast\-growing consumer audio app, and creative is one of our biggest growth levers. We’re looking for a Creative Producer to deliver creative marketing campaigns, experiments, and to build the creative engine that powers performance marketing across every major acquisition channel.


This role sits at the intersection of creative design, AI, and performance marketing. You’ll be our lead creative strategist, producing high\-quality creative concepts, building scalable creative workflows using AI tools, developing a testing roadmap, launching experiments across Meta, Google, YouTube, Reddit, and emerging platforms with our Performance Marketing team. You’ll partner closely with Marketing, Design, Growth Analytics, and partner agencies to continuously discover which creative drives acquisition at scale, and feeding these insights back into future creative roadmaps.


This is one part strategist and one part creative producer for someone who loves combining exceptional creative taste with rigorous experimentation and marketing results.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Designing creative systems, concepts and templates, mood boards, briefs, and AI workflows that power high\-velocity ad production
* Create visually\-stunning, brand aligned, static ad campaigns end\-to\-end in Figma and ElevenLabs
* Directing agency partners with clear and compelling creative briefs, UGC scripts, storyboards, scripts, and feedback on creative concepts, ensuring the timely and aligned delivery of assets
* Creating and launching creative testing programs across Meta, Google, YouTube, Reddit, and emerging acquisition channels with Performance Marketing and agencies
* Developing a structured creative roadmap with recurring testing sprints and clear learning agendas
* Designing analytical frameworks to identify winning creative patterns using performance data and creative analysis
* Researching and mapping creative trends across competitors, consumer categories, and best\-in\-class mobile apps to generate new hypotheses for testing
* Partnering closely with Performance Marketing and agencies to rapidly iterate and scale winning campaigns
* Continuously improving our creative production pipeline through AI automation, reusable templates, and scalable workflows
* Analyzing which creative is resonating most with our audience through ad platforms and tools like Motion
* Raising the creative quality bar while ensuring every asset is designed to maximize measurable business outcomes

**Requirements**
----------------

* 5\+ years of experience in performance creative, art direction, growth marketing, creative strategy, or design at a high\-growth consumer product or technology company
* Deep expertise with generative AI for image and video creation, with a strong understanding of how to build repeatable creative workflows with tools like ElevenCreative
* Experience creating high\-performing ads across Meta, Google, TikTok, YouTube, or other major paid acquisition platforms
* Experience with creative performance analytics tools like Motion
* Strong understanding of creative experimentation, performance marketing, A/B testing, and data\-driven optimization
* Expert proficiency in Figma, CapCut, Adobe Suite and modern AI creative tools and generative media platforms
* Exceptional visual taste with the ability to balance speed, quality, and brand consistency
* Deep understanding of user psychology and what drives successful consumer marketing
* Highly analytical and structured thinker who enjoys building experimentation frameworks and extracting insights from data
* Self\-directed builder who thrives in fast\-moving environments and can independently take ideas from concept to launch

**Bonus**
---------

* Power user of ElevenCreative, including Flows and Templates
* Background in building AI\-powered creative production systems or internal creative tooling
* Passion for consumer products, AI, storytelling, and building globally loved brands.

**Location**
------------


This role is remote with a preference for timezones in US \- East and Europe

title: Senior UA Creative Strategist - Mobile Games
description:
The Role
We are looking for a sharp, highly curious **UA Creative Strategist** to help us decide what advertising creatives we should make and why.


This is not primarily a video editing or art production role. Your job is to stay ahead of the mobile games advertising market, spot emerging creative opportunities, understand what is working and what is becoming stale, and turn those insights into strong concepts and clear production briefs.


You will sit at the intersection of **creative, user acquisition, games and data**.


We want someone who watches the market closely, studies competitors, understands internet culture and short\-form video, experiments aggressively, and is constantly asking:

**“What should we test next?”**


You will work with our UA team and with internal and external creators, editors, artists, AI tools and production partners to turn those ideas into ads.  

What You’ll Do


Own Our UA Creative Direction* Develop a continuous pipeline of new video ad concepts, hooks, formats and creative hypotheses.
* Decide which ideas are worth producing and testing based on market trends, player psychology, competitor activity and our own performance data.
* Build a weekly creative roadmap rather than waiting for production requests.
* Push beyond obvious variations of existing ads and actively search for new creative angles.


Hunt for Trends and Creative Opportunities* Constantly research mobile game advertising across TikTok, Meta, YouTube, AppLovin, Google, Unity, Mintegral and emerging channels.
* Study successful ads from both direct competitors and completely different genres and industries.
* Deconstruct winning creatives by looking at the hook, pacing, storytelling structure, gameplay, visual treatment, sound, creator style, emotional trigger and CTA.
* Track broader TikTok, Reels, Shorts, creator and internet culture trends and identify which ones can be translated into performance advertising.
* Maintain a living library of interesting ads, formats, hooks and creative patterns.


Turn Insights Into Things We Can Actually Make* Write clear, production\-ready creative briefs, scripts, storyboards and references.
* Explain not just **what** to make, but the hypothesis behind the idea and what we are trying to learn.
* Give strong creative direction and feedback to video editors, motion designers, game capture teams, UGC creators, AI creators and external agencies.
* Help producers and artists understand the intent of a concept without prescribing every frame.
* Review work in progress and push execution until the original creative idea comes through clearly.


Build a Modern Creative Testing Machine* Work closely with UA managers to understand CTR, IPM, CVR, CPI, ROAS, retention and other creative performance signals.
* Identify why a creative worked rather than simply declaring it a winner.
* Turn winning ads into structured families of new hypotheses rather than endless minor variations.
* Kill weak directions quickly and double down aggressively when a concept shows promise.
* Watch for creative fatigue and ensure the pipeline always has genuinely fresh ideas entering testing.


Use AI Aggressively, but Intelligently* Stay current with AI image, video, voice, scripting and editing tools.
* Use AI to prototype ideas, explore concepts and generate variations rapidly.
* Understand where AI production is good enough, where human production is better, and when the two should be combined.
* Experiment with AI\-native formats and workflows rather than treating AI only as a cheaper production tool.
* Help us continuously evaluate new creative tools, platforms and production partners.


Direct External Production* Identify and brief specialist agencies, UGC creators, freelance editors, AI studios and playable ad providers when appropriate.
* Evaluate external creative partners based on performance, speed and creative thinking, not simply production polish.
* Give vendors decisive feedback and keep projects moving.
* Help us build a flexible production network capable of executing very different kinds of ideas quickly.


Creative Formats You Should Be Comfortable With
You do not need to personally produce all of these, but you should understand how and when to use them:

* Gameplay\-led video
* TikTok, Reels and Shorts\-native ads
* UGC and creator\-style ads
* Gameplay reviews and reaction formats
* Narrative and story\-driven ads
* Failure, challenge and transformation formats
* Humor, memes and culturally relevant concepts
* AI\-generated and AI\-assisted video
* 2D and 3D animation
* Live action
* Playable and interactive ads
* Static and lightweight motion concepts
* We care much more about **choosing the right format for the idea** than having a preferred production style


What This Role Is Not
This is **not** a traditional brand Creative Director role.


It is **not** primarily a video editor position.


It is also **not** a UA media buying position.


We are hiring the person who sits between those disciplines. This person is responsible for understanding the market, generating the hypotheses, choosing the creative directions, briefing the people who make them, and learning from the results.


What Success Looks Like
You have created a repeatable rhythm where we always know:

**What are we testing? Why are we testing it? What did we learn? What should we make next?**


Over time, we should see a larger and more diverse pipeline of strong creative ideas, faster learning cycles, more creative winners, less dependence on a small number of exhausted concepts, and better UA performance as a result.


Above all, we want someone who develops a reputation inside the company for constantly bringing us ideas we would not have thought of ourselves.

 **Requirements**  

  

What We’re Looking For* Around **3 to 5 years of relevant experience** in mobile games, mobile apps, performance creative, creative strategy, advertising or a closely related field.
* Strong understanding of mobile game UA creative and performance advertising.
* Exceptional instinct for short\-form video, including hooks, pacing, storytelling, visual communication and attention.
* Strong analytical thinking and comfort interpreting creative performance data.
* Ability to look at an advertisement and explain *why* it works.
* Ability to turn insights into clear creative hypotheses and actionable briefs.
* Deep curiosity about games, advertising, internet culture, creators and emerging formats.
* Strong familiarity with current generative AI creative tools and workflows.
* Excellent communication and creative feedback skills.
* High initiative. You should naturally research, experiment and bring us ideas without waiting to be asked.
* Comfortable challenging existing assumptions when you believe there is a better direction.


Nice to Have* Previous mobile game Creative Strategist or Creative Producer experience.
* Experience with casual or hybrid\-casual games.
* Experience working directly with Meta, TikTok, Google or major mobile ad networks.
* Familiarity with creative intelligence tools such as Sensor Tower, AppMagic, Apptica, Meta Ads Library or TikTok’s creative tools.
* Experience briefing and managing UGC creators or external creative agencies.
* Knowledge of playable ads.
* Basic hands\-on ability with CapCut, Premiere, After Effects or similar tools.
* Ability to quickly make a rough edit, AI prototype or visual mockup to communicate an idea.
* Game capture, Unity or other game development familiarity.

  

**Benefits**  

* Market competitive, tax\-free USD salaries
* Paid Time Off
* Performance Bonus
* Annual Performance Reviews

We’re a dynamic, remote\-first global team, fostering award\-winning creativity, a no\-red\-tape approach, and great vibes!


We are looking for a **Creative Producer** to help shape and oversee the creative direction of original YouTube shows for a globally recognized beauty brand.


In this role, you will help define the creative vision, develop distinctive and engaging formats, and ensure that each show aligns with the overall channel strategy, brand positioning, and audience ambition.


You will work closely with an external production agency responsible for execution, providing creative guidance throughout the process, challenging and refining ideas, reviewing key creative decisions, and ensuring the final output stays true to the agreed vision and strategy.


A strong understanding of YouTube, internet culture, creators, and emerging subcultures is essential. Experience in beauty, fashion, or lifestyle is an advantage, but not a requirement.

 **Requirements**  

* Strong experience developing and leading large\-scale entertainment shows for YouTube, with a proven track record of delivering high\-profile, audience\-driven formats.
* Deep understanding of YouTube formats, audience behavior, storytelling, and creator culture.
* Strong creative and editorial judgment, with the ability to critically assess, challenge, and improve concepts and formats.
* Experience overseeing external production agencies, studios, or other creative partners.
* Hands\-on experience reviewing creative work across concept development, casting, scripts, visual direction, and edits.
* Strong understanding of internet culture, emerging trends, online communities, creators, and subcultures.
* Ability to balance creative ambition with brand strategy, guidelines, and wider business objectives.
* Experience developing content for international or multi\-market audiences is highly desirable.
* Experience within beauty, fashion, lifestyle, or adjacent consumer categories is a plus, but not essential.

  

**Benefits**  

* **Flexible Engagement Structure:** This opportunity is offered under an independent service\-provider agreement, giving you the freedom to shape how you deliver your expertise. You define your own working methods, organise your schedule independently, and contribute your skills to clearly scoped projects. Compensation is agreed individually and reflects your experience, capabilities, and the value you bring to each engagement.
* **Location Freedom:** You can deliver services from any suitable location that supports high\-quality outcomes, whether that’s your home office, a co\-working space, or wherever you feel most productive and inspired. What matters most is the impact you create and the reliability of your delivery.
* **Global Network and Inspiring Projects:** You’ll collaborate with a diverse international network of professionals across 85\+ countries, contributing to projects that reach vast audiences and help shape the future of digital content. This is an opportunity to work alongside talented specialists, exchange ideas, and be part of meaningful initiatives with real global reach.
* **Smooth Collaboration and Project Support:** To enable efficient service delivery, we provide modern collaboration platforms, clear project coordination, and streamlined processes. This helps you focus your energy where it matters most, producing high\-impact work and bringing creative solutions to life.
* **Make a Global Impact:** Your expertise will contribute to initiatives that influence audiences worldwide. Join projects that push creative boundaries and help build the next generation of digital experiences.

description:
**About us**
============


Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer\-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about\-us/

**About the role**
==================


About the role. We are seeking a talented and innovative **Ad Creative Producer** to join the creative team of one of Ruby Labs’ fastest\-growing consumer products, advertising at high volume on **Meta, Snapchat, and Google**. This full\-time role is central to driving our advertising creative process. You will be responsible for producing **high\-quality ad creatives** — both from briefs provided by the Lead Creative Producer and from your own ideas — managing production timelines, and collaborating with various teams to ensure that our creatives not only captivate but also convert. As a key player in the ad production lifecycle, you will work directly under the Lead Creative Producerand maintain close coordination with User Acquisition Managers to refine and optimize our creatives based on performance data.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Creative Production \& Development**
--------------------------------------

* Produce high\-quality ad creatives end\-to\-end — statics, video, and AI\-generated formats — executing briefs from the Lead Creative Producer to a high standard.
* Contribute your own ideas: lead the ideation and conceptualization of new ad creatives that resonate with diverse audiences, with an emphasis on strategies that enhance customer acquisition.
* Stay ahead of industry trends to integrate innovative elements into creative production, ensuring our creatives are captivating and effectively convert viewers into customers.
* Collaborate with the design team to transform ideas into compelling ad creatives that align with brand values and effectively meet campaign goals.

**Project Management**
----------------------

* Oversee your production pipeline to ensure all creatives are delivered on time and meet the creative vision, with particular attention to optimizing the impact on customer acquisition.
* Coordinate with designers, the Lead Creative Producer, and User Acquisition Managers to ensure smooth workflow and high\-quality outputs.

**Performance Analysis**
------------------------

* Work closely with User Acquisition Managers to analyze the performance of ad creatives across Meta, Snapchat, and Google, identifying those that best contribute to customer acquisition.
* Provide regular reports to the Lead Creative Producer on the impact and effectiveness of ad creatives, highlighting their role in driving customer acquisition.

**Market and Competitor Analysis**
----------------------------------

* Conduct thorough competitor research to understand market benchmarks and creative standards, particularly those successful in acquiring customers.
* Identify emerging trends in ad creative production and propose innovative solutions to leverage these trends for better market positioning and customer engagement.

**Collaborative Efforts**
-------------------------

* Liaise between creative teams and User Acquisition Managers to ensure that ad creatives are optimized for performance based on real\-time data.
* Participate in brainstorming sessions that encourage a culture of creativity and continuous improvement, aimed at boosting customer acquisition and retention.

**Qualifications**
==================

**Experience**
--------------

* Proven **hands\-on experience producing ad creatives for Meta, Snapchat, and Google**.
* Proven track record of managing creative projects from inception to completion.
* **Strong portfolio** demonstrating expertise in producing high\-performing digital ads.

**Technical Skills**
--------------------

* **Working knowledge of Meta and Google advertising policies** — you know what content gets flagged (misleading design elements, restricted categories, prohibited claims) and produce creatives that stay compliant by default.
* **Expertise in digital advertising platforms** and understanding of **performance metrics.**
* Proficiency in project management tools and collaboration software.
* Ability to perform **data analysis** to draw actionable insights from campaign results.
* Up\-to\-date knowledge of **AI tools** used in creative production, with the ability to leverage them effectively to generate innovative ad creatives.

**Personal Qualities**
----------------------

* Strong creative vision with the ability to think out of the box and challenge the status quo.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to manage diverse teams and stakeholders.
* Detail\-oriented with strong organizational skills to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

**Adaptability**
----------------

* Ability to quickly adapt to new technologies and changes in the digital marketing landscape.
* Willingness to experiment with new creative ideas and approaches to advertising.

**Location**
============


Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.

**Benefits**
============


Discover the perks of being part of our vibrant team! We offer:

* **Remote Work Environment:** Embrace the freedom to work from anywhere, anytime, promoting a healthy work\-life balance.
* **Unlimited PTO:** Enjoy unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize your well\-being, without counting days.
* **Paid National Holidays:** Celebrate and relax on national holidays with paid time off to unwind and recharge.
* **Company\-provided MacBook:** Experience seamless productivity with top\-notch Apple MacBooks provided to all employees who need them.
* **Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement:** Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. Benefit from tax advantages, networking opportunities, reduced employment obligations, and the freedom to work from anywhere. Read more about it here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1nkrN76JlZkbKj9WSOhlT1\_mni\_CZeDkHdwfIjPXVwvk/preview?tab\=t.0\#heading\=h.ndsdl4wapxtt


Be part of our fast\-growing team and seize this excellent opportunity for personal and professional growth!

**Interview Process**
=====================


After submitting your application, we conduct a thorough review which typically takes 3 to 5 days, but may occasionally take longer due to the volume of applications received. If we see a potential fit, we proceed with the following steps:

* Recruiter Screening (40 minutes)
* Take\-Home Assignment
* Technical Interview (60 minutes)
* Final Interview (45 minutes)

**Life at Ruby Labs**
=====================


At Ruby Labs, we move fast, aim high, and expect the same from our team. We’re not here to play small—we’re here to build, grow, and win. That means we look for people who are ambitious, driven, and ready to give their best every single day.


This is a place for individuals who thrive under pressure, embrace challenges, and see opportunity in every obstacle. If you’re hungry to achieve, motivated by impact, and want to grow at the speed of your own ambition, Ruby Labs offers the platform to make it happen.


Here, effort is matched with reward. We recognize those who go all in and deliver results, and we create space for people who want more—more responsibility, more growth, and more success.

description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission\-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI\-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well\-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.  



  

**The Role**

Are you a strategist who makes, or a maker who thinks strategically? Can you turn an ambiguous enterprise challenge into a shared point of view, a testable experience, and evidence for the next decision? If you believe the best AI\-enabled services are designed with clients and their users \- not simply delivered to them \- you will feel at home in the **AI Innovation Lab** with **Kyndryl Vital** .


**Kyndryl Vital** is a global network of designers, engineers, researchers, writers, and strategists helping organizations make sense of complexity and create experiences that are useful, responsible, and buildable. We combine behavioral insight, business understanding, and deep technology expertise so ideas can move beyond aspiration into delivery, adoption, and measurable value.


Based in Madrid and serving clients across Europe, the **AI Innovation Lab** is part studio, part workshop, and part proving ground. Client sponsors, frontline users, Kyndryl designers, and technologists work together in short, focused cycles: framing a challenge, making possibilities tangible, testing prototypes, and deciding what to stop, iterate, pilot, or scale. We favor demos over decks and evidence over opinion.


**The opportunity**

We are hiring two to three Creative Technologists who can bridge human\-centered design, business strategy, and emerging technology. This is a shared role family, not a search for identical candidates. Everyone should be comfortable moving from ambiguity to a testable artifact, but each person will bring greater depth in one of two complementary profiles.


* **Strategic / Conceptual profile:** stronger in problem framing, systems thinking, co\-design, service and conversational experience, synthesis, and helping senior stakeholders make decisions through tangible artifacts.
* **Practical / Technical profile:** stronger in rapid functional prototyping, low\-code and AI platforms, APIs, data integration, agentic patterns, and turning workshop outputs into working demonstrations.

We do not expect every candidate to be equally deep in both profiles. We do expect curiosity across the full cycle, generosity in multidisciplinary teams, and the ability to make their thinking visible. Together, the Lab team should be able to frame, facilitate, build, test, and hand off.


**What you will do**

* **Shape the right challenge.** Work with sponsors and users to locate the real decision inside a broad brief, understand the current system, and define the behavior, outcome, or learning the engagement should create.
* **Design and facilitate co\-creation.** Create participatory sessions for executives, subject\-matter experts, frontline users, designers, and engineers. Enable people with different levels of confidence and authority to contribute meaningfully.
* **Make ideas tangible early.** Use sketches, scenarios, conversation flows, simulations, low\-code tools, or working software to give participants something concrete to react to and improve.
* **Prototype with people.** Build during and between sessions, incorporating feedback while the problem and trade\-offs are still visible. Choose fidelity deliberately: each artifact should answer a question or unlock a decision.
* **Design human\-agent collaboration.** Create clear patterns for autonomy, approvals, escalation, uncertainty, exceptions, rollback, and human override so users remain informed and in control.
* **Test value and feasibility together.** Explore desirability, business value, data readiness, integration, security, operational impact, cost, and maintainability before recommending a pilot.
* **Turn learning into direction.** Synthesize observations and prototype evidence into opportunity areas, principles, requirements, success measures, and a credible stop / iterate / pilot / scale recommendation.
* **Create a clean path to delivery.** Partner with FDEs, architects, security, data, Consult Partners and delivery leads so validated concepts have an owner, documented assumptions, and an appropriate route forward.
* **Help build the Lab as a capability.** Contribute reusable methods, starter environments, component libraries, evaluation sets, showcases, and decision rituals so every engagement starts faster and leaves knowledge behind.

  

**Who You Are**

**Required Technical and Professional Expertise. What you bring.**

* **Human\-centered and systemic thinking.** You apply human\-centered design and design thinking techniques at a strategic level, connecting user behavior and lived experience with business goals, operating models, incentives, technology constraints, and wider organizational consequences.
* **Strategy through making.** You use artifacts and experiments to reduce ambiguity, surface assumptions, and improve decisions rather than treating prototyping as a final presentation step.
* **Participatory facilitation.** You can prepare and lead executive workshops and hands\-on making sessions, read the room, rebalance participation, and adapt the plan without losing the intended outcome.
* **Cross\-disciplinary fluency.** You collaborate credibly with Consult, design, business, FDEs, data, architecture, security, and client teams without pretending to be the deepest expert in every discipline.
* **AI experience literacy.** You understand how generative and agentic systems behave, where they fail, and how to design for uncertainty, trust, feedback, and appropriate human control.
* **Responsible experimentation.** You make data use, model limitations, permissions, safety, auditability, and ethical trade\-offs explicit, proportionate to the risk and maturity of the prototype.
* **Evidence\-led storytelling.** You communicate a compelling possibility while distinguishing what has been observed, assumed, simulated, validated, and still needs to be learned.
* **Enterprise pragmatism.** You move quickly while respecting governance, security, accessibility, and the realities of complex organizations.
* **Service Design.**

**Preferred Professional and Technical Expertise** . **Depth in at least one profile:**

**1\) Creative Technologist – AI Strategy**

Advanced problem framing, systems thinking, design research, or experience strategy.


Design of co\-creation formats that move groups from divergent perspectives to shared choices.


Synthesis of qualitative evidence into insights, hypotheses, principles, opportunity areas, and roadmaps.


Conversational and agentic experience design, including roles, boundaries, handoffs, and exception journeys.


Executive communication and the ability to challenge solution\-first thinking constructively.


Enough prototyping fluency to make ideas testable using tools such as Figma, Miro, or low\-code platforms.


**2\) Creative Technologist – AI Experience Prototype**

Rapid creation of functional prototypes using low\-code platforms, AI\-assisted development, or code.


Hands\-on experience with generative AI, prompt and context design, tool use, structured outputs, and agentic workflows.


Working knowledge of RAG, APIs, data integration, identity, permissions, and enterprise cloud patterns.


Ability to create credible web or conversational interfaces and represent loading, uncertainty, error, and edge cases.


Practical evaluation of response quality, groundedness, safety, latency, reliability, and cost.


Clear documentation of what is functional, simulated, reusable, and required for a production implementation.


**Tools and technologies**

You do not need experience with every product below. We are interested in transferable capability and evidence of learning quickly. The Lab's working environment is expected to include:


* **Co\-creation and experience design:** Figma, FigJam, Miro, or equivalent tools.
* **Low\-code and automation:** Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Apps, Power Automate, or equivalent platforms.
* **AI prototyping:** Microsoft Foundry / Azure AI, model playgrounds, prompt and agent tooling, and evaluation services.
* **Knowledge and integration:** SharePoint, Dataverse, Azure AI Search or other RAG components, APIs, and connectors.
* **Development:** VS Code, GitHub, API clients, and enough front\-end or scripting capability to produce a credible prototype when low\-code is not sufficient.
* **Quality and operations:** test sets, observability, content safety, accessibility checks, and basic cost monitoring.

**What success looks like**

Lab engagements end with a clearer decision, not just more ideas.


A first testable artifact is produced in days or weeks, with fidelity matched to the question.


Clients and users can see how their input changed the concept and understand the trade\-offs.


Evidence, assumptions, risks, data needs, and unresolved questions are documented honestly.


Validated concepts transition with a sponsor, success measures, and a realistic technical and operational path.


Methods, components, and learning are reused across engagements rather than being lost after the demo.


**Experience and education**

A strong portfolio showing how you moved from ambiguity to a tangible outcome and what was learned. We are particularly interested in your decisions, contribution, trade\-offs, and evidence \- not only polished screens.


Relevant professional experience in creative technology, service or product design, innovation, engineering, or consulting. At this level, this is typically five or more years, but demonstrated scope and impact matter more than tenure alone.


Experience working with enterprise clients or similarly complex stakeholder, governance, and delivery environments.


Professional fluency in English \& Spanish. Another European language is an advantage.


Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience and demonstrable portfolio. Advanced study or continued education in design, HCI, technology, business, or AI is welcome but not required.


**Location and working model:** Madrid, Spain \- hybrid, with regular in\-person work in the AI Innovation Lab and at client locations.


**Country/Region:** Spain / European Principal Markets.  



  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.  



  

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  

  

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  

  

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  

  

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

title: Head of Design, AI-First
description:
**Own the design function for a $1Billion\+ brand. Transform how we build with AI.** 




  





**Total Annual Package:** 
 Up to USD $132,000 \+ comprehensive benefits (Base salary \+ monthly performance bonus of up to 10% of base)
 



**Location:** 
 Remote (Global)
 



**Growth path** 
 from here is VP Design → Chief Design Officer. What takes 4\-5 years elsewhere happens in 1\-2 here.
 



  





**We've been AI\-first since December 2023:** 
 Every design proposal ships with an AI review link, and Figma AI runs in our live production pipeline, shipping real work. You'd start where most teams are still trying to get.
 



  





*This position is remote, with the option to work from our Dubai office (with 0% income tax), if preferred (relocation and visa sponsorship support available).* 




  





**Role Overview** 




 Puffy, a market\-leading, nine\-figure D2C brand and Top 5 US mattress brand with over $1 billion in sales, is hiring a Head of Design to own end\-to\-end web design with full authority over the design system, the AI\-first workflow, the conversion roadmap, accessibility standards, and a team of three designers, reporting directly to the CEO.
 



 This role exists to turn design from a sequential production queue into a fast, AI\-native operation, building the workflow, prompt infrastructure, and system governance that let high\-quality work ship at volume without the CEO adjudicating timelines.
 



  





**The Career Accelerator** 




 This is not a role where you review other people's mockups and forward them to engineering. The scope is scarce: very few Heads of Design get simultaneous authority over the design system, the AI toolchain, the conversion roadmap, accessibility standards, and a team of 3, with a direct line to the CEO and no layers in between.
 



**Your first 12 months:** 
 rebuild the design workflow from sequential to agile, with kickoff huddles and a handoff\-time reduced by 40%. Build the prompt library and review workflow covering product copy, FAQs, size/fit guidance, policy explainers, and localized variants. Design the UI patterns for conversational search, guided finders, and PDP Q\&A alongside engineering. Own the recommendation surfaces — placements, card density, "why this" microcopy — and validate them with staged rollouts. Evolve the design system so tokens and components absorb AI\-generated variants without brand drift or PageSpeed cost. Bake WCAG 2\.2 into the system and pair AI\-assisted audits with manual review. Set the split with Growth between bandit allocation on evergreen surfaces and classic A/B on high\-stakes causal changes. Shape the future of design at Puffy, where the site is the entire storefront and every conversion point runs through your team.
 



  





**What Is In It For You** 




 This isn't just another design management role. This is your chance to become a true industry architect.
 



  





**1\. Own the Design Function and the Toolchain It Runs On** 




 You set the standard, build the workflow, and own what ships.
 


* You design the operating model for the whole function: how work enters the queue, how AI\-generated variants get validated, where human QA sits, and how a spec reaches Dev Mode without losing intent. You own IA, wireframes, high\-fidelity comps, prototypes, and motion specs across Home, PLP, PDP, Cart/Checkout, editorial, and paid\-media landing pages. You decide what the design system tolerates and what it rejects.
* You hold the line on WCAG 2\.2, PageSpeed, and brand consistency while the volume goes up, and you carry the conversion roadmap in your own numbers. You report to the CEO directly, present quarterly roadmap reviews, and translate design decisions and experiment results into the narrative the business acts on.



  





**2\. Join a High\-Performance Organization and Partner with the 1%:** 




 🏆 Puffy: Top 5 Mattress Brand in US with Over $1 Billion USD in Sales
 



 🌍 Great Place to Work Certified
 



 💡 Work directly with Forbes Council Member CEO. Your vision is the company's vision.
 



 Gain firsthand exposure to strategic decisions and high\-velocity execution that drives a global brand
 



  





**3\. Embrace Radical Flexibility** 




 Work from anywhere in the world with meaningful time zone overlap. Structure your environment around your best thinking, whether that's a home office, a co\-working space, (OR) our Dubai headquarters (with full relocation, visa support, and 0% income tax if you choose). Your output is your credential, not your location.
 



  





**4\. Become the Design Leader Other Brands Come Looking For** 




 In most companies, design leaders inherit a workflow somebody else built and spend their tenure defending its timelines in meetings. Here you build it. When the CEO decides what ships next quarter, your roadmap is the input to that decision, not a status report on it afterwards. You'll leave with an AI\-native design operation you designed end to end — and the handoff\-time and conversion numbers proving quality held while volume went up, which is the part almost nobody in this function can actually show. Puffy has been AI\-First since December 2023, so you'll build it with an AI\-native toolbox behind you rather than a versioning queue in front of you.
 



  





**What You'll Need** 



* 7\+ years in web design for e\-commerce, including 4\+ years leading, mentoring, and managing the operations of a design team.
* A portfolio that shows shipped PDP/PLP/Checkout improvements tied to clear business metrics.
* Expert in Figma (components, variables, Dev Mode); strong visual/motion craft and responsive design sensibility.
* Proven experience implementing GenAI tools into a professional design pipeline, with a clear understanding of prompt engineering, quality control, and brand governance.
* Familiarity with AI\-shaped UX patterns: conversational search, assistant UI, recommendation modules, and their measurement.
* Comfort collaborating on experiments (A/B vs multi\-armed bandits) with Growth; understands trade\-offs between optimization speed and causal certainty.
* Working knowledge of WCAG 2\.2 and SEO fundamentals for structured content and schema on e\-commerce sites.



  





**Good\-to\-Have** 



* Experience designing chat or guided\-selling flows



  





**The Puffy DNA:** 




 We're restless, perpetually hungry, and fast\-paced, driven by an unwavering belief that we can outperform any competitor, regardless of their size.
 


* **Be the Owner:** 
 We don't hire employees; we welcome owners. You're accountable for results, not activity.
* **Execute with Urgency:** 
 We thrive in high\-stakes environments by making thoughtful decisions quickly and acting decisively.
* **Demand Excellence:** 
 We solve the hard problems that others can't, pushing the boundaries of our craft.
* **Be AI\-First:** 
 Daily multi\-turn AI conversations challenge your assumptions.

title: Creative Assistant to Senior Art Director
description:
**Creative Assistant to Senior Art Director**


Aspinal of London \| London


**The Role**


We are looking for a highly organised, visually driven and proactive Creative Assistant to work closely with our Senior Art Director, acting as a true right hand across campaigns, content, e\-commerce, shoots and post\-production.


This is a varied and hands\-on role for someone who is equally comfortable immersed in the creative process as they are managing the detail behind it. You will play an important role in bringing creative projects to life \- from the initial mood board and shot list through to production, shoot days and final post\-production.


The ideal candidate will have a strong visual eye, excellent attention to detail and a naturally methodical, project\-led approach. You will be someone who can understand a creative vision, anticipate what is needed next and take ownership of making it happen.


This is an opportunity to work closely with a Senior Art Director within a luxury fashion accessories environment, gaining exposure to the full creative production process and becoming an integral part of the creative team.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Creative \& Campaign Support
* Support the Senior Art Director across seasonal campaigns, brand content, e\-commerce and creative projects.
* Assist with the development and organisation of mood boards, creative decks, shot lists and production documents.
* Help translate creative direction into clear, structured and actionable production plans.
* Work closely with the Senior Art Director to understand and maintain Aspinal's visual identity and creative standards.
* Research visual references, locations, props, styling and creative treatments where required.
* Help ensure all creative outputs remain consistent with the brand's luxury positioning and aesthetic.


**Shoot \& Production Support**


* Support the planning and preparation of photography and film shoots from initial briefing through to delivery.
* Liaise with Merchandising to identify key products, bestsellers and commercial priorities for upcoming shoots.
* Manage product, sample and stock requirements, ensuring everything required is available and accounted for.
* Liaise with internal teams to ensure all creative requirements are captured ahead of production.
* Help prepare shoot schedules, shot lists, call sheets and other production documentation.
* Attend shoots in London and work closely alongside the Senior Art Director, photographer, stylist, film team and wider production crew.
* Take responsibility for specific areas of a shoot when required, ensuring the creative direction and shot list are being delivered to the required standard.
* Be confident working independently on set and making informed decisions within the agreed creative direction.


**Post\-Production \& Delivery**


* Support the Senior Art Director with image selection and initial post\-production reviews.
* Review imagery with a strong eye for detail, identifying issues with product, styling, composition, colour, retouching or overall creative execution.
* Consolidate and communicate feedback clearly to photographers, retouchers and creative partners.
* Track post\-production amends and deadlines, ensuring projects stay on schedule.
* Maintain clear records of outstanding actions and follow up with relevant teams and suppliers.
* Help manage the final delivery of creative assets across relevant channels.


**Project \& Administrative Support**


* Act as the organisational backbone to the Senior Art Director across multiple concurrent projects.
* Take detailed meeting notes and maintain clear action lists.
* Follow up with internal teams, agencies, suppliers and production partners to ensure actions are completed.
* Maintain project timelines, deadlines and key dates.
* Proactively identify upcoming requirements and flag potential issues before they become problems.
* Keep creative and production documentation organised and up to date.
* Support the Senior Art Director with day\-to\-day project management, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.


**About You**


We are looking for someone who combines creative instinct with exceptional organisation.


You will ideally have experience within fashion, luxury, beauty, lifestyle, creative production, advertising, editorial or a similar visually led environment.


You will be:


* Highly organised, methodical and proactive.
* Naturally detail\-oriented with an excellent visual eye.
* Passionate about fashion, luxury and visual storytelling.
* Comfortable working across multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
* Confident communicating with a wide range of creative and commercial stakeholders.
* Calm, resourceful and solutions\-focused under pressure.
* Someone who takes ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do.
* Commercially aware and able to understand the balance between creative ambition and business priorities.
* Confident working on set and comfortable in a fast\-paced production environment.
* A strong communicator with excellent follow\-through.
* Collaborative, adaptable and happy to work as part of a wider creative team.


Most importantly, you will be brand\-led rather than ego\-led. You will have your own creative perspective and a strong visual point of view, but you will also understand how to interpret and support an established creative direction.


You will be someone who can look at a project and think:


“What needs to happen next, and how can I make sure it happens?”


**The Ideal Experience**


We would be particularly interested in candidates with experience in roles such as:


* Creative Assistant
* Art Director's Assistant
* Junior Art Director
* Creative Producer
* Fashion / Creative Producer
* Studio or Creative Coordinator
* Production Assistant within a creative environment


Experience working across photography, film, e\-commerce or campaign production would be highly advantageous.


**Location**

**London\-based, with a hybrid and travel led working pattern.**

This is not a traditional Monday–Friday, 9–5 office\-based role, and there is no expectation of working from an office on fixed days each week. The working pattern will vary depending on the needs of each project, with a combination of virtual working, creative meetings, production planning, shoots and travel.


A significant element of the role will be virtual and remote working. You will work very closely with the Senior Art Director remotely on creative development, mood boards, shot lists, production requirements, project timelines and post\-production. This will be a highly collaborative and hands\-on way of working, with regular calls, virtual working sessions and ongoing communication throughout the day \- effectively working together virtually as you would in person.


We are looking for someone who is highly self\-motivated, proactive and accountable, and who thrives when working with autonomy. You will be expected to take ownership of your workload, manage your priorities effectively, maintain momentum and keep the Senior Art Director informed of progress, actions and any potential issues. Strong communication, visibility and follow\-through are essential.


When projects move into production, you will be expected to work alongside the Senior Art Director in person, including regular shoots in London and occasional shoots both within the UK and internationally. There will also be frequent travel to Aspinal's Head Office in West Sussex.


The role therefore offers a varied and flexible working pattern, balancing highly engaged virtual collaboration with hands\-on time together on shoots, creative projects and key moments.


As with any creative production role, shoot days can involve longer working hours, with early starts or later finishes depending on production schedules. Flexibility around shoot days and occasional travel will therefore be required.


**Why Join Us?**


This is a unique opportunity to work closely with a Senior Art Director and gain broad exposure to the creative process within an established luxury British brand.


You will be involved from concept through to execution, with the opportunity to develop your experience across art direction, campaign production, photography, film, e\-commerce and post\-production.


We are looking for someone who wants to become an integral part of the creative process and who takes pride in making great work happen — both creatively and operationally.

 Around half your time will be spent on a global sports brand moving into brand\-first, social\-first campaign work — brand guidelines, campaign toolkits, and regional and global rollouts. title: Head of Brand Design and Creative
description:
**Our mission**
 We're making Africa the first cashless continent.
   

  

 In 2017, over half the population in Sub\-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.
   

  

 We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer\-to\-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.
   

  

 Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

title: Creative Director

Condé Nast is one of the world's most renowned media publishing companies, creating and distributing every type of media today, spanning print and digital publishing in all formats. Lead brands include Vogue, The New Yorker, GQ, Architectural Digest, Condé Nast Traveler, Vanity Fair, Wired, Allure, Ars Technica, Bon Appétit, House \& Garden, Pitchfork, Tatler, and Vogue Business.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Location:
   

  

 London, GB
   

  

 Condé Nast is a global media company, home to iconic brands including Vogue, GQ, Glamour, CN Traveller, Vanity Fair, Wired, The World of Interiors, House \& Garden and Tatler, among many others.
   

  

 We are headquartered in New York and London and operate in 32 markets worldwide, with a footprint of more than 1 billion consumers across print, digital, video and social platforms.
   

  

 Condé Nast thrives on collaboration, and our teams come together in the office four days a week (Monday \- Thursday).
   

  

 We value diversity of background, views and cultures. We celebrate people for their personal qualities, skills and contributions, recognising the power our brands have to influence and shape culture.
   

  

 Condé Nast is a global media company producing the highest quality content with a footprint of more than 1 billion consumers in 32 territories through print, digital, video and social platforms. The company’s portfolio includes many of the world’s most respected and influential media properties including Vogue, Vanity Fair, Glamour, Self, GQ, The New Yorker, Condé Nast Traveler/Traveller, Allure, AD, Bon Appétit and Wired, among others.
   

  

 Based in our London office, this role helps to set the creative vision and leads the overarching delivery of global and UK branded content, advertiser partnerships, and brand marketing across Condé Nast’s editorial portfolio. As a culturally attuned, conceptual leader, you will drive 360° creative strategy that connects brands to culture at scale. You bring a track record of editorially inspired work, natural mentorship, and the capability to deputise for the Executive Creative Director—aiding in guiding the department vision, setting creative standards, and inspiring the wider team.
   

  

 Reporting to the Executive Creative Director, you will partner with senior marketing, strategy, and sales leaders to shape major commercial opportunities, pitch transformative partnership ideas, and oversee cross\-departmental execution with editorial teams. Success requires visionary storytelling, deep commercial strategy, and a sharp cultural perspective. The Creative Director oversees overall portfolio output, establishing the creative direction and directing senior talent on high\-stakes, multi\-platform briefs—from global luxury video campaigns to multi\-market event sponsorships.
   

  

 You excel at guiding cross\-functional teams through complex, fast\-paced workflows, bringing executive\-level problem\-solving and strategic clarity to every meeting. The ideal candidate ensures creative excellence while safeguarding Condé Nast’s brand authority, creative standards, and journalistic integrity across all commercial initiatives.
   

  

 Individual \& Team Responsibilities
   

  

* Develop bold multi\-channel creative work that reflects the voice and ethos of all Condé Nast titles for advertisers across categories.
* Assign, collaborate with and direct the work of multi\-disciplinary creatives suitable for each project (art directors, designers, etc).
* Apply strategic insights in order to craft inventive content, experiential solutions, and partnership ideas that align with audience data, brand ethos, and client objectives.
* Direct video and photo shoots with a focus on performance and editorial quality.
* Serve as the primary creative client liaison on campaigns—presenting work, managing feedback, and guiding creative integrity across production.
* Drive brainstorms and work hands\-on when crafting proposals and presentations.
* Propose creative solutions that fit within the provided budgets.
* Ensure all commercial ideas authentically balance the voices and perspectives of our editorial brands with those of our advertising partners.
* Help build a thriving creative department; nurture talent, establish workflow efficiencies, and champion inclusive, forward\-thinking creative culture.
* Deputise for the Executive Creative Director across key business forums, internal leadership meetings, and executive client pitches.


**Essential Skills \& Requirements**
* 10\+ years of experience as a creative lead in premium media or agency environments.
* A demonstrated appreciation for the subject matter and creativity of the brands you’ll represent at Condé Nast.
* Confidence working with and directing artists, experts, celebrities and creators as talent on commercial projects.
* Strong portfolio showcasing work across print, digital, video and events.
* Passion for brand marketing, with a sharp cultural perspective that informs consumer\-facing campaigns.
* Skilled storyteller with excellent written, visual, and verbal presentation abilities.
* Extensive on\-set experience and deep knowledge of video and photography production, from pre\- to post\-production (for digital and print).
* Demonstrated success managing creative teams and working within established systems to improve output and efficiency.
* A creative aesthetic emphasizing current standards in entertainment, fashion, luxury and design.
* Highly organized, adaptable and adept at prioritizing workloads in fast\-paced environments.
* Ability to work fluently with collaborators in production \- writers, DPs, photographers, editors, animators, and designers.
* Proficiency in Google Slides and treatment deck creation. Bonus: familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite and editing software.


**Desired Qualities**
* Culturally informed \- Current on music and entertainment, luxury and fashion, as well as knowledgeable about Condé Nast brands and culture. Additionally, have awareness of relevant artists, and creative vendors.
* Highly imaginative \- You’re a conceptual creative with innovative ideas that challenge outdated approaches to content and the definition of “experiential.”
* Detail\-oriented \- Equally obsessed with creating memorable work and impactful campaigns that solve our client’s challenges.
* Agile and adaptable \- Open to taking input from others and willing to take on essential tasks needed to get the job done.
* Think critically \- You strive to come up with ideas that solve brand challenges, can manage multiple projects at once, and know when to pivot if something isn’t working.
* Have an ego\-less attitude \- You give credit where credit is due, bring a positive attitude to work and support your teammates in gaining visibility and opportunities.
* A natural mentor \- You prioritize diversity, inclusivity, and representation in every stage of the creative process and empathy in team collaboration.


 What benefits do we offer?
   

  

* 25 days holiday (plus bank holidays) and extra days of annual leave if you move house or want to volunteer.
* You’ll have access to a competitive pension scheme, Bupa Private Healthcare, Season ticket loans and eye tests.

title: Creative Lead
description:
**About Ogilvy**
 Ogilvy has been creating impact for brands through iconic, culture\-changing, value\-driving ideas since the company was founded by David Ogilvy more than 75 years ago. It builds on that rich legacy through Borderless Creativity—innovating at the intersection of intelligence, imagination and influence, with experts across advertising, sports \& entertainment, PR \& social, consulting, and health collaborating seamlessly across more than 120 offices spanning 90 countries. Ogilvy was named Network of the Year at the 2026 Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity and ranks as the \#1 global agency network for creative excellence and effectiveness by WARC for the fourth consecutive year, signifying its ability to deliver creative solutions that drive unreasonable impact for clients and communities. Ogilvy is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting\-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. For more information, visit Ogilvy.com, and follow us on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and Facebook.
   

  

**About WPP**
 WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting\-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world\-class creativity, next\-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.
   

  

 The Role
   

  

 We are looking for a visionary
 **Creative Lead** 
 with a strong background in
 **art direction** 
 to guide the work for a global FMCG powerhouse—one of our network’s most cherished legacy cornerstone accounts.
   

  

 In this role, you will set the creative vision across a diverse portfolio of household\-name consumer brands, driving high\-velocity global and regional campaigns that seamlessly blend bold ideas with cultural relevance and meaningful real\-world impact.This is an opportunity for someone who thrives at the intersection of strategy, craft, and social\-first creativity—someone who inspires teams, elevates execution, modernises iconic brands, and delivers platform\-level ideas that leave a lasting mark.
   

  

 At Ogilvy, we are guided by David Ogilvy’s core values:
 *Do the Right Thing, Do the Best Work of Our Lives, and Do It Together.* 
 If these principles resonate with you, we’d love for you to join us in shaping what’s next.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead with Vision \& Craft: Set and articulate a compelling creative vision across all touchpoints (film, digital, social, experiential, CRM, retail). Establish an unyielding bar for visual craft, design, and detail, leveraging your strong art direction background.
* Shape the Narrative \& Platform: Guide platform\-level thinking. Ensure ideas are culturally resonant, insight\-led, and strategically grounded. Honor the brand’s rich heritage while modernising its expression across global markets with local nuance.
* Partner for Impact \& C\-Suite Advisory: Act as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders, presenting work with clarity and conviction. Translate business goals into inspiring creative briefs and proactively identify opportunities for growth.
* Drive 360 \& Social\-First Campaigns: Oversee end\-to\-end creative for integrated campaigns across paid, owned, and earned channels. Partner closely with strategy, data/analytics, media, and production to champion performance storytelling, dynamic creative optimization, and test\-and\-learn approaches.
* Production Excellence: Guide work across the full production lifecycle, from pre\-pro through to casting, music, edit, post\-production, and final delivery—protecting the creative idea at every stage.
* Empower the Team \& Streamline Rituals: Mentor, coach, and grow multi\-disciplinary creative talent. Foster a curious, accountable culture while establishing clear briefing, review, and decision\-making rituals that streamline collaboration with account and production teams in a high\-velocity environment.


**About You**
* Proven Creative Leadership: Demonstrated experience leading, inspiring, and managing global or multi\-market creative teams.
* Strong Art Direction Foundation: Exceptional eye for visual excellence, craft, and obsessive attention to detail from concept to finished execution.
* Social\-First \& High\-Velocity Mastery: Deep comfort with social\-first approaches, dynamic platforms, and making fast, smart creative decisions in a fast\-paced environment without compromising quality.
* Integrated 360 Portfolio: A track record of platform\-level campaigns that moved culture and delivered business results across film/content, digital, social, influencer, experiential, CRM/web, and retail/e\-commerce.
* Production Expertise: Comprehensive experience navigating complex productions (casting, editing, post\-production) and protecting creative integrity.
* Strategic \& C\-Suite Communication: Outstanding storytelling and presentation skills, comfortable leading high\-stakes client conversations with senior executives.
* Culture Builder: Courageous, collaborative, and adaptable—willing to challenge conventions and defend great work while championing emerging talent.


 Benefits \& Culture
   

  

 At Ogilvy, we are a friendly, collaborative, and eclectic team united by a shared commitment to doing the best work of our lives. Beyond client work, you’ll have the chance to shape our vibrant culture, join active social teams, and contribute to our industry\-leading DEI initiatives.
   

  

**Here Is a Snapshot Of The Benefits We Offer**
* Hybrid Working: We embrace a hybrid model that blends collaborative in\-office time with the flexibility to work remotely.
* Annual Leave: 25 days holiday, a paid volunteering day, plus the option to buy up to 5 additional days.
* Pension: a generous matched scheme. Contribute 4% (Ogilvy pays 6%) up to a maximum contribution of 7% (Ogilvy pays 10\.5%—totalling a powerful 17\.5%).
* Healthcare \& Wellbeing: BUPA Private Medical Insurance, plus discounted BUPA dental cover or financial contribution towards your physical and mental wellness.
* Employee Assistance: 24/7 access to remote GPs, mental health support, physio, nutrition consultations, and confidential counselling for you and your family.
* Free 1\-to\-1 Coaching: Professional and personal growth coaching sessions annually.
* Life Assurance \& Income Protection: Financial peace of mind for you and your loved ones.


 Ogilvy champions innovation and the thoughtful application of AI. We encourage you to use AI tools to enhance your application and achieve the best possible results. During interviews, we may explore how you leverage AI, showcasing your judgment and ability to integrate these technologies effectively.
   

  

 Please ensure your application authentically reflects your own skills, experience, and unique contributions.
   

  

 At Ogilvy, our people are at the heart of what we do: a creative agency that sparks game\-changing ideas across culture and business through collaboration, integrity, and a celebration of self\-expression.
   

  

 We believe in building powerful teams with purpose \- and we relentlessly curate transformative initiatives that make our commitment to fairness, and equity a reality.
   

  

 Our ultimate mission is to leave a positive impact on the world, creating a better future for all, while supporting and uplifting the global communities we serve. This is central to our mantra of Borderless Creativity.
   

  

 Ogilvy is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
   

  

 If you need any assistance seeking a job opportunity, or if you need reasonable accommodation with the application process, please contact us at accommodations@ogilvy.com. Please note that this contact is only for candidates who are requesting accommodation. Emails for other purposes, including application status requests, will not receive a response.

description:
**Who We Are**
 IMG is a leading global sports marketing agency, specializing in media rights management and sales, multi\-channel content production and distribution, brand partnerships, strategic consulting, digital services, and event management. It powers growth of revenues, fanbases and IP for more than 250 federations, associations, events, and teams, including the National Football League, English Premier League, International Olympic Committee, National Hockey League, Major League Soccer, ATP and WTA Tours, the AELTC (Wimbledon), Euroleague Basketball, CONMEBOL, World Rugby, DP World Tour, and The R\&A, as well as UFC, WWE, and PBR.
