TKO owns iconic properties including UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization; WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment; and PBR, the world’s premier bull riding organization. Together, these properties reach 1 billion households across 210 countries and territories and organize more than 500 live events year\-round, attracting more than three million fans. TKO also services and partners with major sports rights holders through IMG, an industry\-leading global sports marketing agency; and On Location, a global leader in premium experiential hospitality.
   

  

*We power the passion for sport \-* 
 IMG is an industry\-leading global sports marketing agency, specializing in media rights management and sales, multi\-channel content production and distribution, brand partnerships, digital services, and events management. It powers growth of revenues, fanbases and IP for more than 200 federations, associations, events, and teams, including the National Football League, English Premier League, International Olympic Committee, National Hockey League, Major League Soccer, ATP and WTA Tours, the All England Lawn Tennis \& Croquet Club (Wimbledon), EuroLeague Basketball, DP World Tour, and The R\&A, as well as UFC, WWE, and PBR. IMG is a subsidiary of TKO, a premium sports and entertainment company.
   

  

 We're looking for an exceptional creative leader who thrives where strategy, storytelling and design meet. Someone equally comfortable shaping the creative vision for a global marketing campaign, leading a business\-winning pitch, or inspiring a team to produce their best work. This is a rare opportunity to influence one of the world's biggest names in sport and entertainment while helping define how IMG shows up to clients, partners and fans around the world.
   

  

 This role oversees and influences creative across graphic design, presentation design, campaign creative, brand identity, digital, social, motion and experiential activation. Bringing together strategy, storytelling, design and innovation to create work that wins clients, builds brands and inspires audiences. Perfect for someone who thrives in a fast\-paced environment, champions bold, original thinking grounded in strategic insight with a passion for sport. You’ll collaborate closely with senior leaders, business development teams and marketers to ensure visually striking, strategically effective designs are delivered to the highest standards.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities And Accountabilities**
* Lead creative for IMG's most strategically important pitches and RFPs from initial brief through to presentation.
* Raise the creative ambition of every pitch by bringing unexpected ideas, strong conceptual thinking and world\-class execution.
* Build pitch frameworks, templates and presentation systems that enable faster, higher\-quality responses.
* Drive creative direction for major clients from initial concept through final delivery.
* Oversee brand development through campaigns, brand activities, and marketing collateral.
* Manage, mentor, and inspire a team of designers and set standards for quality, consistency, and creative excellence.
* Collaborate directly with senior stakeholders, industry\-leading strategists and marketers to interpret briefs and shape visual direction.
* Build and maintain template systems and asset libraries to streamline workflow and raise quality across the organisation.
* Evolve design capabilities and identify opportunities to push our creative through new tools, processes, or formats.
* Balance hands\-on design leadership with strategic oversight.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously and deliver under tight deadlines in a high\-pressure environment without compromising quality.
* Maintain and evolve IMG’s brand identity.


**Knowledge And Experience**
* 10\+ years in design with at least 3 years leading teams in an agency, studio, or in\-house creative environment.
* A strong portfolio \- we'd love to see examples of:
+ Winning pitch presentations
+ Integrated marketing campaigns
+ Brand systems
+ Large\-scale activations
+ Exceptional typography, layout and visual storytelling skills.
+ Knowledge in AI\-driven design tools (E.g. Flora, Runway, Nano Banana, generative design) to improve creative, storytelling and time efficiencies.
+ Experience presenting and selling creative concepts to senior leadership.
+ Fluency in Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, and comfort with motion and digital design.
+ Proven ability to manage multiple projects and priorities without sacrificing quality.
+ Experience in sports, entertainment, or culturally driven brands preferred.

**Skills And Abilities**+ A creative leader who raises the bar for everyone around you.
+ A natural storyteller who knows how to turn ideas, strategy and raw content into beautifully crafted narratives.
+ You give direct, constructive feedback and create space for your team to do their best work.
+ You believe great design can change how people feel about a brand, an event, or a moment and you want to prove it at the highest level.
+ Highly organised, thrive in high\-pressure environments, staying calm, focused and sharp when deadlines are tight.
+ Detail\-obsessed but never lose sight of the bigger picture, work with speed and precision, balancing creativity with efficiency.
+ Enjoy collaborating and confidently present and discuss your design decisions.
+ You’re proactive and solutions\-focused, if something isn’t quite right, you instinctively find a better way.
+ You're curious, energized by sport and culturally aware.


- 

 In addition, success at IMG is driven by four
 **core competencies** 
 that apply to all employees:
   

  

* Business Acumen – Understanding financial drivers, interpreting business data, aligning decisions to strategic outcomes
* Operational Excellence – Driving efficiency, governance, and continuous improvement in delivery \& operations
* Innovation Mindset – Cultivating curiosity, experimentation, and forward\-looking capability development
* Leadership \& Collaboration – Inspiring others, building trust, and enabling collaboration across teams

title: Creative Director
description:
As a
 **Creative Director,** 
 you will turn complex business goals into compelling creative ideas. You will guide multidisciplinary teams, lead client conversations, and create the clarity people need to do their best work. You will also use AI thoughtfully to support research, exploration, and workflow efficiency while keeping strategy, judgment, and final approval human\-led.
 



  





 Designity is a premium, AI\-enabled and human\-led Creative\-as\-a\-Service company. We help brands scale creative and marketing work through dedicated Creative Director\-led teams. Our model brings together senior creative leadership, multidisciplinary talent, managed execution, and AI\-enabled workflows so clients can move faster without lowering the standard.
 



  





**Why this role exists** 




 Our clients are managing ambitious business goals, changing priorities, and creative needs that span brands, campaigns, digital experiences, motion, and content.
 



  





 They need more than strong execution. They need a senior creative leader who can find the strategic opportunity, establish a clear direction, assemble the right team, and protect quality from the first conversation through final delivery.
 



  





**What you will be doing** 



* **Set the creative vision** 
 \- Lead creative direction across multiple clients, industries, and project types, including brand platforms, campaigns, visual identities, digital experiences, motion, and content.
* **Turn business goals into creative opportunities** 
 \- Find the human and strategic insight behind the brief. Translate it into focused, emotionally resonant concepts that support the client’s objectives.
* **Guide the right creative team** 
 \- Help shape and lead multidisciplinary teams based on the needs of the client, brand, and assignment.
* **Conduct Quality Control \& Protect the standard** 
 \- Review concepts and execution for strategic relevance, originality, craft, brand alignment, and production quality.
* **Lead client conversations** 
 \- Present and defend creative ideas with confidence. Explain the reasoning behind recommendations and guide stakeholders through productive feedback cycles.
* **Develop creative talent** 
 \- Help creative professionals strengthen their judgment and craft through direct feedback, clear expectations, and thoughtful mentorship.
* **Use AI with intention** 
 \- Leverage AI tools to strengthen research, ideation, exploration, and workflow efficiency. Retain human ownership of strategy, accuracy, taste, sensitive decisions, and final approval.
* **Build a strong creative environment** 
 \- Encourage originality, curiosity, respectful challenge, accountability, and collaboration.



  





**What you will bring** 



* Around 8 years of relevant creative experience, including at least 3 years in creative leadership roles
* A portfolio demonstrating strong work across branding, visual communication, digital experiences, motion, or integrated campaigns, with clear examples of how you have leveraged AI in your creative process and outcomes
* Great attention to detail to catch any branding inconsistencies
* Experience leading multidisciplinary teams toward original, strategically grounded creative work
* The ability to translate complex business challenges into clear creative strategies and compelling concepts
* A strong understanding of branding, storytelling, design, and audience\-centered communication with sound creative judgment and the ability to explain what is working, what needs to change, and why
* A business\-minded approach that connects creative decisions to audience and organizational goals with the ability to present ideas clearly, build stakeholder alignment, and guide feedback without losing the strategic intent
* Strong written and verbal English communication for nuanced client conversations, presentations, briefs, and feedback
* The adaptability, judgment, and reliability and strong internet connection needed to work effectively in a remote environment
* Practical experience using AI tools to strengthen creativity or efficiency without compromising quality or human accountability



  





**How we work** 




 Designity is remote, with a structured virtual office environment built for close collaboration, clear communication, and meaningful connection. You will work across client relationships, creative disciplines, and changing priorities.
 



  





 At least six hours of overlap with U.S. Eastern Time is required so you can lead conversations, collaborate with teams, and make timely decisions.,
 



  





**What this role offers** 



* The opportunity to work alongside the top 1% of global creatives and marketers, in a multicultural environment that broadens your perspective and sharpens your craft
* Shape meaningful creative work across different brands, industries, and disciplines
* Collaboration with ambitious clients and multidisciplinary creative talent
* A fully remote environment with structured virtual collaboration
* W\-2 role with health insurance and 401k benefits available after 90 days
* Paid time off to rest and recharge
* Professional growth and continued skill development
* A fast\-moving, supportive environment that values creative thinking, accountability, and high standards
* Total compensation of $90,000–$110,000 USD based on your qualifications.



  





**We believe great teams are built on shared values** 



* **Choose Positivity** 
 and lift those around you.
* **Say It Straight** 
 with honesty and respect.
* **Raise the Bar** 
 by never settling for average.
* **Take Ownership** 
 of your work and your impact.
* **Move with Purpose** 
 and make every action count.



  





**Success in this role means** 



* Creating work that is both strategically sound and creatively outstanding.
* Becoming a trusted creative partner to clients and internal teams.
* Elevating the quality of ideas, execution, and storytelling.
* Helping teams do their best work through clear feedback and mentorship.
* Balancing creativity with reliability, organization, and follow\-through.
* Embracing AI as a tool to enhance creativity and efficiency.



  





**Disclaimer:** 




 Our team reviews every submission carefully and will contact candidates who best fit the role within 2–3 weeks.
 



  





 Be cautious when applying. Official communications from Designity will come only from the Designity.com domain.
 



  





 At Designity, employment decisions are based on business needs, qualifications, and merit.
 



  





 We’re an Equal Opportunity Employer that values diversity in backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences; it’s what makes our team and our work stronger.

title: Creative Director
description:
**About Us**
 Circle is building the world’s leading AI\-powered, all\-in\-one platform for digital businesses. We make it possible for creators, coaches, educators, and businesses to bring together their audience with engaging discussions, live streams, events, chat, courses, and payments — all in one place, all under their own brand.
   

  

 We’re proud to be a fully remote company of around 270 (and growing!) team members from 30\+ countries around the world. We seek exceptional individuals around the world, set them up to do the best work of their lives, and in turn, create a meaningful impact in their own lives. We don't track hours, but we do manage for high expectations very closely. We collaborate across time zones, are highly async, and like to document a lot.
   

  

 Twice a year, we bring the whole company together in beautiful places around the world for our company offsites. So far, we’ve hosted offsites in Turkey, Portugal, Mexico, Thailand, Colombia, Italy, Ireland, and more, with still more to come!
   

  

 Check out our
 **Careers** 
 page for more about working at Circle.
   

  

**About The Role**
**We’re excited to bring on Circle’s first Creative Director.**
 This is a unique opportunity to shape how Circle shows up in the world, and define the story of a generational company building the future of digital businesses.
   

  

 We’re looking for an exceptional creative storyteller who can help us develop strong, consistent narratives across everything Circle puts into the world: product launches, campaigns, ads, landing pages, announcements, partnerships, events, and more.
   

  

 You obsess over the power of a great narrative. You believe every word, visual, and detail matters. You have an exceptionally high creative bar, thrive in highly collaborative environments, and know how to influence people through the quality of the work itself.
   

  

 As Circle’s first Creative Director, you’ll first and foremost act as a creative extension of the founders. You will turn their ideas, product strategy, and company vision into narratives that are clear, memorable, and unmistakably Circle across all our assets.
   

  

 On a day\-to\-day basis, you’ll work closely with Circle’s founders and across our in\-house design studio, product marketing, paid media, video, and events teams to elevate our storytelling and creative execution across every major moment.
   

  

**Your goal is to help make Circle one of the most creatively distinct and definitive companies in the category of digital businesses.**
**What You'll Be Doing**
* Shape Circle’s narrative. Work closely with Circle’s founders to synthesize, sharpen, and evolve the story behind our long\-term vision, and translate it into clear, compelling narratives that can travel across everything we do.
* Own the creative direction of our biggest launches and campaigns. Find the angle, develop the brief, shape the story, and obsess over how we make each moment stand out. You’ll partner closely with Product Marketing across launches, announcements, demos, and enablement to ensure everything feels cohesive, intentional, and unmistakably Circle. Doing this well requires developing a deep understanding of our product, customers, and market.
* Be a deeply embedded creative marketing partner to our design studio. You’ll work especially closely with our Design Studio, which is led by one of Circle’s co\-founders and won’t report to you. Success here involves shared taste, mutual trust, healthy creative tension, and the ability to move quickly together. You’ll occasionally lead external agencies as well — and when the moment calls for it, write the high\-stakes copy yourself: the headline, manifesto, launch script, or line someone delivers on stage.
* Raise the bar on our advertising and creative campaigns. Develop the concepts and narratives behind Circle’s ad creative, partnering up our Paid Acquisition team to turn them into high\-performing campaigns. They’ll bring the channel and media\-buying expertise; while you can make sure the creative is worth paying to distribute.
* Direct how our stories come to life across video and events. Get hands\-on with scripts, structure, pacing, and narrative for launch films, social, ads, virtual summits, and other major moments. You won’t be editing videos or producing events yourself, but you’ll understand the craft well enough to have strong opinions about what works in each medium, and collaborate deeply with the specialists who bring it to life.
* Influence the narrative behind brand experiences people remember across our webinars, virtual summits, conferences, and live events to align with company brand vision. This includes everything from the theme and programming to the booth, talks, slides, copy, and small details nobody else would think to obsess over.
* Turn partnerships into stories. Work with our Partnerships team to make more of our collaborations with creators and customers into stories we can distribute across our channels. You can help develop the concept, framing, name, narrative, and creative execution behind our biggest partnerships, and helping our partners tell those stories powerfully themselves.


**What We're Looking For**
* A body of work you’re genuinely proud of. We care far more about what you’ve made than the titles you’ve held or the number of years you’ve been doing it. You should be able to walk us through your best work piece by piece: the problem, the idea, the choices you made, what you personally contributed, and ultimately, whether it worked.
* Exceptional creative taste and judgment. You know great work when you see it, can articulate why it’s great, and have the conviction to push work until it gets there. title: AI Creative Lead (Remote)
description:
At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality. We arm people with trusted advice and guidance so they can make informed decisions they feel confident in and get back to doing the things they care about most.
   

  

 We are an experienced team of industry experts dedicated to helping readers make smart decisions and choose the right products with ease. Forbes Advisor boasts decades of experience across dozens of geographies and teams, including Content, SEO, Business Intelligence, Finance, HR, Marketing, Production, Technology and Sales. The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel.
   

  

 Forbes Advisor is hiring an
 ****AI Creative Lead****
 to own the generative stack that turns approved scripts and storyboards into finished, on\-brand video and static ads. This person is two things at once: a creative with a deep understanding of direct\-response marketing, and a hands\-on operator who lives in the AI tools daily. You run the back half of our pipeline, from character\-locked stills through AI video, lip\-sync, and voiceover to editor\-ready footage, and you treat every step as a creative call as much as a technical one: what serves the story, what sells, and what will read as a real ad in the feed.
   

  

 The role reports into the Head of Creative Production and partners with our Creative Directors and Editor/Designers. You know what makes a DR ad work, the hook, the pacing, the proof, and the turn to the offer, and you know which model(s) to use and why. You can hold character, wardrobe, and continuity across a whole spot, debug a broken render instead of re\-rolling, and get renders through touchy platform filters. You have shipped AI\-generated video that ran as paid creative, and you can tell real\-ad output from output that just reads as AI.
   

  

 We are a human\-led shop that uses AI to move faster without diluting craft. You protect the craft bar rather than lowering it to what the model makes easy, and you stay current with a stack that turns over frequently, treating every tool pick as a short\-term decision.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own generation end\-to\-end for paid social and native creative: character\-locked stills, AI video, lip\-sync, and clean generated voiceover, from approved script and storyboard to editor\-ready footage.
* Lock base characters first, then build a still per beat that references them, holding character, wardrobe, prop, and continuity consistency across an entire spot.
* Pick the right model for each job (hero vs. volume, native\-audio vs. img\-to\-video) and keep a live view of a fast\-moving tool stack, pinning exact model versions at build time.
* Scout, test, and onboard new models and tools as the stack evolves, and retire the ones that fall behind, so the team is always working with the best available.
* Get renders through platform and category filters. Diagnose and auto\-fix a broken render once, then escalate, and keep a running swipe of safe phrasings and prompt patterns that pass.
* Operate and lightly orchestrate the tooling (fan\-out, scheduling, asset movement) so many jobs run in parallel without a person babysitting each one.
* Own the generative\-side handoff into post: deliver organized, tagged, editor\-ready clips into the DAM to the production team's standards.
* Feed the shared learnings file (format, copy, render, and legal notes per job) and read it back at the next job's start so the system compounds instead of repeating mistakes.
* Partner with the Creative Directors and copywriters to keep generated output on\-voice, on\-persona, and matched beat\-for\-beat to the script (AV sync).
* Bring a direct\-response creative eye to every job: push each render toward what sells, the hook, the pacing, the proof, and the turn to the offer, not just what looks good.
* Operate inside compliance rails for our regulated categories: no better\-drug or results claims, coverage/qualify framing, required disclosures, and honest routing. Hold generation to the same gate as the rest of the pipeline.
* Manage generative tooling spend against render volume, and give the Head of Creative Production a real monthly cost model as volume scales.
* Build reusable assets (prompt libraries, character references, templates, and workflow docs) that let editors and strategists self\-serve the routine work.


**Requirements**
* 4\+ years in creative production, motion, VFX, or content, with at least the last 1 to 2 years hands\-on in generative AI video and image production for real deliverables.
* A real grounding in direct\-response creative. You understand how a DR ad is built (hook, problem, mechanism, proof, offer, and CTA) and can judge whether a cut will convert, not only whether it looks polished.
* Demonstrated generative craft: a reel or portfolio of AI\-generated or AI\-assisted video and stills, with an honest account of what you made vs. what the model made, and (ideally) how it performed.
* Deep, current fluency with the generative stack: multi\-subject\-consistency image models, AI video (native\-audio and img\-to\-video), lip\-sync, and AI voiceover. You have opinions on trade\-offs, not just tool names.
* Character and continuity discipline: you can hold a consistent character across many shots and beats, not just generate one good frame.
* Prompt and troubleshooting fluency: you can diagnose why a render broke or a character drifted and fix it deliberately, rather than re\-rolling until something lands.
* Comfort building light automation/orchestration around the tools (e.g. n8n, Gumloop, or comparable) to fan out and move assets. You don't need to be an engineer, but you're not afraid of the glue.
* A finishing eye: you know when AI output reads as a real ad vs. a tech demo, and you hold the line on craft.
* Demonstrated speed and volume in a performance, DR, or high\-output content environment. Comfortable shipping many cuts and variants a week across multiple categories.
* Comfort working inside compliance rails (regulated\-category claims, platform ad policy, partner brand guardrails).
* Strong collaboration across Creative, Production, Post, and Buying, and clear written communication for briefs, prompt docs, and learnings.
* Self\-starter with an entrepreneurial mindset, comfortable in a start\-up style operating environment where the tools change under you.


****STRONG PLUSES****
* Generative video that has run as paid social or DR creative with attributable performance, not only brand or experimental work.
* Concepting or copywriting experience on DR ads, so you can improve a script or angle, not just execute it.
* Direct experience generating for regulated DR categories and getting their renders through platform filters.
* Video editing or motion/VFX background (Premiere, After Effects, DaVinci) that lets you hand editors better material and speak their language.
* Experience building reusable AI workflows for creative production: prompt libraries, character\-reference systems, Claude Projects or custom GPTs, or agentic tooling that compounds team output.
* Familiarity with DAM systems (Air, Frame.io, or comparable) and production project\-management tooling.
* Comfort reading performance dashboards (Looker, Tableau, in\-platform reporting) to close the loop between what rendered and what converted.
* A track record of picking up brand\-new tools fast and forming a real point of view on them, because this stack turns over monthly.

**Creative Direction**



* Lead AI\-powered vertical short drama projects from script breakdown through final delivery.
* Translate scripts into production\-ready visual plans: scene breakdowns, shot lists, character references, location references, style guides, and AI production requirements.
* Guide AI image and video generation; review style frames, character tests, motion tests, rough cuts, and final deliverables, and give clear, actionable notes on continuity, performance, composition, pacing, and tone.
* Strengthen episode\-level hooks, cliffhangers, reversals, and emotional escalation for 1–3 minute vertical episodes.
* Maintain visual, character, and story consistency across episodes and series.
* Supervise post\-production — editing, sound, music, subtitles, and final polish.



**Production \& Vendor Management**



* Serve as the primary point of contact between Zing and external AI production vendors and partners.
* Own project timelines, budgets, and resource/vendor allocation across multiple concurrent productions.
* Communicate creative briefs, visual references, production standards, delivery timelines, and revision notes to vendors, and hold them to Zing's technical specs (9:16 format, 1–3 min episodes) and quality benchmarks.

* Build repeatable AI production workflows: vendor briefing templates, character bibles, prompt guidelines, review checklists, and delivery specifications.
* Translate platform data, audience feedback, and ad performance learnings into creative and production improvements.
* Help define Zing's internal AI vertical drama production playbook and quality standards.
* Monitor emerging AI tools, trends, and vendor capabilities to keep Zing's workflows and partner network competitive.

* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in vertical/short\-form drama production — as a director, showrunner, creative producer, or producer — with real credits in the format (not adjacent film/TV only).

* Strong understanding of vertical drama structure and mechanics: hooks, reversals, cliffhangers, emotional escalation, fast\-payoff storytelling.

* Proven experience managing external vendors, production partners, or outsourced/remote production teams, ideally across several projects at once.

description:

**Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.**
 Hey, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!
   

  

 Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.
   

  

**Where And How You Can Work**
 Alongside our global campuses, we also collaborate with talented contractors and freelancers from all over the world to help us achieve our crazy big goals. While we support flexible, remote\-friendly ways of working, for this role we’re focusing on Mexico City so we can best support our teams and keep collaboration flowing.
   

  

 This role is a 12 month engagement, working full time hours per week.
   

  

**What You’d Be Doing In This Role**
 As Creative Strategist for Mexico, you’ll be the creative performance engine behind Canva’s paid marketing in the region.
   

  

 This role sits at the intersection of Creative, Growth, and Data \- combining cultural insight, analytical depth, and creative instinct to continuously improve our performance marketing output. You won’t be running bids day\-to\-day \- you’ll be driving the creative strategy that makes those campaigns win.
   

  

 If you love decoding what makes a hook scroll\-stopping, turning insights into structured testing, and raising the creative bar sprint after sprint, this role is for you.
   

  

**At The Moment, This Role Is Focused On**
* Leading the full creative cycle \- research, briefing, production, and performance review — running weekly sprint cycles that balance quick\-win iterations with bigger creative swings, and feeding learnings back to the broader team after every sprint
* Digging into performance dashboards to spot winning patterns, diagnose underperformance, and translate insights into clear, actionable creative direction that drives the next round of concepts
* Directing and collaborating with video editors, designers, writers, and local creators to produce high\-quality work across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and emerging channels \- briefing and reviewing content to keep it on\-brand, culturally relevant, and platform\-optimised
* Bringing deep cultural fluency to every brief \- identifying Mexican audience behaviours, regional trends, and platform dynamics that shape compelling, locally resonant storytelling
* Working closely with media buyers, data science, and the LatAm Growth Marketing Lead to make sure creative insights translate into measurable business outcomes
* Driving CRO initiatives that improve acquisition journeys and lift conversion efficiency across key touchpoints
* Using AI tools to accelerate ideation, research, asset generation, and analysis \- and staying across emerging formats and creative tech that give the team an edge


**You’re Probably a Match If**
* You have solid experience in growth or performance marketing with a strong focus on creative strategy \- and you've worked hands\-on across Meta, TikTok, and YouTube
* You can lead structured creative testing and sprint frameworks, analyse what's working, and turn those learnings into clear briefs for the next cycle
* You have strong creative instinct \- you know what makes a hook scroll\-stopping, a format compelling, and a concept scalable across channels
* You're fluent in Spanish and English, with a sharp eye for tone, nuance, and cultural resonance for Mexican audiences
* You have experience briefing, directing, and iterating with creative talent — video editors, designers, writers, and creators \- coaching them to produce performance\-driven work
* You're confident using dashboards and analytics tools to inform decisions and optimise creative at scale
* You use AI tools to accelerate your workflow and improve output quality


**Meet the team**
 We're Canva's LatAm Marketing group, and our mission is to make Canva the most loved brand in the region. We build culturally resonant, high\-impact marketing across Latin America \- combining bold creative storytelling with sharp performance thinking to drive visibility and growth, market by market. Mexico is a key focus for us right now, and this role sits right at the heart of that ambition.

 We make decisions to engage contractors based on your experience, skills and passion.
   

  

 When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.

description:

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.


We’re proudly digital\-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80\+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital\-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in\-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in\-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City (opening Summer 2026\), you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

Upstart’s **Brand \& Creative** team shapes how the brand comes to life across every touchpoint — defining our voice, personality, and emotional connection with borrowers and partners. As the **Art Director, Performance** at Upstart, you’ll create high\-impact creative across our Paid Social channels, including Meta, TikTok, Google, and emerging channels. Partnering closely with Marketing and Creative, you’ll develop best\-in\-class work across evergreen and influencer programs with both in\-house teams and external agency partners. * Partner cross\-functionally and with external agencies to concept, design, and deliver best\-in\-class evergreen and influencer creative that drives measurable results.

* Ability to clearly articulate creative decisions and recommendations to creative and non\-creative stakeholders.
* Ability to translate business and performance goals into compelling creative strategies and concepts.

**Time zone requirements** The team operates on the East/West coast time zones.

The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in\-person collaborating via regular onsites. title: Associate Creative Director / Copywriter
description:
Bakery is an independent creative agency built to make people obsessed with great products. We work with ambitious brands to give them cultural value and help them make things people want. We've made work for Nike, Pepsi, Dairy Queen, Shiner, and Buchanan's, among others. We've been named an AdAge Small Agency of the Year four times. We're hiring an Associate Creative Director to join us in Austin.

 **The job**


You partner with an ACD on the art side and report into a Creative Director. Together you run the work day to day, from the brief to the final deliverable. You're not just managing, you're in it. Writing lines, shaping scripts, sitting in the edit, pushing a piece until it's right.


You lead by doing. Senior, mid\-weight, and junior creatives on your team learn what good looks like by watching how you work, not just by getting your notes on their work. You set the standard in the room, on set, on the page, in the edit bay, wherever the work actually gets made.


Here's what you'll own:

* Hands\-on development of the work alongside your team, not just oversight of it
* Day\-to\-day leadership of writers across every level, senior to junior
* Partnership with your art\-side ACD to keep ideas and execution moving together
* The gap between a CD's vision and what actually gets made
* Client presentations, alongside your CD and on your own when it's called for

**Core responsibilities**

  

* Write and lead the copy on your work, not just direct someone else's
* Set the voice and standard for writers below you, by doing the work in front of them
* Present your own thinking directly to clients and hold the room when it's challenged
* Push back on feedback that would flatten the idea, and know the difference between that and feedback that makes it better
* Partner tightly with an art\-side ACD so copy and concept move as one thing, not two

*This role is on\-site 3\-4 days a week.*

 **Requirements**  

You've spent at least 8 years in top agencies making work that has shipped and had impact. If the work has made the rounds at award circuits, even better. We're only considering candidates from agencies making work we recognize and respect. We are not hiring brand\-side. You know what it means to run multiple clients at once, work a pitch cadence that doesn't stop, and move at a pace other industries don't operate at.


Beyond that:

* A portfolio with real, produced work across film, OOH, experiences, social, and digital.
* Direct, hands\-on writing chops. You're still doing the work, not just reviewing it.
* Experience leading and teaching creatives across seniority levels, by example.
* Comfort presenting to clients and holding your own in the room.
* Experience on set. Our ACDs are a key presence at shoots; not to eat crafty and be on their phones, but to ensure the creative plan is followed.
* An obsession with craft. You notice the detail everyone else missed, and you fix it before anyone has to ask.

  

**Benefits**  

* Competitive insurance coverage, inclusive of medical, dental, and vision
* 401k Retirement with 3% employer matching
* Open PTO Policy
* 2 weeks Work From Anywhere (WFA)
* 13 weeks paid Maternity and Paternity leave
* Pet\-Friendly Office
* Yearly Creative Stipend
* Snacks, Meals and Drinks
* No Time Tracking!

Leading an integrated Art and Copy team, you bring both conceptual rigor and the self\-editing skills to shape campaigns with minimal oversight. You thrive as a hands\-on creative, formulating bold ideas on brief, directing executions, and presenting directly to clients with confidence and clarity. * Demonstrate maturity in navigating challenging client situations, finding creative opportunities even within difficult constraints
* Collaborate with flexibility and confidence to build account team and client trust and ensure satisfaction while maintaining HUNTER's creative standards
* Identify growth opportunities with existing clients; support account expansion through strong creative work and strategic thinking


**New Business \& Agency Growth**

* Bring thoughtful, fresh, and strategic ideas to new business opportunities; demonstrate the energy and enthusiasm that wins pitches

**Budgeting and Finance**
* Track team members hours/rates and OOP costs against budget and work with the ECD to manage billability and useability across the team
* Establish a clear line of communication with account teams, ECD and COO with respect to scoping and pricing models for all projects

* Manage all vendor contracts, and insurance (both freelance and production vendor)

* 6\-10\+ years of creative leadership, with proven success leading multidisciplinary teams in integrated marketing, brand experiences, or communications
* Exceptional portfolio demonstrating conceptual strength, visual storytelling, and integrated campaign execution
* Demonstrated ability to develop and execute innovative campaigns that drive engagement and measurable results
* Record of winning new business and expanding existing client relationships

* Ability to mentor, coach, and develop creative talent; model strong leadership through clear direction, constructive feedback, and empowerment
* Proven experience managing and inspiring cross\-functional teams across design, content strategy, production, and account management

Westside Design, in partnership with Westside Build, is a Santa Monica\-based design and construction firm rebuilding homes across the Pacific Palisades in the wake of the wildfire. We bring architecture, design, and construction under one roof, with a strong emphasis on technology, speed, and craft.
   

  

 We are looking for a
 **Studio Director** 
 to lead an entire studio across client management, contracts, design, technical coordination, and delivery. This is a senior leadership role for someone who can operate as a broad\-based leader rather than a narrow specialist, someone who can move between client conversations, project strategy, technical issues, team leadership, and day\-to\-day studio needs with ease.
   

  

 This role is intended to be more of a multi\-tool leadership position: a person who can talk about contracts, deal with clients, guide design, engage technical and CA issues, and help support the Managing Principal lead the full studio. The Studio Director will directly lead our Project Managers and Project Architects, who are responsible for BIM model development, construction documentation, and permit\-ready deliverables in Revit. You will set the design intent and quality bar that the team documents and executes against, review their work at key milestones, and serve as the design authority they escalate to on coordination, code, and client\-facing design decisions.
   

  

**Requirements**
* 13\+ years of professional experience in architecture, residential design\-build, or a comparable studio environment
* 8\+ years leading complex residential projects through design, technical coordination, and delivery
* 5\+ years in a senior leadership role spanning client management, contracts, team oversight, and project execution
* Residential experience, especially custom homes, ADUs, and rebuild work
* Proven ability to lead across contracts, client management, design discussions, technical coordination, and CA
* Strong leadership presence and sound judgment in a fast\-moving environment
* Experience overseeing teams, projects, and multiple stakeholder relationships
* Strong communication skills and the ability to operate effectively with clients, internal teams, and leadership
* Must bring direct experience in a comparable leadership seat; this is not intended as a step\-up role from PM or senior project architect


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years in a role such as Studio Director, Senior Project Manager, Design Director, or similar leadership role
* Experience in integrated architecture/construction or design\-build settings
* Familiarity with consultant coordination, construction documentation, and field\-related problem solving


**Studio Leadership**
* Lead the overall performance of the studio across client service, project execution, staffing coordination, and day\-to\-day operations
* Serve as a senior leader helping guide studio priorities, unblock issues, and maintain momentum across multiple active projects
* Partner with firm leadership on studio structure, resourcing, and operational effectiveness
* Help create accountability across the studio by following up on open items, pushing decisions forward, and keeping workstreams moving


**Client \& Project Leadership**
* Serve as a senior point of contact for clients and help manage relationships across active work
* Navigate project conversations across scope, contracts, design, technical coordination, and delivery
* Step into difficult project situations and help resolve issues with sound judgment and a broad understanding of project needs
* Balance design intent, technical requirements, coordination demands, and client expectations across the life of a project


**Contracts, Technical Oversight \& CA**
* Engage directly in contract review, contract language discussions, and related project risk items as needed
* Provide high\-level oversight on technical issues and support teams in resolving project coordination challenges
* Participate in CA\-related discussions and help ensure project issues are being surfaced and addressed appropriately
* Act as a senior escalation point when projects need broader leadership attention beyond pure design questions


**Team Leadership**
* Help supervise and support team members working across design, project delivery, and technical execution
* Provide oversight and direction to staff who need support coordinating clients, internal standards, and changing project demands
* Mentor team members and help reinforce expectations for accountability, communication, and cross\-functional coordination
* Work closely with leadership to identify where additional supervision or stronger management coverage is needed


**Benefits**
* Hybrid work schedule: four days in\-office, one day remote
* Comprehensive health insurance (medical, dental, and vision)
* Paid time off and holidays
* Professional development opportunities
* A collaborative, innovative work environment with a supportive culture focused on mentorship and growth


***Compensation:***
*Commensurate with experience and scope of leadership responsibility. The salary range for this role is $140,000\-$170,000\.*

title: Senior Director, AI Transformation & Operations
description:
The Senior Director of AI Transformation \& Operations serves as the operational heart of the ELEC AI Center of Excellence.
  

  

This is a high\-impact leadership role responsible for translating our enterprise\-wide AI strategy into reality.
  

  

You will provide the structure, shared foundations, and governance that enable our four business lines to deliver AI solutions with speed, quality, and precision.
**Job Description**
===================


**The mission of the AI Operations Leader within our office is to:**


* **Enable Execution:** Facilitate the execution of Business Line long\-term strategy (LTS) plans, ensuring they move at speed and with high impact.
* **Ensure Operational Excellence:** Define and manage the day\-to\-day mechanisms that deliver consistent quality, ensuring that every AI initiative is executed with discipline and minimal risk.
* **Scale Through Capability:** Act as the operational backbone of our center of excellence, transforming our strategy into repeatable processes that allow our businesses to own and scale their AI delivery effectively.

**What you’ll be doing**


* **Facilitating business execution:** You will act as the primary partner for our four business lines. Your focus is on clearing the path for them to execute their long\-term strategic AI plans, ensuring they have the support and resources needed to reach their goals quickly and effectively.
* **Defining the operational heartbeat:** You will establish the "cadence" of AI delivery—regular reviews, progress tracking, and feedback loops—that keep our business lines aligned and moving forward.
* **Providing a shared foundation:** You will lead the development of the "common ground"—the standards, tools, and shared platforms—that allow our business units to build AI solutions without having to solve the same infrastructure or governance problems in isolation.
* **Driving speed and quality:** You will help our business teams balance the need for rapid delivery with the need for high\-quality, reliable output. By implementing clear, lightweight ways of working, you will help teams avoid common pitfalls and keep projects on track.
* **Managing risk by design:** Instead of treating risk as a hurdle to be jumped at the end, you will help teams bake it into their processes from day one. You will ensure that Responsible AI and security practices are built into the workflow, protecting the business while maintaining momentum.
* **Ensuring strategic alignment:** You will oversee our portfolio to ensure that the work happening across the business lines stays tethered to ELEC’s overarching enterprise priorities. You will help teams focus their energy on the initiatives that provide the greatest return.
* **Supporting the transition:** We are working toward a future where our business lines are fully empowered to lead their own AI delivery. You will guide this evolution, scaling our efforts today to build a sustainable, business\-led model for 2030\.
* **Driving adoption and upskilling:** You will champion the human side of our transformation by leading efforts to upskill our workforce. In close coordination with ELEC HR, the GE Vernova Corporate Learning team, the ELEC CTO office, and Business Line AI teams, you will design and adapt training programs that directly address the unique missions and practical needs of our ELEC teams. By building targeted AI literacy and specialized expertise, you will ensure our people are empowered to adopt new tools and maximize the value of AI in their specific daily work.

**What you bring to the team**


* **A commitment to partnership:** You have a track record of supporting business units in achieving their strategic goals. You view your role as a service to the business lines, not as a central authority.
* **A "get it done" mindset:** You understand that the best strategy is only valuable if it can be executed. You are experienced in guiding complex initiatives through to delivery while maintaining high standards.
* **Balanced judgment:** You know how to provide enough guidance to ensure consistency across the company without creating unnecessary red tape that slows teams down.
* **Technical and business fluency:** You can communicate clearly with both technical delivery teams and business leadership, ensuring that everyone understands the goals and the path to achieving them.
* **Proven reliability:** You have a history of managing programs or operations where speed, quality, and risk management were all critical to success.

**How we’ll measure success**


* **LTS Execution:** Our business lines are successfully hitting the milestones set out in their long\-term AI strategy plans.
* **Operational Speed:** We have reduced the time it takes to get from an idea to a working, value\-driving solution.
* **Risk \& Quality:** Our AI initiatives consistently meet our internal standards for security and responsibility, with minimal friction.
* **Business Impact:** Every AI project we support can clearly demonstrate its contribution to ELEC’s business performance.

**Skills \& Academic Requirements**


To lead this transformation effectively, you will need a blend of technical understanding, operational discipline, and the ability to influence people.


* **Academic \& Professional Background:**
	+ **Degree:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
	+ **Experience:** Strong and proven leadership experience in operations, program management, or technical strategy, ideally within a large, global matrixed organization.
	+ **AI/Technical Fluency:** A solid grasp of the AI/ML landscape—not necessarily as a developer, but as a leader who understands the lifecycle of AI solutions, from data preparation to production and monitoring.
* **Core Competencies:**
	+ **Strategic Change Management:** Proven success in leading large\-scale organizational shifts, including the ability to build and sustain engagement across diverse teams.
	+ **Operational Discipline:** Exceptional ability to build, manage, and refine the "cadence" of a business—tracking metrics, managing budgets, and maintaining project momentum.
	+ **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Demonstrated expertise in bridging the gap between technical teams (CTO/Engineering) and business stakeholders. You know how to translate technical requirements into business value and vice\-versa.
	+ **Learning \& Development Agility:** A strong track record of partnering with HR and Learning \& Development functions to design curriculum or enablement programs. You understand that "upskilling" is not just about classroom training, but about driving behavioral change.
	+ **Influencing \& Negotiation:** The ability to achieve alignment across different business lines without having direct line authority over every team member. You lead through persuasion, shared goals, and the value you provide.
	+ **Risk \& Governance Mindset:** A pragmatic approach to compliance and ethics. You can integrate guardrails into the development process so that they feel like an asset rather than an obstacle.

==========================

title: Principal Product Designer
description:
We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI\-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!

**Your opportunity**

  


As a Principal Product Designer on the UX Platform team, you will be the most senior individual design voice across the breadth of the UX Platform: the products our engineers and customers rely on every day, and the Design System that ties them together. You will partner closely with our Design Director as a trusted right hand, owning the hardest and most ambiguous problems, setting the quality bar, and helping decisions move so design is never the bottleneck.



Two things sit at the center of this role: designing for AI\-native experiences, and rethinking how design itself gets done in AI\-first workflows. We are fully immersed in both, and this role has a real hand in shaping where they go. We want someone genuinely eager to learn, test, and experiment here, but with the judgment to tell where AI raises the quality of the work and where it just adds noise. The aim is to use AI where it genuinely makes the work better, not to adopt it for its own sake.



You are a pragmatic optimist: ambitious about where we could go, honest about the terrain in front of us. You can hold “this is hard and might not work” and “let’s do it anyway, here’s how” in the same breath. You lead through craft and influence rather than authority, you take a vague problem and give it shape, you bring strong opinions but invite better ones, and you raise risks early and honestly. You lift the people around you by example, and the whole team’s work gets sharper because you are on it.

  


**What you'll do**

  

* Own the most complex and ambiguous design problems across our platform scope, from framing through detailed craft, end to end and with no oversight required.
* Design for AI\-native experiences: shape interfaces that are non\-deterministic and adapt to each use, design for outputs we cannot fully predict, and set the design principles and heuristics that keep those experiences coherent.
* Evolve how we design in AI\-first, spec\-driven workflows: help define how our role shifts, act as a multiplier for the team, and build ways to evaluate that we are shipping higher quality software, not just more of it.
* Set the bar for documentation and traceability: clear specs, references, and rationale that the team, our partners, and our AI tools can build on.
* Act as a second senior point of design judgment and a subject matter expert on our product: deputize for the Design Director in Product and Engineering reviews, shape strategic direction, and hold the quality bar across the whole product, not only your own area.
* Strengthen the connection between product design and the Design System, and define systems and processes that others across the company can benefit from.
* Partner with Product and Engineering to align on direction and keep work moving at a healthy cadence.
* Mentor designers, lead by example, and raise the overall level of craft across the team.


**This role requires**

  

* Extensive product design experience, including senior or lead work on complex software products.
* A portfolio that shows depth of craft and systems thinking across both product design and design systems, and recognized mastery of craft: a track record of raising the collective quality bar and defining patterns, systems, or processes that others adopt.
* A track record of owning ambiguous problems independently and driving them to real outcomes, end to end and without oversight.
* Comfort designing for AI\-native, non\-deterministic experiences, and enthusiasm for evolving how design gets done in AI\-first workflows.
* A discerning approach to AI: eager to experiment, but with the judgment to tell where it adds real value, and a quality bar that does not bend for the sake of hype.
* Ability to act as a subject matter expert who shapes priorities, leads research where useful, and interprets analysis into design decisions.
* Proven ability to influence Product and Engineering partners without formal authority.
* Excellent written and verbal communication in English, and a habit of documenting decisions, rationale, and references clearly so that people and tools can build on them.


**Bonus points if you have**


* Experience designing services and platforms, especially in observability, developer tools, data, or complex B2B products.
* A technical background: an understanding of modern software architecture, and experience with data visualization.
* Experience contributing to or stewarding a design system at scale.
* Hands\-on experience with spec\-driven or AI\-assisted design workflows.
* Comfort working in a distributed, cross\-cultural team.


Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

title: Principal, Renewal Operations & Strategy
description:
**Company Description**  

Nexthink is the leader in digital employee experience management software. The company provides IT leaders with unprecedented insight allowing them to see, diagnose and fix issues at scale impacting employees anywhere, with any application or network, before employees notice the issue. As the first solution to allow IT to progress from reactive problem solving to proactive optimization, Nexthink enables its more than 1,200 customers to provide better digital experiences to more than 15 million employees. Dual headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland and Boston, Massachusetts, Nexthink has 9 offices worldwide.


\#LI\-Hybrid

 **Job Description**  

We're looking for a **Principal, Renewal Operations \& Strategy** — a senior individual contributor who will own the health, performance, and integrity of our entire renewal portfolio. This is not a people\-management role; it's a high\-impact expert track position for someone who wants to shape how a fast\-growing B2B SaaS company renews, retains, and grows its customer base at scale.


You'll sit at the intersection of **Analytics, Governance \& Policy, and Sales Process** — the person every team turns to when they need to understand what's happening across renewals, why it's happening, and what to do about it. You won't just report on the portfolio; you'll define the rules, systems, and playbooks that make it run well.

**What You'll Own**

**Renewals Analytics**

* Build and maintain the single source of truth for renewal performance: gross/net retention, churn, downgrade, price increase, and expansion metrics across segments.
* Design forecasting, cohort models and early\-warning indicators to flag at\-risk accounts before they become losses.
* Partner with BI/Data teams to build self\-serve dashboards for CS, Sales, and Finance leadership.
* Translate portfolio data into a clear narrative for exec and board\-level reporting

**️ Governance \& Policy**

* Own and evolve the renewal policy framework — pricing floors, discount guardrails, auto\-renewal terms, contract exception handling
* Establish approval workflows and controls to ensure renewal deals are compliant, consistent, and auditable
* Act as the escalation point for non\-standard renewal terms, balancing commercial flexibility with policy discipline
* Partner with Legal and Finance to keep renewal policy aligned with contractual and revenue\-recognition requirements
* **️ Sales Process**
* Design and continuously improve the end\-to\-end renewal motion — from renewal notice through quote, negotiation, and close
* Define playbooks, stage gates, and SLAs for the renewals sales process inside the CRM
* Identify friction points in the renewal funnel and drive process or tooling fixes (Salesforce, CPQ, renewal automation platforms)
* Enable and train renewal managers/AEs on process changes, new tools, and policy updates

**What Success Looks Like**

* Renewal leadership can answer any portfolio question — retention, risk, pipeline — within minutes, not days
* Renewal policy is documented, consistently applied, and requires minimal ad\-hoc exception handling
* The renewal sales process is measurably faster and more predictable quarter over quarter
* You are the trusted, go\-to authority on "how renewals work here" across Sales, CS, Finance, and Legal

  

**Qualifications** **What You Bring**

* 7\+ years in Revenue Operations, Renewals, Sales Operations, or Deal Desk within B2B SaaS
* Proven experience owning renewal/retention analytics — comfortable building models, not just reading dashboards
* Hands\-on experience designing or governing commercial policy (pricing, discounting, contract terms)
* Deep fluency in CRM and renewal tooling (Salesforce required; CPQ or renewal automation platforms a strong plus)
* A track record of designing sales processes that people actually adopt
* Excellent judgment for balancing policy rigor with commercial pragmatism
* Strong executive communication skills — you can brief a CRO as easily as you can debug a workflow with an AE

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with SQL or BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI)
* Background in Deal Desk or contract compliance
* Experience scaling renewal processes through hypergrowth (Series C\+ or post\-IPO)

**Why Join Us**

* **Impact without the overhead** — shape strategy and policy at a senior level without managing headcount
* **Cross\-functional visibility** — direct exposure to Sales, CS, Finance, Legal, and executive leadership
* **Build, don't just maintain** — this role is being created to bring order and rigor to a growing renewal motion; you'll define how it works

  

**Additional Information**  

We are the pioneers and trailblazers of a global IT Market Category (DEX) that is shaping the future of how the world works, giving our customers’ IT Teams total digital visibility across their enterprise. Our innovative solutions integrate real\-time analytics, automation, and employee feedback across all endpoints. This enables our IT teams to solve complex technical challenges, create ever more productive workplaces, and deliver happy, satisfied employees in the digital workplace.


With over 1000 employees across 5 continents, Nexthink operates as One Team, connecting, collaborating and innovating to continuously grow. We call our employees ‘Nexthinkers’ and our commitment to diversity, inclusion, and equity is second to none. We currently have over 75 nationalities working with us, from all cultures and backgrounds, speaking many different languages.


If you are looking for a change and like a nice atmosphere, lots of challenges, and having fun while working, this is a great opportunity for you! Check what we offer:

title: People Partner - Europe
description:
**Company Description**  

At EVERSANA®, we are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work across the globe. We’re fueled by our vision to create a healthier world. How? Our global team of more than 7,000 employees is committed to creating and delivering next\-generation commercialization services to the life sciences industry. We are grounded in our cultural beliefs and serve more than 670 clients ranging from innovative biotech start\-ups to established pharmaceutical companies. Our products, services and solutions help bring innovative therapies to market and support the patients who depend on them. Our jobs, skills and talents are unique, but together we make an impact every day. Join us!

  

Across our growing organization, we embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. We are deliberate and self\-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building. We look for team members that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but also who care deeply about EVERSANA, our people, clients and most importantly, the patients we serve. We are EVERSANA.

 **Job Description** **THE POSITION****:**

The People Partner – Europe reports to the Senior People Director – Europe and works closely with both European and global HR teams, as well as cross\-functional partners such as Finance, Payroll, and Legal. The role also collaborates, where relevant, with external HR partners and service providers, supporting the HR needs of managers and employees across the allocated region.


This role is a key contributor to the success of our growth and operations in the region, ensuring the delivery of high\-quality HR support across the full employee lifecycle. This includes implementing, reinforcing, and evaluating legally compliant HR policies, procedures, and best practices, as well as fostering a positive and productive work environment that supports employee well\-being, engagement, and development.


The ideal candidate is an experienced HR professional who is able to combine strategic thinking with hands\-on, operational approach, gets energized by working in global and dynamic organizations, likes driving HR initiatives and process improvements, acts a trusted partner to the business and is solution oriented, team player and has a positive mindset.


To be considered for this role, candidates must be based in Ireland or Spain (home office), and have solid HR track record in more than 1 country in Europe:

* France is mandatory required
* Previous HR experience in any of these countries would be highly appreciated: UK, Ireland, Germany, Switzerland, Italy, France, Spain, Portugal, Poland, Finland.

Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by:

* Support international mobility and relocation processes.
* Guide stakeholders through sensitive conversations and transitions.
* Lead or support initiatives in training, diversity, inclusion, and engagement.
* Act as an ambassador for company culture and support internal communication.
* Demonstrate commitment to DE\&I through inclusive behaviors and proactive bias management.
* Demonstrate a commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through continuous development, modeling inclusive behaviors, and proactively managing bias.
* All other duties as assigned

  



**EXPECTATIONS OF THE JOB:**

* **Travel** Normally this position will not require travel, but this requirement may vary
* **Hours** full\-time, normal working hours, from Monday to Friday

  

**Qualifications** **REQUIREMENTS:**

The requirements listed below are representative of the experience, education, knowledge, skill and/or abilities required.

* Minimum of 5 \-10 years of previous HR operations experience, out of which 3\-5 years within an international environment (**previous HR experience in France is a must**)
* Proven working experience of employment\-related laws and regulations in more than one European country: France is mandatory, any of these countries would be highly appreciated: UK, Ireland, Germany, Switzerland, Italy, Spain, Portugal, Poland, Finland.
* **Fluent in English and French**, any other European language will be a plus
* Keen attention to detail, experience in organizing and leading projects with many different data sources
* Experience working in a fast\-paced environment
* Pragmatic, hands\-on attitude, solution oriented
* Flexible, adaptable, comfortable in dealing with change and competing priorities
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Excellent interpersonal, negotiation and conflict resolution skills
* Excellent time management skills with a proven ability to meet deadlines
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, data\-driven mentality
* Ability to act with integrity, professionalism, and confidentiality

 **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

**Additional Information** **Patient Minded**I act with the patient’s best interest in mind.

title: Associate Applied (AI) Value Engineer (Benelux) - Orbit Program
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

**Location: Madrid for an onboarding period of 2 years and a possible relocation to Amsterdam after. Customer base will be in the Benelux region, involving travel to meet clients in person.**

  

### **Role Description**



As an Applied (AI) Value Engineer you are pushing the envelope in solving business\-critical problems for our customers. You are part of our Value Engineering team and are the trusted advisor for customers working on the intersection of technology and business. You will be working with our most strategic customers, understanding their objectives and key challenges, and building Celonis solutions using the world's leading Process Intelligence (PI) platform in combination with the largest AI and ML technology partners, such as Microsoft, OpenAI and Databricks. With Celonis' Process Intelligence (PI) platform we feed operational context to AI so it understands our customers' business and enables them to industrialize AI unlocking real ROI on AI deployments and at scale. There is no AI without PI. You will prototype these solutions, demonstrate their value to Executives and ensure successful implementation, adoption and value realization in order to increase the footprint of Celonis at those customers.


### **Launch Your Enterprise Software Career \- Orbit Graduate program**



Kickstart your career in enterprise software through our immersive 12\-month Orbit Program.



During the Orbit Graduate program, you will be joining the Global VE Center of Excellence which is an international, diverse, and dynamic organization at the core of the Celonis Value Engineering team supporting our local field teams. As a team, we enjoy working in a fast\-paced environment and share a sense of belonging to an international community that wants to learn and grow together. The team culture is one based on building trust, continuous development, and improvement through coaching \& mentoring.



This program offers a unique blend of client engagements, dedicated mentorship, and a strong team culture where collaboration and shared success are paramount. You'll leverage your technical background to develop essential skills, build lasting client relationships, and establish yourself as a trusted advisor, paving the way for significant career growth within Celonis.



Your journey begins with comprehensive onboarding and enablement, followed by hands\-on experience in customer engagements and targeted training. You will gain expertise in:

* Building and coding within the Celonis platform (SQL, PQL and Python)
* Scoping business and technical requirements
* Effectively handling objections
* Developing industry domain knowledge
* Delivering impactful presentations and demos
* Understanding value selling and realization
* Managing customer accounts

### **What You'll Do:**

* **Hackathons \& Prototyping:** Think out of the box, have a "can\-do" attitude and don't shy away from complex problems. Leverage cutting edge AI technologies to rapidly build creative prototypes in customer hackathons solving business critical problems
* **Agentic Process Transformation:** Support our customers in achieving real ROI out of AI deployments at scale enabling a fundamental shift in business operations from traditional, rule\-based automation to the use of autonomous AI agents empowered by our Celonis Process Intelligence Platform
* **Proof Projects:** End\-to\-end execution of business\-critical Proof\-of\-Value projects showcasing the value of Celonis Process Intelligence tailored to customers and align our solutions with their AI strategy.

### **What You Need:**

**Bonus Points:**
