You will have two primary responsibilities:
  

(1\) Your primary role will be to oversee the daily research being conducted in IESE’s Behavioral Lab, including scheduling and running of online or in\-lab studies. developing and maintaining the participant pool, programming surveys and experiments, completing Internal Review Board (IRB) submissions, etc.


(2\) Work with faculty and PhD students from different departments within IESE Business School to conduct a diverse set of research studies. The research being conducted spans many topics, including decision\-making, behavioral economics and finance, consumer and organizational behavior. You will be trained on the latest integration of AI in research methods and be expected to support faculty research using AI.

  

You will report to the Academic Lab Director and the Research Centers and Activities Director.

**Responsibilities**

* Schedule and supervise the running of online and in\-lab studies.
* Manage online survey panel deployment for researchers.
* Create and maintain a pool for lab\-based and online studies (posting and approving studies, recruiting participants, …)
* Assist researchers with experiment design, data collection, and analysis
* Submit and approve participants payment requests
* Facilitate and coordinate the day\-to\-day operations
* Provide support to participants and researchers
* Provide support in other activities of professors (related to experiments)
* Engage with AI agents to support academic research

**Requirements**

* Work\-permit in Spain
* Undergraduate or post\-graduate degree in psychology, psychological research or related fields, such as consumer behavior, organizational behavior, statistics, economics, or other scientific methodology
* Experience designing experimental behavioral research studies
* Very good organization and attention to detail
* Excellent social and communication skills
* Working knowledge of AI platforms like ChatGPT/Codex and Anthropic/Claude
* Full fluency in English at a native level or equivalent. Excellent English writing skills.

**Conditions**

**Full\-time** position


1830 euros / months before tax

**Start date**


ASAP

**End date**


1 year with the possibility of extending.

title: Manager Value Creation
description:
**Company Description**  

Syntegon Telstar S.R.U is a company belonging to the Syntegon Group, which operates worldwide with 7,300 colleagues at 49 locations in over 20 countries. As a brand specialising in the development of GMP consulting, engineering, construction and integrated process equipment projects, we serve companies linked to the life sciences market (pharmaceutical and biotechnology, healthcare, cosmetics, veterinary and food industries), as well as hospitals, laboratories and research centres. We also offer solutions using vacuum and high vacuum technologies for traditional and high\-tech industries in the energy and aerospace sectors, as well as scientific experimentation.

 **Job Description**  

As Manager (m/f/d) Value Creation in our Pharma Liquid (PHL) business unit, you play an active role in the company's success by realizing our value creation plan in close collaboration with the business unit leadership and the Executive Committee (ExCo). Unlike traditional advisory roles, you will own the execution and see the tangible impact of your work, from strategy design to on\-the\-ground implementation across our global sites.

* You are responsible for the execution of selected strategic initiatives, partner directly with our global production sites, and translate strategy into action while diving into the entire value chain of our business.
* You support the Director Value Creation \& Strategy PHL and the leadership team of the Pharma Liquid business unit in executing a portfolio of strategic initiatives and in continuously improving our strategy execution framework.
* You contribute to the strategic steering of our business unit PHL by preparing leadership offsites and ensuring the execution of follow\-up actions across our entities.
* In addition, you work closely with the Director Value Creation \& Strategy PHL in managing additional projects commissioned by the ExCo and in handling requests from the private equity investor.

  

**Qualifications**  

* You hold a degree in business administration, finance, or a related field.
* You bring more than 3 years of relevant professional experience, ideally gained at a top\-tier strategy consultancy, in transaction services/M\&A, or in corporate development within a PE\-backed environment.
* You are characterized by strategic thinking, reliability, assertiveness, and the ability to work under pressure
* Thanks to your excellent communication skills and intercultural competence, you can engage effectively with diverse global stakeholders.
* Strong problem\-solving and conflict\-resolution skills, along with a pragmatic approach, complete your profile.
* Fluent English is required; German language skills are a plus.
* Willingness to travel internationally (approx. 10–20%) is required

  

**Additional Information**  

For Syntegon and its subsidiaries, diversity is a key concern. We explicitly welcome an environment where all employees, regardless of gender, age, origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or special needs, are treated equally. If this job posting uses only the male form, it is for readability purposes and refers to individuals of all genders.

title: Account Executive
description:
#### **About this role**

**About us**


Plenit is a European cloud and IT Operating Platform that helps IT companies (resellers, MSPs, and IT distributors) become fully\-fledged cloud providers. Founded in 2020 (originally as Jotelulu), Plenit brings together Sovereign Cloud services (Servers, Remote Desktop, File \& Object Storage, Disaster Recovery), IT Management, a software Marketplace, and Go\-To\-Market enablement tools — all in one platform. Plenit is a member of CISPE and operates data centers across Europe, serving thousands of IT partners across more than eight countries in Europe and the Americas.


We're looking for a results\-driven **Account Executive** to own the full sales cycle for mid\-to\-large IT companies looking to build and grow their own cloud business on top of Plenit.

 **The challenge**


As an Account Executive, you will drive new business growth by identifying, engaging, and closing strategic IT partners resellers, MSPs, and IT distributors who want to launch or expand a cloud offering under their own brand. You'll own your pipeline end\-to\-end, from qualified opportunity through negotiation and close, working closely with Presales, Marketing, and Partner Success to build long\-term, high\-value partnerships.


This role carries a revenue quota and is central to Plenit's growth across its core European markets.

 **Key Responsibilities**

* Own and manage a portfolio of mid\-market and enterprise IT company prospects, building a healthy and predictable sales pipeline
* Run consultative, solution\-based sales cycles: discovery, business case building, proposal, negotiation, and close
* Partner with Presales to design tailored solutions (Sovereign Cloud, IT Management, Marketplace) that fit each prospect's business model and client base
* Develop and execute account/territory plans to hit and exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets
* Negotiate commercial terms, pricing structures, and contracts with prospective partners
* Build relationships with key decision\-makers (owners, technical directors, commercial directors) at target IT companies
* Collaborate with Marketing on outbound campaigns, events, and account\-based marketing initiatives to fill pipeline
* Accurately forecast revenue and maintain up\-to\-date opportunity data in the CRM
* Ensure a smooth handover to Partner Success/Onboarding post\-close, staying engaged to support early\-stage partner growth and expansion/upsell opportunities
* Represent Plenit at industry events, webinars, and partner meetings as needed
* Stay current on the competitive landscape, cloud/IT channel trends, and Plenit's evolving product roadmap

 **What We're Looking For**

**Required:**

* 3–5\+ years of experience as an Account Executive or full\-cycle sales role in B2B tech, SaaS, cloud, or the IT channel
* Proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding sales quotas
* Strong consultative selling skills, with experience running complex, multi\-stakeholder sales cycles
* Comfortable negotiating commercial terms and closing mid\-to\-large deals
* Experience using CRM tools (HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar) for pipeline management and forecasting
* Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship\-building skills
* Fluent in \[Spanish/English/Portuguese/French adjust based on target market]; additional European languages a plus

**Nice to have:**

* Experience selling to IT resellers, MSPs, distributors, or system integrators
* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure concepts (IaaS, virtual servers, storage, disaster recovery, VDI)
* Background in channel/partner sales models

#### **About us**


Plenit (formerly Jotelulu) is the Operating Platform for IT Service Providers. We help MSPs, ISVs, VARs, and IT resellers run, scale, and grow their businesses on top of our own sovereign infrastructure, with footprint across Europe and the Americas.  

  

We are a European cloud platform with a clear conviction: digital sovereignty matters, and the IT channel deserves a partner that speaks their language, builds for their reality, and stays close to the ground. We are not enterprise\-y. We are simple, pragmatic, and obsessed with our partners’ success.  

  

Five years in, we are 130 people, four countries, and growing fast — which is exactly why we are bringing this role on now.  

  

We’re passionate about technology, but we’re also a bit geeky—we love Star Wars, video games, 90s movies, and pop culture. We work hard and with passion, but we also have a great time together. At Plenit, you’ll find a balance between work and fun, where teammates often become friends, and boredom is rare—there’s always something new, unexpected, and memorable happening.

 **What Plenit offers**  

  

At Plenit, we offer a place where you can do great work, keep growing, contribute to something meaningful, and be part of shaping the project. We trust our people, give them the space to take ownership, and believe that working as one team and creating a great working environment make all the difference.

  

Here’s what you can expect when you join us:

 **Flexibility that works**  

We believe people do their best when work can adapt to their lives. That’s why we offer flexible working hours and different ways of working, including remote and hybrid options depending on your role and team.

 **More moments to enjoy**  

Some days are simply meant to be enjoyed. In addition to your annual leave, we offer extra company days off throughout the year, giving you more time to rest, recharge, and make the most of those moments.

 **Your health, covered**  

Taking care of our people is part of how we do things. That’s why Plenit provides private health insurance, fully paid for by the company.

 **Keep growing**  

We want Plenit to be a place where you can keep learning, take on new challenges, and continue growing professionally. You’ll have opportunities to develop within the company and keep building on your skills and experience.


You’ll also receive an annual learning budget that you can use for training, courses, certifications, and other resources that support your professional development.

 **A great place to connect**  

Our Madrid office is located in the heart of the city and offers a welcoming, collaborative, and energetic environment where you can work, share, and spend time with the team. You’ll also find great coffee and fresh fruit.

 **A culture built on trust**  

We believe in doing things well, taking ownership, supporting one another, and enjoying what we build. We value open and honest communication, different perspectives, and working together to keep moving forward. Our culture isn’t just something we talk about; you’ll experience it every day in how we collaborate, contribute, and make things happen.

title: PRMS Architectural Redesign Blueprint Consultancy
description:
**Contracting unit:** \- Office of the Chief Scientist, CGIAR System Organisation


**Budget Ceiling: \-** USD 30,000 (all\-inclusive; competitive open call)

**Duration: \-** 6–8 weeks

**2027 milestone: \-** Blueprint endorsed; build procurement decision made

**Delivery lead: \-** Portfolio Performance and Results Team (PPT)

**Oversight: \-** Steering Group (Office of the Chief Scientist, DTA, Digital)

**Deadline for Applications: \-** 8 September 2026, 23:59hrs (Paris time GMT\+2\)




**Background**


The Performance \& Results Management System (PRMS) is CGIAR's core infrastructure for portfolio planning, results reporting, quality assurance, adaptive management, risk management and accountability. It was identified in the CGIAR Performance and Results Management Framework as a common system housing planning, theory of change management, stage\-gate decision points, and annual reporting — with linked datasets, an integrated dashboard for funders and management, and access aligned to international standards. A February 2021 Accenture fit\-for\-purpose assessment translated this into implementation requirements: integrated business applications, standardized data definitions across CGIAR systems, and comprehensive onboarding of end users. CGIAR invested approximately USD 800k per year to build and run that system during the period 2022\-25, with joint Independent Advisory and Internal Audit review during rollout to ensure delivery against specification.


The PRMS was built for a context of relatively stable institutional requirements: a defined set of manual inputs, largely from Window 1/2 funding, processed sequentially — each stage waiting for the previous — to produce a predetermined set of outputs on a predictable cycle. Bespoke requests that fell outside those predetermined outputs required specialists to extract value case by case. That design was rational for the conditions in which it was built. Five shifts prompt a redesign.


The first is the nature of demand. The portfolio now requires dynamic, on\-demand, user\-defined outputs — some anticipated, many not. New business requirements arrive at unpredictable intervals: a GST decision requiring real\-time performance data for resource allocation, a donor wanting a bespoke cut across Programs, an AI tool needing to interrogate the data layer directly. A system with predetermined outputs cannot serve this.


The second is the scope of what the system must hold. Window 3/bilateral funding — around 1000 non\-pooled projects — is heterogeneous in structure, language, and reporting logic. W3/bilateral data cannot be pre\-programmed into the system; it is a different problem type, and the current architecture has no way to accommodate it.


The third is the ability to orchestrate. CGIAR now deploys operational AI tools — for example SNAP, the zero\-draft generator, the QA helper, the Progress Tracking Solution — that need to query, submit to, and coordinate across the system. The current PRMS is not orchestrable: its components are not designed to be called, sequenced, or managed by an AI agent. A system that AI can understand and act on any layer is a key requirement.


The fourth is the multiplicity of data sources the system must draw on. Portfolio evidence already sits across many instruments and repositories — among them legacy CRP and Initiative results, current Program and Accelerator results, Plans of Results and Budget (PoRB), Projected Benefits, the Impact Compendium, CGSpace, AnaPlan and others — each with its own structure and logic, with limited interconnections.


The fifth is the technological revolution in data management. The maturing of AI and large language models has changed what is possible: data no longer has to be captured through fixed forms and rigid fields to be usable, and outputs no longer have to be predetermined and assembled by hand. This reframes the redesign itself — not a faster version of the old model, but a shift to more flexible, AI\-native handling of data that cuts duplication, lowers effort, and can generate higher\-quality outputs on demand while maintaining core security safeguards.


The new PRMS must be modular, reconfigurable, and interoperable by design — not simply cheaper to build, but cheaper to run and extend, with a clear view of the trade\-off between reduced human effort and the real costs of AI\-driven processing at scale.


Two developments in 2026 show what this looks like in practice. The CGIAR Progress Tracking Solution — launched in July 2026 — demonstrates a possible target architecture: AI\-assisted, modular, with a human validation layer, open enough for users to connect their own systems via API. The June 2026 GST\-endorsed Guidance Note on Program/Accelerator\-level prioritization establishes that actual performance against theories of change will directly inform W1/W2 fund allocation from 2026 onward: PRMS data must be queryable in real time to feed consequential resource allocation decisions, not compiled into static reports after the fact. Together, they define what fit for purpose now requires.


Purpose
This commission produces an architectural blueprint for a rebuilt PRMS — the design basis for a subsequent build investment. It is not a developer\-ready technical specification. It is the front end of a two\-stage process: design now, procure and build against it. Steering Group endorsement of this blueprint will be the decision gate for the larger investment.


The starting point is not the technology but the people the system serves — funders, senior leadership and governing bodies, Program and Accelerator directors, Centers, and external partners — and the outputs they need, from stabilized reports and dashboards to on\-demand answers tailored to a specific question. The design works back from those needs to the data the system already holds, and it must make the system materially lighter to feed — less manual entry, less duplication, less double reporting — not only cheaper to run.


The design target is a system that is orchestrable: modular, reconfigurable, and interoperable, built so that AI agents can understand and operate across any layer — or so that any process can run without AI, depending on the risk appetite and the requirement. A result linked to a causal pathway is the atomic unit; everything else is an expression of it. Report once, use many times. The system must function as a data layer that CGIAR tools and authorised external actors can query, contribute to, and act on — not a system that only produces predetermined outputs for predetermined audiences.


The blueprint must address constraints: that replacing human effort with AI\-driven processing shifts cost rather than eliminates it, and that AI operating costs at scale must be designed for; and that Center and Program adoption has been suboptimal, and the design must address why. Both are in scope. The blueprint must be specific enough to brief the Performance and Results Management Steering Group, scope a build procurement, and hold a development team accountable.


Objectives* Map the demand the system must serve. Identify the priority users and uses — internal and external — and the outputs each needs, from those already mandated by CGIAR governance to the on\-demand, tailored outputs that AI now makes possible. Distinguish what the system already delivers well from what users cannot currently obtain.
* Take stock of the foundational building blocks the portfolio already runs on — for example the Theory of Change, the Projected Benefits model, the Results Framework and its 3 indicator tiers, PoRB/PoD planning instruments — and assess their fitness as the base for a redesigned system rather than starting from a blank slate.
* Characterize the data supply and its fragmentation — what is entered by hand versus captured automatically, and what lives across CGIAR, donor, and Center systems — and consider the growing overlap between monitoring data and science or project data under FAIR. Set out what this implies for a system that draws on existing sources rather than re\-collecting data during each reporting cycle.
* Define the connecting layer between demand and supply — the core of this commission. At the level of principle and direction, set out how a result linked to a causal pathway becomes the atomic unit that is reported once and reused many times; how the layer is made FAIR, API\-first, and orchestrable so that CGIAR tools and authorised external actors — including AI agents — can query and contribute to it; and how heterogeneous W3/bilateral data is accommodated without being forced into a W1/W2 mold.
* Show how the redesign lightens the load — and where it does not. Explain how it may reduce fields, duplication, and double reporting and shift effort from manual data entry toward data interoperability, while being honest about the trade\-offs, including AI operating costs at scale and the points where human judgment must remain.
* Set out the direction of travel and a phased path — what is foundational and should be settled now versus what can be resolved at the build stage, including a costed view of the interim 2027 release and the fuller rebuild. As part of this, diagnose at a strategic level why Centers and Programs have historically, to different extents, routed around PRMS, and what the new system must do differently to earn adoption.


Scope and Constraints
This is a conceptual design commission. The consultant produces the architectural blueprint and roadmap, with the Performance and Results Management Steering Group providing oversight and independent challenge. While security, access controls, audit trails and availability are core aspects of the future system, detailed technical specification — schema definitions, API contracts, and migration mechanics — is deliberately out of scope at this stage: the blueprint establishes direction and principle, and the build phase resolves the detail.


Ready by 2027 means: blueprint endorsed by the Steering Group and a build procurement decision made — not full system deployment. Specific PRMS capabilities needed for the 2027 reporting cycle will be identified in the roadmap and may be delivered as an interim release against the existing system while the rebuild proceeds. The costed build roadmap must give PPT and Centers a concrete transition path for modules currently under active management — including the Planning Module and POD — specifying which planned enhancements should continue during the review period and where enhancement work should pause pending the interim 2027 release, so teams are not left to decide this unilaterally while the review is underway.


W3/bilateral data integration — where permitted by Centers — is within scope. It is a distinct architectural problem that the blueprint must address — not a future phase or an edge case. The heterogeneity of non\-pooled project data, the challenge of connecting it to the CGIAR results hierarchy, and the implications for Center\-level data ownership and access are design questions the consultant must answer.


Center and Program adoption is a governance and change management challenge, not an architectural one. The blueprint will diagnose it and specify design requirements that reduce friction, but the Steering Group — not the consultant — must own the adoption strategy.


Given that PPT leads both delivery and the Steering Group secretariat, the blueprint will be subject to independent technical review by at least two Steering Group members with relevant technical expertise before endorsement. This is a process requirement, not optional.


Deliverables* Architectural blueprint.
* Costed build roadmap.
* Performance and Results Management Steering Group briefing deck.


Methodology* Review of PRMS technical documentation, AI tool dependency evidence, MELIAF Interoperability Framework, March 2026 operational incident record, enhancement request history, and existing API documentation and agent integration work produced by the PRMS infrastructure team.
* Interviews with PRMS infrastructure team, PPT AI tool developers, MELIAF workstream leads, Center MEL leads, and Center representatives who have actively worked around PRMS. The interview set must include demand\-side users, not only the supply side.
* Co\-design sessions with PPT to validate architecture decisions.
* Independent technical review of draft blueprint before finalisation — reviewers nominated by the Performance and Results Management Steering Group.


Timeline
Duration: 6–8 weeks

* Weeks 1–2: Document review, interviews, co\-design sessions
* Weeks 3–5: Blueprint drafting
* Week 6: PPT review and iteration
* Weeks 7–8: Independent technical review, revisions, Steering Group briefing

  

**Requirements**  

  

Required Expertise* Senior\-level expertise in data architecture and API design for complex, federated data environments — including experience designing for AI orchestration and agentic access patterns.
* Advanced understanding of AI/ML pipeline requirements — practical understanding of what LLM\-based and agentic tools require from upstream data infrastructure, including cost modelling at scale.
* Deep experience in MEL and risk\-informed systems in international development — results frameworks, theory of change, indicator management, and bilateral reporting structures.
* Proven ability to advise on organizational change and adoption in federated, multi\-stakeholder settings.
* Track record producing architectural blueprints that non\-technical leadership can act on and developers can build against.
* Strong capacity to translate user, governance, and reporting needs into system and data requirements — a service\-design sensibility that starts from what users must be able to answer.
* Experience with CGIAR, multilateral research organisations, or comparable federated institutional environments is an advantage.

**Required application documents**

* A **technical proposal**, including:
* Updated CVs and a cover letter explaining how the consultant’s qualifications and experience meet the requirements of the assignment;
* A short approach to the work, maximum 2–4 pages, outlining how the consultant proposes to address the objectives and deliverables in these TORs, with reference to comparable assignments that demonstrate the required expertise.
* A **financial proposal in USD**, quoted as a lump sum and supported by a cost breakdown by level of effort per deliverable. Combine both technical and financial proposal in one document.

**Evaluation and communication**


CGIAR places strong emphasis on ensuring that the objectives of the PRMS Architectural Redesign Blueprint are met. Proposals will be assessed on technical merit and value for money. Only pre\-selected candidates will be contacted.


Annex 1: CGIAR Performance and Results Management Framework’s definition of the**Performance and Results Management System (December 2020\)**


Building on investments made in the current phase of CGIAR research programming, a comprehensive, mature and accessible Performance \& Results Management System (PRMS) that encompasses planning, monitoring, and reporting will provide robust information upon which to take informed decisions. It will provide:

* Practical services aligned to meet learning, accountability and resource mobilization objectives,
* Dashboards open to Funders and partners, with access to the full set of underlying quality\-checked data, including communications\-focused products capturing collated evidence of CGIAR contribution to change (e.g. outcome/impact case reports).
* Alignment with international standards such as IATI (International Aid Transparency Initiative).


Key PRMS features
The CGIAR PRMS will feature:

* A common system housing plan of work and budget, theory of change management, stage\-gate decision points, and annual reporting processes. It will allow real\-time data collection and day\-to\-day portfolio and Initiative management.
* Key data sets (results, plan of work and budget, grant, finance, stage\-gate specific e.g. Scaling Readiness) will be increasingly linked, for example through CLARISA: CGIAR Level Agricultural Results Interoperable System Architecture, a web service that harmonizes data from across the CGIAR).
* Interface and exchange with big data and partner data sets (e.g. WIPO Green and the International Treaty on Plant Genetic Resources for Food and Agriculture) will increase. CGIAR will publish relevant data through IATI. CGIAR Performance and Results Management Framework 2022\-2030 CGIAR System Organization Page 16 of 20
* CGIAR’s digital knowledge base will make better use of linked data through Knowledge Graphs, and


will use the SDG Interface Ontology to better link its contribution to impact with that of partners.

* An integrated dashboard will draw from relevant data sets to provide transparent data and insights on


CGIAR geographic and thematic presence, contribution to change, spend and partner network.


Users
Target users of the PRMS include CGIAR staff for day\-to\-day Initiative management and reporting, portfolio management and resource mobilization, and Funders and partners to access evidence of CGIAR thematic and geographic presence and progress against stated objectives such as the SDGs.


Security, hosting, maintenance and support
The PRMS will incorporate:

* Secured infrastructure,
* Cloud hosting,
* CGIAR Active Directory integration for user provisioning and account management,
* Access control through Multi\-Factor Authentication,
* Single Sign On,
* Tiered support and maintenance approach aligned with CGIAR’s IT support model.

 **Benefits**  

All applications must be submitted online by clicking the 'Apply' button below before **11:59 PM CET on 08 September 2026**.


If you require assistance or face challenges in submitting your application, please email smo\-bidding@cgiar.org with the position title in the subject line. **Applications submitted through smo\-bidding@cgiar.org will NOT be accepted.**


Please ensure your resume and cover letter are in English and does not contain your marital status, age, or photograph. **Documents provided in a language other than English will not be considered.**

CGIAR is committed to fair, safe, and inclusive workplaces. We believe that diversity powers our innovation, contributes to our excellence, and is critical for our mission. We offer a multi\-cultural, multi\-color, multi\-generational, and multi\-disciplinary, collegial working environment. We consciously create an inclusive organization that reflects our global character and commitment to gender equity. We, therefore, encourage applicants from all cultures, races, ethnicities, religions, sexes, national or regional origins, ages, disability status, sexual orientations, and gender identities.

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Director, UX Design - AEC Forma Design
AI-Focused Video Editor for DTC Brands - EU Applicants
description:
About Us
We're a company running 7–8 figure DTC brand portfolios operating across the US, Malaysia, and the Philippines. Our growth runs through paid social \- Meta and TikTok at a serious scale, which means video is at the center of everything we do. We produce a high volume of UGC\-style and direct\-response ad creative, and we need editors who can keep up without the output quality slipping.


This isn't a passion project or a content agency. The videos we edit run as paid ads, and the numbers tell us immediately what's working and what isn't. If you're the kind of editor who gets better with every round of feedback and wants to understand why something performs, not just how it looks, this is the environment for you.


We operate across multiple brands and categories, which means if needed, our editors must have the ability to switch between brand voices and audience types without losing quality or pace.


The Role
As an **AI\-Focused Video Editor**, you'll be responsible for creating and editing AI\-assisted video content primarily for paid social advertising. This includes AI\-generated visuals, AI *UGC*\-style creatives, product\-focused videos, direct\-response ads, and variations of existing winning concepts across Meta and TikTok.


You'll work closely with Creative Strategists, Video Editors, and the wider creative team to turn concepts and briefs into platform\-ready ad creatives. You'll be expected to actively use and experiment with AI video generation and editing tools to create more creative variations, improve turnaround time, and expand what can be produced from a single concept.


This is a high\-output and high\-feedback role. Your work will be reviewed not only on visual quality but also on how effectively it supports creative testing and campaign performance.


What You'll Be DoingAI Video Creation \& Editing* Create AI\-generated and AI\-assisted video creatives for paid social advertising across Meta and TikTok
* Generate AI visuals, scenes, product shots, characters, avatars, and *UGC*\-style content based on creative briefs and campaign requirements
* Transform creative concepts and scripts into AI\-generated video assets while maintaining consistency with the intended brand, audience, and offer
* Combine AI\-generated footage with traditional editing techniques to create polished, high\-performing advertisements
* Edit AI\-generated and traditional footage into *UGC*\-style, direct\-response, and product\-focused video ads
* Create multiple versions of the same concept efficiently, including *hook* variations, visual variations, CTAs, and different creative angles
* Produce fast\-paced edits with strong visual changes, pacing, captions, text overlays, sound design, music, and motion graphics where needed
* Ensure AI\-generated content feels natural, engaging, and platform\-native rather than obviously artificial or repetitive
* Continuously experiment with new AI video tools and workflows that can improve creative quality, speed, and production capacity


Creative Testing \& Iteration* Work from creative briefs, scripts, winning ad references, and performance insights provided by Creative Strategists
* Translate creative concepts into multiple AI\-generated visual approaches for testing
* Produce variations of winning concepts without simply duplicating existing ads
* Apply feedback quickly and accurately to improve creative output
* Repurpose high\-performing concepts into new formats, angles, audiences, or visual styles
* Identify opportunities where AI can help produce stronger or more scalable creative variations
* Understand the relationship between editing, visual storytelling, *hook* structure, attention retention, and ad performance


Workflow \& Collaboration* Receive and interpret creative briefs, asking relevant questions upfront when clarification is needed
* Work closely with Creative Strategists and other members of the creative team to ensure visuals align with the intended concept and marketing angle
* Submit first cuts and AI\-generated assets within agreed timelines
* Respond quickly and accurately to revision notes
* Keep project files, prompts, source materials, generated assets, and exports organized according to team SOPs
* Stay updated on emerging AI video tools, trends, and capabilities and share useful discoveries with the team
* Support high\-volume creative production across multiple brands and markets

  

**Requirements**  

  

What We're Looking For* Proven experience creating or editing **short\-form video ads** for paid social, *UGC*, DTC, direct\-response, or performance marketing
* Hands\-on experience with **AI video generation and creative tools**
* Strong portfolio showcasing video editing skills and AI\-generated or AI\-assisted work
* Proficiency in **Premiere Pro, CapCut, or similar professional video editing tools**
* Strong understanding of ***hook*****s, pacing, attention retention, CTA placement, and Meta/TikTok video formats**
* Ability to turn creative briefs and scripts into engaging, high\-performing video ads
* Experience creating multiple creative variations efficiently for testing
* Ability to combine **AI\-generated assets with traditional editing** while maintaining high\-quality output
* Able to work independently, manage multiple projects, meet deadlines, and respond well to feedback


Strong Advantages* Experience creating **AI** ***UGC*****\-style content**
* Experience with AI video tools such as **Sora, Higgsfield, Arcads, InfiniteTalk**, or similar platforms
* Familiarity with AI creative tools such as **ElevenLabs, Leonardo.ai, Freepik, and ChatGPT**
* Experience editing **DTC, e\-commerce, beauty, wellness, lifestyle, or consumer product ads**
* Strong understanding of **direct\-response advertising and performance marketing**


Instant No's* No hands\-on experience creating practical AI\-assisted video content
* No portfolio demonstrating relevant short\-form, paid social, *UGC*, or performance\-focused work
* Relies entirely on AI tools without strong editing, pacing, and storytelling skills
* Unable to work independently or handle a high volume of creative output
* Unwilling to experiment with new tools or apply feedback and revisions

  

**Benefits**  

  

Compensation \& Benefits* Competitive monthly rate (contractor) based on experience, AI tool proficiency, and portfolio quality
* Fully remote with a flexible setup
* Clear growth path within the Creative and AI production function

title: Senior Direct Response Funnel Copywriter & Strategist
description:
About Us


HarZa Group is a fast\-growing operator of direct\-to\-consumer brands in health and wellness. Our flagship brand, Rejuvacare, serves more than 400,000 customers with products targeting chronic pain and mobility, including RejuvaKnee, FootRenew, RejuvaFlow and OzemPatch. We ship primarily to the United States and run a membership program that powers recurring revenue. The company has scaled 12x in a single year to nearly 150 people across more than 15 countries. We are remote\-first, async\-first, and hold a high standard of accountability across everything we do.


The Role


We are looking for an exceptional senior direct response copywriter to take ownership of our post\-click funnels. This is not a role for someone who receives a brief, writes the copy and moves on. We are looking for someone who treats funnels the way an exceptional creative strategist treats advertising: research the customer and the market, form a hypothesis, develop the concept, write the copy, get the funnel launched, study the performance, identify the constraint, develop the next test, and turn every result into a feedback loop.


You will be deeply involved in the commercial performance of everything you write. Once a funnel goes live you should be watching click\-through rates, advertorial to sales page click\-through, quiz completion, sales page and checkout conversion, revenue per visitor, average order value, order bump and upsell take rates, refund rates and contribution margin. A page is not finished when the copy is approved. It is finished when it has launched, been measured, and produced a learning that improves the next page.


Your ultimate objective is to remove the founders from writing and reviewing routine funnel copy. Initially they will remain closely involved and may still write a large share of it. You will work directly with them, learn their frameworks, understand their decision\-making, and gradually take ownership of the function. Success means reaching the point where the founders no longer need to write funnel copy, rewrite your work, or independently double\-check it before launch. From there you create leverage through AI systems, documented processes and, in time, additional writers trained and managed beneath you.


A Note on the Category


This is claims\-led direct response, not product\-led ecommerce, and the distinction matters more than any other line in this description. Our products address chronic pain and mobility. The benefit is not visually obvious, it cannot be demonstrated in a photograph, and it cannot be sold on aspiration. Belief has to be built through mechanism, proof, advertorial and presell structure, and honest handling of objections, all inside the compliance limits of a health category.


Copywriters who have scaled fashion, accessories, beauty or other visually self\-evident products often find that their playbook does not transfer. A strong track record in a product\-led category is welcome but does not substitute for this. We will prioritize candidates who have written for health, wellness, supplements or another claims\-sensitive category and who understand what can and cannot be said.


Why This Role Is Different


The founders have generated more than nine figures in post\-purchase upsell revenue in under twenty\-four months. That figure is post\-purchase upsell revenue specifically, not total front\-end company revenue. You will get direct access to the frameworks behind those results, existing research, templates, processes and funnel data, direct feedback and training from the founders, a portfolio of brands and offers with significant traffic, a high\-volume testing environment where your ideas get launched and measured, and real commercial data across multiple funnel types, offers and traffic sources.


This is an opportunity to develop beyond being a copywriter. The right person can progress toward Head of Funnel Copy, Head of Funnel Strategy, Director of Conversion, or operator of one of our portfolio brands. We prefer to promote from within, and progression is based on commercial results, leadership ability and the amount of responsibility you can absorb.

 **Requirements**  

What You Will Own


Post\-Click Funnel Strategy


Act as the strategic owner of post\-click messaging and conversion copy. Participate in marketing, campaign and offer planning, understand what each traffic source needs after the click, and ensure message continuity between the advertisement, presell page, sales page, checkout and upsell journey. Recommend the right funnel format based on the offer, traffic source, customer awareness and market sophistication, and determine when a campaign needs an advertorial, listicle, quiz, long\-form page, short\-form page or another structure. Collaborate with media buyers and creative strategists to understand the promise that generated the click, and identify disconnects between the ad message and the landing page experience. Your remit begins at the click, but you must understand the whole acquisition system to make intelligent post\-click decisions.


Customer and Market Research


Research the customer before developing the copy. Analyze reviews, surveys, support tickets, customer interviews, call transcripts, refund reasons and community discussions. Study competitor offers, positioning, mechanisms, pricing and funnel structures. Identify desires, fears, frustrations, failed solutions, objections and buying triggers, understand the customer's level of awareness and the sophistication of the market, and distinguish between what customers say they want and what their behaviour suggests they value. Build voice\-of\-customer libraries that preserve the language customers actually use, validate that claims are supportable and appropriate for the category, and convert raw research into usable copy insight rather than research documents nobody reads.


Hypothesis Before Writing


Every meaningful funnel project begins with a clear hypothesis. Identify the metric or funnel stage being targeted, diagnose the likely reason for underperformance, state the customer insight behind the diagnosis, define what will change and why it should influence behaviour, select a primary success metric and the guardrails around it, and determine what result would validate or invalidate the idea. The first question is not what copy should I write. It is what is the constraint, why does it exist, and what evidence suggests this is the right solution.


Writing Complete Funnels


Write and optimize new offer positioning, unique mechanisms, big ideas, hooks and leads, advertorials, listicles, quiz flows, long\-form and short\-form sales pages, product detail pages, offer sections, pricing and bundle presentation, guarantees, checkout copy, order bumps, post\-purchase upsells, downsells, cross\-sells, funnel transitions, calls to action, and the supporting briefs for page graphics and visual proof. You must be able to develop a major long\-form funnel from a blank page and equally to identify and rewrite the one critical section inside an existing funnel.


The Offer, Not Only the Words


Copy cannot be separated from the offer. You will think critically about positioning, price, quantity, bundles, discounts, bonuses, guarantees, payment options, shipping thresholds, subscription structures, order bumps, upsell sequencing and offer continuity through the funnel. You should be willing to conclude that the copy is not the main problem and that the right recommendation is to change the offer, reorder the upsells, change the price, improve the guarantee, remove a step or target a different segment. Your responsibility is to improve the commercial result, not to defend the original brief.


Funnel Economics


Understand the underlying economics of each offer, including selling price, cost of goods, pick and pack, shipping, payment processing, discounts, refunds, chargebacks, subscription take rates, upsell margins, gross and contribution margin, customer acquisition cost, and revenue and profit per visitor. A higher AOV is not automatically better if contribution margin falls, a higher conversion rate is not better if refunds rise, and a pricing test must be judged on full funnel economics rather than one isolated metric. You do not need to be a finance professional. You do need to think like an owner.


Staying Close to Live Performance


Once your copy is launched, confirm the correct version went live, review performance against the control and at each funnel step, segment where appropriate, compare mobile and desktop, look for discrepancies between traffic sources, use heatmaps and behavioural data where helpful, and compare primary against guardrail metrics. Document what worked, what did not and why, recommend the next action, and feed every meaningful learning back into research and writing. You should feel personal ownership of the result without becoming defensive when an idea loses. A losing test that produces a real learning is useful. A test launched without a hypothesis and never reviewed is not.


The Learning System and AI Leverage


Build and maintain a searchable archive of tests and results recording the original problem, hypothesis, change, result and learning. Identify recurring patterns across brands and funnel types, separate genuine principles from conclusions drawn on insufficient data, convert repeated winners into reusable frameworks, and prevent failed concepts from being unknowingly repeated. Insight should become company knowledge rather than living in one person's head.


Alongside that, become highly AI\-enabled. Use and improve AI\-assisted systems for research synthesis, voice\-of\-customer clustering, transcript and review analysis, competitor and mechanism research, angle development, hypothesis generation, copy outlining, first drafts, variations, objection identification, quality control, claim consistency review, funnel analysis and test documentation. You will not use a generic chatbot to produce first drafts. You will help build structured processes containing the right context, approved source material, brand knowledge, customer research, historical winners, founder frameworks, defined quality criteria and clear review stages. The standard is not whether AI was used. It is whether AI helped us produce better research, better copy, more tests and faster learning without lowering quality.


What We Are Looking For


Substantial professional experience in direct response copywriting, gained over several years writing for real offers with meaningful traffic. A portfolio containing both long\-form and short\-form funnel copy, significant experience writing for cold traffic, and proven experience in DTC ecommerce, direct response or another measurable\-response environment. Evidence that your work has generated meaningful revenue or measurable conversion improvement. Experience writing complete funnels rather than isolated page sections, including advertorials, listicles, sales pages, quizzes, checkouts and post\-purchase upsells.


Experience in health, wellness, supplements or another claims\-sensitive category, and an understanding of how to build belief where the benefit is not visually demonstrable. A strong grasp of customer awareness, market sophistication, offers, mechanisms, leads, proof, objections and risk reversal. The ability to conduct and synthesize deep customer research and turn it into a clear hypothesis and a persuasive argument.


Strong analytical fluency and comfort with funnel performance data, the ability to diagnose where a funnel is losing customers, a working understanding of AOV, revenue per visitor, upsell take rates, gross margin and contribution margin, experience creating and evaluating conversion tests, and the ability to distinguish correlation, noise and meaningful evidence.


Strong AI fluency with evidence of using AI inside a real research, writing or analysis workflow. The ability to write quickly without sacrificing strategic depth, the confidence to challenge a weak brief or assumption, the humility to change direction when the data disproves an idea, the communication skills to work with founders, media buyers, designers and analysts, and the potential to train and lead additional writers as the function grows. You must be able to overlap consistently with our collaboration window of 8:00am to 12:00pm EST.


High\-volume Meta, native, Google or affiliate traffic, post\-purchase upsell funnels, portfolio or multi\-brand environments, CRO or direct response agencies, subscription offers, and experience building copy systems or training programs are all highly advantageous.


Evidence We Expect to See


Applicants should demonstrate results, not simply submit polished writing samples. Strong evidence includes funnel revenue, conversion rate improvements, revenue per visitor and AOV improvements, upsell take rate and contribution margin improvements, results against an established control, evidence of scaling an offer, before and after funnel performance, and a sequence of tests showing how an insight developed over time.


We understand that candidates may be under confidentiality agreements. Results can be anonymized, but you should still be able to explain what the offer was, what the original problem was, what you personally owned, what research you conducted, what hypothesis you formed, what you changed, which metric moved, how much traffic supported the conclusion, and what happened next. We are more interested in clear thinking and honest attribution than impressive numbers without context.


This Role Is Not


This is not a junior copywriting position, a brand copy role, a content or social media role, or an ad\-copy\-only position. It is not a role where you write from a brief without questioning it, where your responsibility ends when the document is submitted, or where you would rather your work was not measured. It is not a pure CRO analyst role in which you never write, nor a management\-only role in which you no longer produce. It is not for someone who uses AI to generate generic copy and calls that leverage, who needs the founders to supply every angle and mechanism, who waits to be told which test to run, or who blames media buying, design or development without investigating the full funnel.

 **Benefits**  

What We Offer


A fully remote senior position with genuine ownership of a function that directly determines how fast the business can move. We offer paid time off, a monthly wellness stipend, medical insurance support, a company\-funded computer allowance after a tenure milestone, a birthday gift card, an in\-country meetup allowance, and participation in company\-funded leadership offsites. You will have direct access to the founders, a high\-volume testing environment, and the mandate to build the system rather than inherit someone else's process.

title: Director of Planetary Health Alliance European Hub Secretariat
description:
The Barcelona Institute for Global Health (ISGlobal) is a cutting\-edge institute addressing global public health challenges through research, translation into policy and education. ISGlobal has a broad portfolio in communicable and non\-communicable diseases including environmental and climate determinants, and applies a multidisciplinary scientific approach ranging from the molecular to the population level. Research is organized in five programs: Climate, Air Pollution, Nature and Urban Health; Environment and Health over the Lifecourse; Global Viral and Bacterial Infections; Malaria and Neglected Parasitic Diseases and Maternal Child and Reproductive Health. ISGlobal is accredited with the Severo Ochoa distinction, a seal of excellence of the Spanish Science Ministry.


During the last years, ISGlobal has emerged as a prominent international advocate for Planetary Health approach, integrating human health and the health of our planet into actionable research and policy initiatives. Together with a cluster of institutions — Fundació Sanitària Mollet (FSM), Consell Assessor per al Desenvolupament Sostenible (CADS), Col·legi Oficial de Metges de Barcelona (CoMB), and Universitat Oberta de Catalunya (UOC) — ISGlobal has been appointed to lead the Secretariat of the Planetary Health Alliance European Regional Hub (European Hub of the Planetary Health Alliance) for the 2026–2028 term. The European Hub is part of the global Planetary Health Alliance and works closely with its global headquarters and regional hubs.

### **WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**


ISGlobal is seeking a senior professional to lead the development and coordination of the Planetary Health Alliance European Hub Secretariat.


The European Hub Lead will provide strategic and operational leadership, strengthen the European Planetary Health community and represent the Hub in its relations with PHA Global (hosted at Johns Hopkins University), European institutions, professional and academic networks, healthcare organizations, policymakers and civil society.


The role requires a strong capacity to connect scientific knowledge with institutional strategy, policy and implementation; to build interdisciplinary and cross\-sectoral partnerships; and to translate Planetary Health principles into collaborative initiatives with tangible impact.


The position involves regular interaction with European and international organizations and occasional travel within Europe.

### **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Lead the Secretariat of the PHA European Regional Hub Secretariat as a multiinstituional cluster.
* Lead the implementation of the European Hub strategy and work plan for the 2026–2028 term including the search of funding opportunities
* Ensure alignment and close partnership with PHA Global and maintain regular collaboration with other regional hubs.
* Strengthen and expand the Planetary Health network across Europe.
* Build strategic partnerships with academic institutions, healthcare organizations, public administrations, professional bodies, European networks and civil society.
* Facilitate interdisciplinary and intersectoral collaboration among Hub members and partners.
* Represent the European Hub at European and international meetings, conferences and institutional forums.
* Contribute and oversee the Hub’s communication and dissemination strategy, including its website, newsletters and professional networks.
* Communicate Planetary Health concepts and initiatives effectively to scientific, institutional, professional and public audiences.

**AUXILIAR TASKS**


This job description reflects the present requirements of the post but may evolve at any time in the future as duties and responsibilities change and/or develop providing there is appropriate consultation with the post\-holder.


This job description is not a definitive or exhaustive list of responsibilities but identifies the key responsibilities and tasks of the post holder. The specific objectives of the post holder will be subject to review as part of the individual professional assessment process.

### **SKILLS**

* Strategic vision and strong leadership capacity.
* Excellent stakeholder engagement, facilitation and relationship\-management skills.
* Ability to work across disciplines, sectors and institutional cultures.
* Strong planning, coordination and decision\-making abilities.
* Excellent written and oral communication, including public speaking and institutional representation.
* Capacity to work autonomously while fostering collaborative and distributed leadership.
* Proactive, innovative and results\-oriented approach.
* Ability to identify strategic partnerships, project opportunities and potential funding sources.
* Availability for occasional travel within Europe.


The post holder will adhere to ISGlobal principles contained in **People management policy, including Equity, diversity and health safety**. The post holder will respect, and be accountable to ensure ISGlobal policies and procedures.

### **TRAINING AND EXPERIENCE / QUALIFICATIONS**

* University degree in environmental sciences, public health, health sciences, sustainability or another relevant discipline.
* Postgraduate training in Planetary Health, environmental health, public health, sustainability, management or a related field will be considered an asset.
* At least ten years of relevant professional experience in environmental health, sustainability, public health, Planetary Health or related fields.
* Demonstrated experience leading strategic programmes, organizational transformation or multi\-stakeholder initiatives.
* Proven ability to develop partnerships across academic, healthcare, institutional, policy and civil\-society settings.
* Experience translating scientific and technical knowledge into strategies, programmes, policies or practical solutions.
* Experience working in European or international networks and representing organizations in high\-level professional environments.
* Knowledge of health\-system transformation, environmental determinants of health and Planetary Health approaches will be highly valued.

### **LANGUAGE LEVEL**

* Full professional proficiency in English, Spanish and Catalan, both written and spoken.
* Knowledge of additional European languages will be considered an asset.

### **CONDITIONS**

* Contract: Full time (40 hours per week). Until the end of the European Hub’s current mandate in December 2028\.
* Salary: According to ISGlobal internal salary scale
* Work\-Life Balance: 36 days off per year (23 vacation days \+ 13 personal days)
* Start date: September 2026

### **HOW TO APPLY**


Applicants must complete the application form and upload a CV and a Cover Letter. Each document must be clearly named with the candidate’s name and surname.


Applications will remain open until 16th of September.


Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and shortlisted candidates may be contacted and interviewed as applications are received. Interviews may take place during the application period.


We encourage diverse applications, including but not limited to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, age, sexual orientation, physical abilities, and political beliefs.

### **SELECTION PROCESS**


The selection process is designed in two phases:
  

1\- Interview phase of a technical nature, with the team that requires the incorporation. To assess the person's skills and CV.  

2 \- Meeting with HR with the finalist(s) to finish assessing the profile and discuss contractual and institutional issues.


If needed any technical test could be passed. A Psychological Competency Evaluation Test will be required for the structural or transversal positions.


In accordance with the OTM\-R principles, a gender\-balanced recruitment panel is formed for every vacancy at the beginning of the process. After reviewing the content of the applications, the panel will start the interviews, with at least one technical and one administrative interview. A profile questionnaire as well as a technical exercise may be required during the process.

*We confirm our commitment towards the value of the diversity of our staff and student population and seek to promote peace, equity, diversity and inclusion as essential elements in contribution to improving health worldwide.*

**Responsibilities**

**Introduction to role**


BioPharmaceuticals Medical (BPM) ensures the best patient outcomes by providing healthcare decision\-makers around the world with the evidence and confidence they need on AstraZeneca therapies and support our internal stakeholders with medical insight and expertise. BPM provides medical leadership with market participation and connectivity while also impacting the life cycle planning and execution of all our products. The Senior Director, Health Data Implementation will be accountable for chairing RWD steering committees and hold a key role on cross\-functional working groups that will link RWD platforms to enterprise strategy. * Understand and communicate on technologies behind RWD knowledge management and data insight tools
* Translate problems into specific analytical questions and form hypotheses that can be answered with RWD
* Publish research into the areas of automation and visualization for generating Real World Evidence
* Lead senior leader and cross\-functional engagement to scale RWD platforms strategically and sustainably, including our global/local RWD community of practice
* Mentorship and oversight of other RWD leaders within BPM Evidence and related functional areas

Context Travel is a global day tour operator that connects intellectually curious travelers with local subject matter experts in over 60 destinations around the world. Our guests often tell us that we are the best part of their trip, and we take great pride in creating unforgettable moments that are treasured for a lifetime.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

The first is client\-facing and commercial: converting custom enquiries, advising clients and advisors, and maximizing the value of each booking. The second is behind the scenes: keeping the regional portfolio accurate and fulfillable, working directly with our experts, and using data and tools to improve our regional operations.  

  

The role reports to the Regional Senior Manager \- Italy, Southern Europe and Africa, and will work closely with the Regional Director and the Regional Delivery team.

**ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES**
-----------------------------

* Own the end\-to\-end journey for custom and high\-value regional requests, from initial qualification and proposal design to closing the sale and identifying upsell opportunities.
* Serve as the primary, proactive contact for clients and advisors, ensuring all proposals are commercially sound, operationally feasible, and accurately tracked.
* Maintain expert knowledge of the ISEA portfolio to ensure fulfillability, support product development, and turn recurring custom requests into repeatable products.
* Monitor backend configurations and flag seasonality risks or portfolio gaps before they impact bookings.
* Manage 1:1 expert communications and build trusted relationships with the regional community, thoughtfully matching experts to clients based on context and expertise.

* Support onboarding of new regional teammates and act as a resource for best practice.
* Actively contribute to weekly Delivery team and cross\-regional meetings.
* Participate in region\-agnostic initiatives and lead project working groups.

* **Portfolio depth.** Knows the Italian, Greek, Turkey and Africa product well enough to answer most questions without escalating.
* **Technical fluency.** Adopts tools, including AI, and turns them into time saved for the whole team.

* **Expert relationships.** Trusted by the expert community, and able to brief them well under time pressure.

* 2\+ of experience in travel, hospitality, or a comparable client\-facing commercial role.
* Proven experience selling or building custom, high\-value travel or service proposals with an eagerness to close the sale and celebrate the win

Because we created this category, we've learned that successful global expansion isn't driven by technology alone. It requires deep global expertise. We call this the marriage of expert and technology, human when it matters.


This means we have the people and the technology to ensure 100% compliance with local, regional, national, and international laws. Together, this ethos and our solutions portfolio allow businesses to scale up or down wherever, however, and whenever they want to expand, without the risk.


**Overview of the role**

We're looking for a **Head of Product, Core Journeys** to lead the platform experience across our core client journey, from hiring a worker through to invoicing for them.


The role is accountable for the platform experience, delivery, and outcome achievement across the core transactional workflows . You'll translate that target experience, combined with the product strategies set by the Directors of Product into a prioritised order of work ; lead ing the product managers who deliver it and ensuring we deliver on business and customer experience objectives.


**What you will be responsible for**

**Platform experience**

* Own the end\-to\-end platform experience across the core client journey, including the transitions between one part of the platform and the next

**Customer insight and product performance**

* Raise the standard of discovery and validation across your teams
* Define the expected outcome for each investment and own the value delivered against it
* Own platform NPS and adoption for the core journey, and act on the results

**Team leadership**

* Set clear expectations, give direct feedback, and address performance issues early
* Work with each product manager to understand their individual development needs, and take a coaching approach to growing their capability
* Drive AI adoption where it creates the best outcome, recognising that it serves some tasks well and others poorly, and help the product team keep pace with how the role of product is rapidly changing
**What will give you an advantage**

* Eight or more years in product, including at least five leading people
* Proven experience leading product managers in a B2B SaaS or platform business, ideally where several teams contribute to a single client experience
* Experience owning a multi\-team product area end to end, with accountability for both delivery and the value delivered

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
**About iSpeedToLead**
----------------------


iSpeedToLead is a two\-sided real estate lead marketplace operating across the United States. Sellers of motivated\-seller leads list on one side, and real estate investors buy on the other. We are a bootstrapped, profitable product company with an engineering and analytics team that ships fast and makes decisions from data rather than opinion.

**About the role**
------------------


This is the first dedicated Customer Success hire at iSpeedToLead. Today, buyers are supported reactively: tickets get answered, credits get issued, and nobody owns what happens to an account between its first purchase and its last one.


You will own the post\-purchase relationship with our buyers. That means onboarding them properly, keeping high\-value accounts healthy, and turning churn from something we observe into something we manage. You will build the function itself (playbooks, health scoring, reporting) rather than inherit it.


One thing worth stating openly before you apply: the workload is around 50 hours a week for the first 6 to 9 months while the function is being built. We would rather you decline now than discover it in month two.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

**Onboarding and activation**

* Own the onboarding of new buyers end to end, from first purchase to first repeat purchase.
* Run onboarding calls and follow\-ups, making sure every new buyer understands how to filter, buy, and work leads effectively.
* Design and maintain the onboarding sequence (content, timing, channel) and improve it based on what actually converts.

**Account health and retention**

* Manage a book of high\-value accounts with regular check\-ins, usage reviews, and proactive outreach.
* Build and maintain a health\-scoring model that flags at\-risk accounts before they churn, not after.
* Run save conversations on at\-risk accounts and document what worked, by reason code.

**Escalations and problem\-solving**

* Act as the escalation point for buyer complaints, including lead quality disputes, refund requests, and billing or balance issues.
* Coordinate with support, sales, and engineering to resolve issues, and follow through until the customer confirms resolution.
* Operate within agreed refund and credit authority limits, and defend those decisions with data.

**Voice of the customer**

* Collect, categorise, and quantify churn and refund reasons, turning anecdotes into a ranked list.
* Deliver a weekly written report to product and leadership on retention performance and the top issues driving cancellations.
* Advocate for the product changes that would remove recurring causes of churn.

**Process and reporting**

* Build the Customer Success playbooks from scratch: onboarding, save, win\-back, and escalation.
* Maintain accurate account records and interaction history in our systems.
* Report on retention metrics weekly, and own the definitions behind them.

**Collaboration**

* Work daily with sales on the handoff of new buyers, and with support on ticket patterns.
* Partner with product and analytics on lifecycle experiments and instrumentation.

**Requirements**
----------------

* 2\+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, or Retention in a high\-volume, low\-ACV environment such as a marketplace, self\-serve SaaS, or transactional product with hundreds of accounts. (Enterprise CSM experience with a handful of large logos is a different job and will not transfer well here.)
* Demonstrated ownership of a retention, churn, or repeat\-purchase metric. You can describe what it was, what you changed, and what it became.
* Comfortable working with data: SQL basics or strong BI fluency (Amplitude, Metabase, Looker, BigQuery, or similar). You pull your own numbers rather than requesting them.
* Experience building a process from zero, such as an onboarding flow, a save playbook, or a health\-score model. Executing someone else's process is not the same thing.
* Written and spoken English at C1 level, customer\-facing, at volume.
* Confident on the phone with US small\-business customers. Our buyers are real estate investors: direct, busy, and blunt.
* Practical use of AI tools in your daily workflow (call summarisation, drafting, triage) with examples you can show.
* A minimum of 4 hours of daily overlap with US Eastern Time.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience in real estate, proptech, lead generation, or a marketplace with wallet or prepaid\-balance mechanics.
* Familiarity with Intercom, HubSpot, or a comparable CRM and support stack.
* Experience designing lifecycle email or automation flows.
* Ukrainian or Russian in addition to English.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Full ownership of a metric that shows up directly in the P\&L, with no layer between you and leadership.
* A greenfield function. You design how Customer Success works here.
* Real data infrastructure and an AI\-native team, so arguments get settled with numbers and tooling is not a fight.
* A clear 12\-month growth path to Head of Retention or Head of Customer Success, including automation of the low\-touch tier and one to two direct reports.
* Remote work with flexible hours inside the required US overlap.
* Referral bonus of USD 3,000 after probation for anyone you bring in.

Please be advised that we are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position. As such, you will only be considered if you already possess the right to work in the UK.

At Tapestry, we are committed to building a diverse \& inclusive workforce. If you are interested in this role but do not believe you meet all the set criteria, that’s ok. We are happy to work with individuals who have the drive, passion, agility and willingness to learn. So, take a chance and apply; you may just be who we are looking for. We would be delighted to hear from you.
  

  

**Our Competencies for All Employees**  

**Courage** : Doesn’t hold back anything that needs to be said; provides current, direct, complete, and “actionable” positive and corrective feedback to others; lets people know where they stand; faces up to people problems on any person or situation (not including direct reports) quickly and directly; is not afraid to take negative action when necessary.

**Customer Focus** : Is dedicated to meeting the expectations and requirements of internal and external customers; gets first\-hand customer information and uses it for improvements in products and services; acts with customers in mind; establishes and maintains effective relationships with customers and gains their trust and respect.
  

**Dealing with Ambiguity** : Can effectively cope with change; can shift gears comfortably; can decide and act without having the total picture; isn’t upset when things are up in the air; doesn’t have to finish things before moving on; can comfortably handle risk and uncertainty.

title: Facilities Manager
description:
### **Position**

**Being part of LOEWE** gives you the opportunity of learning new things every day and working with people passionate about what they do, in a fast moving and ambitious company.


We are looking for a Facility Manager to oversee the maintenance and operation of our facilities and workplace services, ensuring they meet the needs of the organization and its employees.


Reporting to the Security Director, you will be based at our Madrid headquarters.


### **Job responsibilities**

**Your role will be:**

* Manage the day\-to\-day operation of LOEWE facilities, ensuring a safe, efficient, and high\-quality workplace environment.
* Oversee facility service providers and contracts, including security, cleaning, catering, parking, maintenance, and renovation projects.
* Lead facilities staff and external contractors, monitoring service performance, SLAs, KPIs, and cost efficiency.
* Manage facilities budgets, procurement activities, and operational expenditures.
* Ensure compliance with health, safety, environmental, and building regulations, including mandatory inspections, audits, risk assessments, and energy efficiency standards.
* Plan and oversee preventive and corrective maintenance programs for building systems, including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, fire protection, and building management systems (BMS).
* Coordinate office space planning, workplace moves, refurbishment projects, and facility\-related infrastructure requirements.
* Develop and implement workplace policies, procedures, and best practices to support business operations.
* Collaborate closely with HR, Finance, Legal, Procurement, IT, and other stakeholders to ensure integrated facility management.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives through the use of CAFM tools, digital maintenance platforms, and workplace analytics.
### **Profile**

**What is important for the role:**

* 5 years of experience in facilities maintenance or equivalent related functions.
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
* Analytical, problem\-solving and decision\-making skills.
* Ability to lead and manage teams and projects.
* Attention to detail but also to see the implications for the bigger picture
* Commercial and customer service awareness
* Organisation, time management, prioritising and the ability to handle various things at the same time.
* Good knowledge of IT packages.
* Fluent Spanish and English is a must.
### **Additional information**

**About us:**

Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second\-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise.


At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.  



If you think this role is made for you, please send us your CV!


***LOEWE***
**MAISON**
----------------------

Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques.
  

Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts \& Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work.
  

Today, Loewe’s master artisans combine their craft knowledge, accumulated over generations, with new technologies to produce iconic objects presenting both instant appeal and enduring style: true incarnations of Loewe’s ideals and vision.
  

Radical and ever\-evolving: here’s to another 200 years of Loewe history
  

Since 2013, Jonathan Anderson, Loewe’s Creative Director, has been carrying this vision ever further. One of the leading designers of his generation, Anderson has spearheaded a major rejuvenation of the House.
  

Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre\-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force.
  

At the intersection of fashion, craft and culture, Loewe’s ambition is to be radical and ever\-evolving. Craft and luxury are inextricably linked, and at Loewe, the one makes the other feel more accessible and tangible. And by adding a cultural dimension – involving fine arts, film, dance, etc. –, Loewe has become a vibrant force for creativity and innovation, ensuring the brand’s durability for another 200 years… and more.
