description:
**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Employer:** **DWS Group**

**Title:** **Corporate Functions AI Strategy and Adoption Lead, Director**

**Location:** **Madrid**

**Job Code:** *placeholder for LinkedIn job wrapping*

**About DWS:**

Today, markets face a whole new set of pressures – but also a whole lot of opportunity too. Opportunity to innovate differently. Opportunity to invest responsibly. And opportunity to make change.


Join us at DWS, and you can be part of an industry\-leading firm with a global presence. You can lead ambitious opportunities and shape the future of investing. You can support our clients, local communities, and the environment.


We’re looking for creative thinkers and innovators to join us as the world continues to transform. As whole markets change, one thing remains clear; our people always work together to capture the opportunities of tomorrow.


As investors on behalf of our clients, it is our role to find investment solutions. Ensuring the best possible foundation for our clients’ financial future. And in return, we’ll give you the support and platform to develop new skills, make an impact and work alongside some of the industry’s greatest thought leaders. This is your chance to achieve your goals and lead an extraordinary career.


This is your chance to invest in your future.


Read more about DWS and who we are here.


**Team / division overview**

The role sits at the intersection of hands\-on delivery and strategic influence. You will work directly with engineers, analysts, delivery leads, and business stakeholders to identify meaningful AI use cases, build practical examples, coach teams, and remove blockers to adoption. At the same time, you will translate what is being learned on the ground into clear recommendations for leadership, tooling, governance, roadmap choices, and ways of working.


Reporting into the Head of Corporate Functions (CF) Technology, you will be embedded in the area where AI adoption needs to happen. You will also work closely with the DWS AI Centre of Excellence, ensuring that Corporate Functions is both aligned to enterprise AI direction and actively shaping it through real delivery experience. You will help create and nurture the Corporate Functions AI Community of Practice, so that knowledge, experimentation, and adoption are shared across teams rather than remaining isolated in individual pockets.


**Your responsibilities –**

As Corporate Functions AI Strategy and Adoption Lead, Director, you will:


* Act as the primary AI champion embedded within the delivery and operational teams, working alongside engineers, analysts, and delivery leads to embed AI into everyday practice.
* Lead and facilitate the AI Open House and equivalent adoption programmes including curating peer wins, facilitating skill\-building segments, and visibly resolving blockers.
* Coach individuals and teams on practical AI use, from prompt engineering and gen\-AI features through to building RAG pipelines and agentic workflows.
* Serve as the primary convenor and energiser of the AI Community of Practice ensuring it has rhythm, relevance, and genuine peer ownership.
* Curate and grow a shared knowledge base of AI use cases, prompt libraries, lessons learned, and emerging tools relevant to the team.
* Design and run lightweight experimentation programmes including challenges, hackathons, discovery sprints that surface new AI applications and build confidence across teams.
* Act as the CF technology team’s primary AI thought leader and strategic advisor to leadership translating field\-level insight into strategic recommendations.
* Stay current with AI developments across the industry particularly in financial services and bring relevant intelligence into AI CoE leadership conversations and roadmap decisions.
* Advise CF business stakeholders on how AI can be applied to their specific domains, translating technical capability into business value language.
* Build, test, and iterate on AI\-powered tools, prototypes, and integrations demonstrating feasibility and sparking wider adoption through working examples.
* Design and implement end\-to\-end AI solutions including RAG pipelines, LLM\-powered applications, and agentic workflows that connect AI to real business processes.
* Evaluate internal and SaaS AI models, platforms, and tooling including LLMs, agentic frameworks, and productivity tools and make grounded recommendations based on practical, production\-aware experience.

We are looking for


* Demonstrable hands\-on experience building software, with confidence working in a modern development environment and credibility with engineering teams.
* Practical, working experience with AI models and tools including LLMs, prompt engineering, AI\-assisted coding tools such as GitHub CoPilot or equivalent. Demonstrable delivery of at least one RAG implementation, an agentic workflow, a fine\-tuned model, or a production LLM integration.
* A genuine track record of driving AI adoption within an organization, making it happen at the team level and measuring what changed.
* Experience working in or closely with technology teams in complex organizations — ideally within financial services, professional services, or similarly regulated environments.
* Demonstrated ability to work across multiple organizational layers from coaching junior developers to briefing senior leadership
* Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.
* Proficiency in Python (strongly preferred) and comfort working in a modern development environment
* Working knowledge of LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, or equivalent and experience building applications on top of them beyond simple prompting.
* Hands\-on experience with AI development tooling: vector databases, embedding models, orchestration frameworks, and evaluation and observability approaches.
* Understanding of agentic AI patterns, including tool use, planning, multi\-agent coordination with experience designing or building systems that use them.
* Understanding of how regulated financial services organizations operate including data sensitivity, compliance constraints, and the specific risk appetite that shapes technology decisions.
* Awareness of how leading financial institutions are approaching AI adoption.
* Ability to translate AI capability into business value language relevant to financial services such as risk reduction, control improvement, cost efficiency, revenue enablement, client experience and making the case to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Demonstrably well\-read on AI developments. You follow research, read technical blogs, track model releases, and can hold a credible conversation about where the field is heading and what it means for the organisation.
* Strong understanding of change management and adoption dynamics. You know why people resist new tools and how to meet them where they are and led early interest into sustained adoption.
* Curious about the intersection of AI and organisational design \-how capability builds, how communities form, and what it takes to move an institution rather than just a team.

**What we’ll offer you:**

At DWS we’re serious about diversity, equity and creating an inclusive culture where colleagues can be themselves and it’s important to us that you enjoy coming to work \- feeling healthy, happy and rewarded. At DWS, you’ll have access to a range of benefits which you can choose from to create a personalised plan unique to your lifestyle. Whether you’re interested in healthcare, company perks, or are thinking about your retirement plan, there’s something for everyone.


DWS’ Hybrid Working model is designed to find the right balance between in\-person collaboration and engagement in the office, which is core to our working culture, and working from home. Each business group varies on the split between time spent in the office and at home, but this will be discussed and made clear as part of your application and interview process. We will continue to review and evolve our working environments and methods to ensure that we are working in the best way possible for our people.


If you require any adjustments or changes to be made to the interview process for any reason including, or related to a disability or long\-term health condition, then please contact your recruiter and let them know what assistance you may need. Examples of adjustments include providing a change to the format of the interview, or providing assistance when at the DWS office. This will not affect your application and your recruitment team will discuss options with you.


We at DWS are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace, one that embraces dialogue and diverse views, and treats everyone fairly to drive a high\-performance culture. The value we create for our clients and investors is based on our ability to bring together various perspectives from all over the world and from different backgrounds. It is our experience that teams perform better and deliver improved outcomes when they are able to incorporate a wide range of perspectives. We call this \#ConnectingTheDots.

title: Lifestyle Agent
description:
**THE RESIDENCES**


Mandarin Oriental has experienced exponential growth in the development of The Residences at Mandarin Oriental, in combination with hotels, to form complex mixed\-use and stand\-alone projects. Integral to the growth of the Mandarin Oriental footprint, Residences are a new paradigm, and as such require focused operational expertise. In addition to the goal of delivering superior experiences and services to Residences owners, Mandarin Oriental is focused not only on the management of the Residences common areas to the very high standards our guests have become accustomed, but to continually improving our relationship with Residence owners over the long term.

  

**STRATEGIC INTENT**


The mission of this position is for the incumbent to assume full responsibility for all aspects of residential services, concierge operations, and the lifestyle experience of our residents during both the pre\-opening and post\-opening phases.


The ideal candidate will be proactive, creative, and resident\-centric, with a strong focus on excellence and operational efficiency. They must consistently keep the residents’ perspective in mind when delivering services and products and always represent the brand with professionalism and integrity. This role also serves as a key development opportunity for operations\-focused professionals aspiring to advance into positions within Group Residences or Hotel operations across MOHG projects.


The incumbent is expected to demonstrate tenacity, creativity, flexibility, and unwavering commitment to ensure a successful residential launch, strategic positioning, and continued operation — all delivered on budget and on time.  



**SCOPE OF POSITION / SUMMARY**


The Lifestyle Attendant is responsible for the organisation, coordination, monitoring and maintaining of their shift to ensure a smooth and efficient operation of all the exclusive Amenities including the Fitness Center, Spa facilities, the indoor and outdoor pool, the meeting room, the lounge areas, the library, the Golf Simulator and wet\-areas of the residences and any other health / outdoor activities provided.  

  

  



Also, the Lifestyle Agent is responsible for assisting and supporting Residential Concierge and Residential Porter with their full scope of duties duties.

  



**ORGANIZATION STRUCTURE**

  



The Lifestyle Attendant reports to Lead Concierge and subsequently to the Director of Residences.

  



**DUTIES AND SUPPORTING RESPONSIBILITIES**

  



The Lifestyle Agent responsibilities:  

  

  



* Effectively coordinates the usage of the Lifestyle area and Community activities.
* Review the cleanliness of the exclusive Amenities during the shift and maintain it in accordance with MOHG Standards (i.e. set up of treatment room, maintain the stock of towels, water, etc… at the fitness centre and changing rooms, disinfection of fitness equipment, etc…)
* Proactively greet, interact, and assist residence owners in a professional manner.
* Identify and report defects throughout the residential area; notify the Residences Management team immediately of hazards, injuries, equipment or processes that negatively affect the operations.
* Report all requests and complaints to the Residences Management team to ensure issues are resolved immediately and followed up to ensure the resident’s satisfaction.
* To aid therapists and private practitioners in setting up for treatments as well as clearing away after.
* To ensure that lockers are stocked with clean linen at all times and removing soiled items.
* To ensure fitness center is always clean and with sufficient stock of towels, drinks, etc…
* Make sure all equipment at fitness center is disinfected after every use.
* To attend to residents in all areas, ensuring that they are comfortable as well as offering refreshments.
* Be knowledgeable with AV equipment and be able to set up equipment on demand.
* Maintain complete knowledge and comply with all residential and Management Company departmental policies and procedures.
* Maintain correct records for FLHSS audit.
* Maintain strict confidentiality relative to Residents and Residences business.
* Practice teamwork, create a positive work environment, greet fellow employees and thank them when they lend assistance.
* Proactively seek to provide refined luxury service ensuring resident satisfaction.
* Ability to focus attention on resident needs, remaining calm and courteous.
* Assist Residential Concierge in any duty deemed appropriate by the Concierge such as the delivery / pick up / purchase of desk services, for those services that need to be performed away from the desk such as deliveries of food, laundry, etc…
* Anticipate residents’ needs, respond promptly and acknowledge all residents, however busy and whatever time of day.
* Accommodate all Residents requests expediently and courteously. Follow up with designated Residential or Management Company personnel to ensure completion of request.
* Protect and utilise Management Company assets in a responsible and professional manner.
* Participate in the property’s sustainability initiative through energy conservation and the use of recycling programs and materials.
* Always show a professional attitude, particularly with regard to punctuality, appearance and general manner.
* Provide food and beverage service upon resident request, ensuring a seamless and personalized experience.
* To carry out any other reasonable requests as directed by your manager.

  



**REQUIREMENTS ON CORE COMPETENCIES**

  



The Lifestyle Agent requires the following personal attributes:


* Delighting our Customers


* Delighting our Colleagues


* Communicates a compelling vision
* Inspires co\-operation and commitment
* Adapts work style and ethics appropriately
* Actively listens and builds on other ideas
* Effectively understands and uses resources
* Is culturally sensitive
* Good written and verbal skills

  



* Becoming the Best


* Achievement orientated
* Makes things happen
* Has presence
* Has positive impact and influence
* Generates, innovative options
* Adapts plans to suit change
* Seeks continuous improvement opportunities

  



* Working together


* Has energy and drive
* A sense of urgency
* Motivating individual
* Communicates clearly
* Open to feedback and learning
* Operates ethically
* High level of personal integrity


* Acting with Responsibility


* Can identify core issues and problems
* Emotionally stable and mature
* Accepts feedback
* Coaches others
* Manages responsibilities

  



**Requirements – Experience, Skills, Education and Qualifications**
-------------------------------------------------------------------


* Have a minimum of one year’s experience in similar position, preferably in a luxury environment.
* Excellent communication skills in all aspects.
* To be passionate about delivering the very best recreation, fitness and leisure experience for your residents.
* Approachable, confident, composed, and is able to work well in a team environment.
* Flexible work hours to meet the demands of the operation.
* Good verbal skills in Spanish and English.

title: Publicity Manager
description:
***Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.***

**Who We Are…**

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the *storytellers* bringing our characters to life, the *creators* bringing them to your living rooms and the *dreamers* creating what’s next…


From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.

**Your New Role...**
Join Warner Bros. Pictures and play a pivotal role in shaping and delivering publicity campaigns for the theatrical slate in Spain. Working closely with the Senior Director of Publicity, Italy and Spain, you will ensure campaigns are culturally relevant, aligned with international objectives, and generate meaningful audience engagement and earned media impact.
If you are passionate about entertainment publicity, thrive in a fast\-paced environment and enjoy working across high\-profile film releases, we would love to hear from you.**Your Role Accountabilities*** Oversee Spanish publicity campaigns from strategy through execution, localising global plans to maximise relevance and impact within the Spanish market while identifying creative opportunities that drive earned media coverage and audience engagement.
* Act as the primary publicity contact for Spain, partnering with cross\-functional teams across Marketing, Distribution, Creative, Social, Media and Promotions, while coordinating relationships with filmmakers, talent teams and external PR agencies.
* Lead the planning and delivery of publicity activity in Spain, including talent tours, premieres, special screenings, awards campaigns, film festival participation and other cultural moments that enhance campaign visibility.
* Coordinate talent schedules, oversee tour and junket logistics, and manage supplier negotiations and onboarding processes, including purchase orders, vendor creation and contracts.
* Coordinate the Spanish publicity budget, monitor campaign performance against agreed objectives and KPIs, and provide clear status updates to senior stakeholders.
* Build and maintain strong relationships across print, broadcast, online and influencer media, securing high\-quality editorial coverage and coordinating participation in local and international media opportunities.
* Support publicity strategies for local productions, oversee publicity materials and media monitoring activities, and coordinate the publicity team while supporting their development and ensuring delivery across multiple film titles.

**Qualifications \& Experience*** Extensive experience in publicity, communications or PR within an entertainment company, film studio, media organisation or specialised agency in a management level position.
* Excellent written and spoken English skills with the ability to draft, adapt and present clear communications for local and international stakeholders.
* Strong knowledge of the Spanish media landscape, including entertainment, film, lifestyle, online and influencer media.
* Proven ability to coordinate multiple projects and priorities simultaneously while meeting deadlines.
* Collaborative approach with experience working effectively with internal teams, external agencies, media partners and international offices.

JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  

Associate / Associate Director SCS
  
  

The Role
  
  

We are seeking an Associate/Associate Director to join our EMEA Strategic Capital Solutions team based in London, Madrid or Frankfurt. The team combines our Real Estate Investment Banking and Pan European Capital Markets Sector teams as an integrated, market\-leading platform.
  
We specialise in complex, multi\-stakeholder transactions including large portfolio sales, corporate M\&A, recapitalisations, joint ventures, new funds and structured equity transactions. The team operates from offices in London, Madrid, and Frankfurt, within a highly motivated, high\-performing, investment\-banking\-style environment that values initiative, analytical rigor, and ambition.
  
As Associate/Associate Director, you'll be a trusted member of the team supporting directors throughout the full life cycle of projects. You will play an active role in live client processes, participating in client meetings and maintaining relationships. You'll also mentor analysts, graduates and junior team members, helping develop their financial analysis skills and understanding of the real estate market.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

**Execution Leadership:** Ensure quality and timeliness of all client\-facing materials and transaction documentation while coordinating multiple workstreams, anticipating execution obstacles, and demonstrating ownership of transaction outcomes.
  
  

**Transaction Management:** Manage complex transactions including joint ventures, corporate M\&A, portfolio and asset sales, maintaining clear communication between multiple stakeholders while managing competing priorities across simultaneous transactions.
  
  

**Sector Specialisation Development:** Build depth of market intelligence within preferred asset classes or product types, producing high\-quality sector/product\-specific technical analyses
  
  

**Client\-Facing Capability:** Present marketing materials and transaction updates with professionalism, respond effectively to technical client questions, and serve as point of contact externally.

Sustained excellence across execution responsibilities over 3\+ years
  
Strong financial modeling capabilities \- comfortable building and critically analyzing financial and valuation models and working with complex operating data
  
Sound understanding of financial statements and how operational metrics drive platform / property value
  
Deep market knowledge including submarkets, rental trends, and recent transactions
  
Consistent leadership on transactions
  
Excellent project management and organisational abilities with proven ability to manage multiple workstreams
  
Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills with ability to manage multiple stakeholders
  
Proven track record in independent client relationship management and business development
  
Deep market knowledge including submarkets, rental trends, and recent transactions
  
Meticulous attention to detail
  
Proactive attitude and ability to work independently while contributing to team objectives
  
Ability to mentor and develop junior team members
  
Meticulous attention to detail
  
Expert proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
  
Willingness to travel regularly throughout Europe for client meetings and site inspections
  
Additional European languages are beneficial but not essential

At JLL, we make sure that you become the best version of yourself by helping you realize your full potential in an entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment. Opportunities for career growth and professional development
  
Collaborative and innovative work environment

Global exposure within a leading real estate services firm

description:
Mandarin Oriental Punta Negra, Mallorca is looking for a **Social Media Manager** to join our **Sales \& Marketing Team.**


Are you a master of craft? Do you thrive in a team that succeeds together, demonstrating integrity and respect while acting responsibly? Do you embrace a growth mindset? We invite you to become a fan of the exceptional.


Mandarin Oriental Hotel Group is the award\-winning owner and operator of some of the most luxurious hotels, resorts and residences located in prime destinations around the world, with a strong development pipeline. Increasingly recognised for creating some of the world’s most sought\-after properties, the Group provides legendary service inspired by Asian heritage whilst representing the very cutting\-edge of luxury experiences.


Set against the stunning backdrop of Puerto Portals, Mandarin Oriental Punta Negra pulses with the vibrant spirit of Mallorca. Here, subtle and emotional luxury seamlessly blend with the island’s natural beauty and energy, offering a place where inspiration flows effortlessly. Celebrate the essence of Mallorca through bespoke experiences, dynamic culinary journeys, and rejuvenating wellness \- each designed to immerse you in the island’s vibrant atmosphere and extraordinary offerings.


**About the job**


Based at Mandarin Oriental Punta Negra, Mallorca, as the Social Media Manager, you will be responsible for developing and implementing social media strategies in order to increase online presence and improve marketing and sales efforts of the resort and its outlets. This position works closely with different departments to develop and execute the story telling at the resort.


**As Social Media Manager, you will be responsible for the following duties:**


* With the guidance of the Director of Marketing Communications, design and implement the hotel’s social media and e\-commerce strategy with KPIs.
* Proactively plan creative, compelling, and targeted social media activity and campaigns.
* Stay informed of upcoming trends and developments within the field of social media.
* Research and develop new ways to leverage social content to improve performance.
* Setting KPIs for social media agencies and using relevant social media monitoring tools to manage all the resort’s social channels.
* Conduct competitive analysis of studies on competition and provide recommendations on content changes for the resort’s social channels.
* Oversee and manage all social media accounts for the resort, including each F\&B outlet, while leading community management strategies and daily engagement for every account.
* Prepare and implement the annual social media content strategy in accordance to brand.
* Plan and execute social media influencer campaigns, working closely with local and/or international influencers / KOLs and with the Public Relations agency.
* Collaborate create and execute social media campaigns that will generate leads, drive quality traffic and fans/follower’s engagement.
* Prepare monthly reports on social media for distribution to department heads and executive committee.
* Work closely with various departments to produce quality content for social media.
* Writing, commissioning, and editing materials for a range of key hotel audiences for use across all social media platforms.
* Plan, organize and oversee all social media photography / videography sessions.
**As Social Media Manager, we expect from you:**


Experience and education


* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, eCommerce Management, or a related field.
* Minimum of 2 years of solid experience in a similar role, preferably within the luxury hospitality sector (resort experience is considered a plus).
Technical Skills


* Excellent communication skills with an articulate and compelling communication style.
* Strong writing ability, capable of adapting tone and style to different audiences and communication platforms.
* Proven project management skills with a demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
* Strong attention to detail and organisational skills.
* Creative mindset with the ability to think innovatively and work with flair and imagination.
* Strong communication skills in English and Spanish, both written and spoken.
**Our commitment to you**


* Learning \& Development. Your success is our success. We craft unique learning and development programmes for various stages in your career so that you grow, continuously.
* MOstay. When you work as hard as our colleagues do, it’s important to take time off. As a member of the \#MOfamily, you can stay with us wherever you go in the world. The MOstay programme offers complimentary nights and additionally attractive rates on rooms for you and your loved ones.
* Health \& Colleague Wellness. Finding the right work\-life balance is important. Your wellbeing matters to us. A variety of health benefits and wellness programmes are offered to all our colleagues, globally.
**We’re Fans. Are you?**

description:
Part of the Wolters Kluwer’s CP \& ESG division, our award\-winning CCH® Tagetik expert solution provides the strategic \& financial intelligence platform that enables CFOs and their peers, in global enterprises, to propel their strategy with faster and better\-informed decisions. CCH Tagetik provides a comprehensive, data\-driven, AI\-based CPM platform for Financial Close \& Consolidation, Extended Planning including financial \& operational planning, ESG and Regulatory reporting, and Corporate Tax including Global Minimum Tax. With embedded AI and state\-of\-the\-art governance, the open and extensible platform easily connects leading operational solutions to create enterprise\-wide insights, drive growth, and navigate change for our customers to gain the greatest value, today and tomorrow.

**Role Summary**
----------------


The **Director, SaaS Migration Program Execution**, will be responsible for overseeing the entire migration process for **Wolters Kluwer CCH Tagetik’s existing customer base**. This position will own the transition from legacy deployment and commercial models to the strategic cloud platform and the latest packaging and pricing models. Responsibilities include:

* Managing the migration of commercial models for cloud customers who are still using legacy models.
* Leading both the commercial and technical migration for on\-premise customers.


This role is accountable for converting migration strategy into operational execution, coordinating cross\-functional teams across Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, Cloud Operations, Legal, Finance and Product.


The position requires a highly hands\-on leader capable of driving customer migrations at scale while managing complex customer\-specific situations, particularly within the on\-premise installed base where commercial, contractual, technical and organizational complexity is highest.


The role serves as the central point of accountability for migration outcomes, capacity planning, execution governance, risk management, and business value realization.

**Key responsibilities:**

**Migration portfolio management**

* Own the global SaaS migration portfolio, maintaining a consolidated view of all migration opportunities across customer cohorts and geographies.
* Translate migration strategy into executable annual and quarterly migration plans, customer migration waves and measurable business outcomes.
* Own customer prioritization, migration sequencing and cohort governance, continuously reassessing customer readiness, migration complexity and commercial opportunity throughout the migration lifecycle.
* Recalibrate migration priorities and customer cohorts based on new customer information, migration outcomes and changing business priorities.

**Migration program leadership**

* Lead execution of the global SaaS migration roadmap across all migration cohorts and regions.
* Establish and operate the Migration Execution Office as the central coordination function across Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, Consulting Partners, Cloud Operations, Finance, Legal and Product.
* Orchestrate end\-to\-end execution across all participating functions, ensuring effective planning, dependency management, handovers and accountability throughout the migration process.
* Ensure migration execution remains aligned with strategic objectives, customer commitments, available capacity and financial targets.
* Drive consistent execution through standardized migration methodologies, operational playbooks, templates and governance processes.

**Migration governance \& performance management**

* Establish and facilitate the governance structure supporting the migration program including executive decision forums, operational reviews and performance reporting.
* Define, monitor and continuously improve migration KPIs, dashboards and reporting to provide transparency on migration progress, customer status, commercial outcomes, delivery performance and business case realization.
* Identify systemic bottlenecks, operational risks and recurring execution challenges, driving corrective actions across the organization.
* Own migration exception management, ensuring customer, commercial, contractual, technical and operational escalations are resolved efficiently and consistently.
* Ensure adherence to commercial guardrails, approval processes, pricing governance and migration policies.

**Capacity planning \& execution readiness**

* Define migration capacity requirements across Professional Services, Consulting Partners, Cloud Operations and supporting functions, balancing migration demand with available delivery resources.
* Ensure migration readiness across all participating functions prior to each migration wave, including resource availability, governance, customer preparation and operational planning.
* Provide executive recommendations on resource allocation, outsourcing opportunities, partner utilization and execution scalability.

**Customer migration execution**

**On\-premise customer migration (technical \& commercial)**

* Oversee end\-to\-end execution of commercial and technical migrations from customer qualification through technical assessment, commercial design, implementation, testing, product transition and post\-go\-live optimization.
* Coordinate cross\-functional delivery teams throughout the migration lifecycle while proactively resolving delivery risks and execution blockers.
* Ensure consistent execution quality across regions through standardized migration methodologies and operational standards.

**Cloud customer migration (commercial)**

* Lead the commercial migration program for existing cloud customers transitioning to the new packaging and pricing model.
* Partner with Sales and Renewal teams to execute structured, cohort\-based commercial migrations aligned to predefined customer lifecycle triggers such as renewals, cloud expansion opportunities and cross\-sell events.
* Balance customer retention, migration velocity, commercial standardization and ARR realization while ensuring compliance with commercial governance and negotiation guardrails.

**Continuous improvement**

* Capture lessons learned from completed migration waves and incorporate them into future migration planning, execution standards and governance processes.
* Continuously improve migration methodologies, planning assumptions, operational playbooks, reporting and customer engagement models.
* Drive increased standardization and scalability of migration execution while maintaining flexibility for strategic customer situations.
* Identify opportunities to automate, simplify and optimize migration processes across commercial and technical functions.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Minimum Bachelor’s in Engineering, Information Technology, Business or related field.
* 10\+ years of experience leading large\-scale transformation, cloud migration, SaaS transition or customer lifecycle programs.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex enterprise customer implementations and migrations.
* Strong program management, stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
* Proven ability to lead cross\-functional teams in a matrix organization.
* Experience driving operational execution across commercial, technical and services organizations.

**Preferred**

* Experience managing global customer transformation programs.
* Knowledge of cloud migration methodologies and enterprise application modernization.
* Familiarity with commercial transformation, pricing migrations and customer retention programs

**Critical success measures**

* Migration wave execution versus plan.
* On\-prem ARR converted to cloud ARR.
* Customer retention during migration.
* Migration cycle time and throughput.
* Delivery capacity utilization.
* Business case realization.
* Executive stakeholder satisfaction.

title: IT Business Analyst - LIMS Process Expert
description:
**Company Description** ***Why are we here?***


Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic, and labelling is accurate.


Eurofins is dedicated to delivering testing services that contribute to the health and safety of society and the planet, and to its corporate responsibility to protect the environment and ensure diversity, equity, and inclusion across the entire network of Eurofins companies.

 **Job Description** **In a nutshell**


As a **Business Analyst, expert in LIMS Processes,** you will support our in‑house chromatography data processing application. You will translate laboratory and business requirements into clear deliverables, optimize analytical workflows for quality and efficiency, and ensure compliance with major EU environmental testing laboratory standards.


You’ will partner with laboratory leaders, product and engineering teams, finance, and commercial stakeholders to standardize processes and guide delivery of features that streamline instrument data capture, processing, quality control (QC), technical review, and reporting across hyphenated and non\-hyphenated analytical workflows (gas chromatography GC, liquid chromatography LC, inductively coupled plasma ICP and mass spectrometry (MS).

**Where will you be based and what business will you support?**


Based in Madrid, Spain; you will join a globally distributed team in support of our European Environmental Testing business, with a primary focus on chromatography data processing application.

**How can you help us?**


You will work on the following main areas:

**Strategy \& Operational Analysis, to:**

* Assess the EU Environmental Testing market, regulatory expectations, and laboratory operational data to identify opportunities for efficiency, quality improvement, and margin enhancement.
* Support EU‑focused pricing, client segmentation, and demand modeling to guide product and investment priorities.
* Recommend improvements to enhance turnaround time (TAT), analytical quality, data reliability, and regulatory alignment.

**Product / Requirements Ownership (Chromatography Data System Software), to:**

* Serve as primary liaison between EU laboratory stakeholders and the Product Development team.
* Elicit, document, and refine Business Requirements, User Requirements, and acceptance criteria (including non‑functional needs like performance and usability).
* Maintain and update process documentation, including BRD (Business Requirements Document), URD (User Requirements Document), and BPMN (Business Process Model \& Notation).
* Collaborate with Product Development team to translate requirements into functional designs; help groom backlogs and support release scoping.
* Lead EU‑regional user acceptance testing (UAT), business sign‑off, and change management for new features and workflow updates.

**Cross‑Functional Business Support, to:**

* Partner with laboratory directors, technical leads, and product teams across the EU to harmonize chromatography data workflows.
* Facilitate workshops with subject matter experts (SMEs) to challenge assumptions, streamline workflows, and improve cross‑site alignment.
* Build and maintain strong relationships across operations, R\&D, quality, IT, and commercial units.

**Process Optimization \& Quality Alignment, to:**

* Map current vs. future‑state EU laboratory workflows; identify gaps, risks, and compliance needs.
* Ensure alignment with Eurofins Quality System Documents (SOPs, methods, work instructions).
* Ensure processes, requirements, and software workflows comply with key EU laboratory frameworks, including: ISO/IEC 17025, EU Ecolabel testing requirements, and EU Member State national accreditation bodies operating under EA (European co‑operation for Accreditation)
* Support audit preparation, nonconformity resolution, CAPAs, and continuous improvement.
* Track corrective actions and measure system/process impact post‑deployment.

**Data, Reporting \& Financial Insight, to:**

* Build dashboards (performance, throughput, error rates, QC metrics, method performance, adoption/usage).
* Support budgeting, forecasting, and operational reviews with EU‑specific actionable insights.
* Validate product requirements with data, quantify product value, and measure outcomes.

  

**Qualifications** **Are you our kind of extraordinary?**

**You have:**

* A Bachelor’s degree in Business, Science, Engineering, IT, or related field.
* 3\+ years as a Business Analyst or Product Owner/Analyst in software, laboratory operations, or scientific environments.
* Experience writing user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional documentation in an Agile environment (e.g., Jira/Confluence).
* Familiarity with laboratory informatics such as LIMS (Laboratory Information Management System) and CDS (Chromatography Data System).
* Excellent communication and facilitation skills across multi‑cultural EU teams.
* Working knowledge of EU environmental testing compliance frameworks, including but not limited to: ISO/IEC 17025, EU Ecolabel requirements, and European Accreditation (EA)
* Strong stakeholder management and interpersonal skills
* Strong analytical skills; proficiency in Excel (SQL/BI tools a plus).

**You are:**

* A strong communicator in English (written/oral).
* A fast learner.
* Self\-motivated with a can\-do attitude.

**What else should I know?**

**The following skills are an advantage:**

* Experience in environmental (chromatography workflows is a plus), food, agroscience or biopharma testing and laboratory operations in EU‑regulated scientific environments.
* Experience building BPMN workflows and writing functional specifications.
* Exposure to LIMS, CDS, or scientific data management platforms; understanding of instrument integration.
* MBA, M.Sc., or advanced scientific/technical degree.

  

**Additional Information** **We support your development!** Do you feel you don’t match 100% of the requirements? Don’t hesitate to apply anyway! Eurofins companies are committed to supporting your career development.

**We embrace diversity!** Eurofins network of companies believe in strength and innovation through diversity, being an Equal Opportunity Employer. We prohibit discrimination against employees or applications based on gender identity and/or expression, race, nationality, age, religion, sexual orientation, disability, and everything else that makes employees of Eurofins companies unique.

**Sustainability matters to us!** We are well on our way to achieving our objective of carbon neutrality by 2025, through a combination of emission reduction and compensation initiatives. We encourage our laboratory leaders to make sustainable changes at their local level, and in addition to their initiatives we also count on our dedicated carbon reduction team to help us to achieve this goal!

**Find out more in our career page: https://careers.eurofins.com/**

**Company description:** Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.


The Eurofins network of companies is the global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and agroscience contract research services. It is one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies, as well as having an emerging global presence in Contract Development and Manufacturing Organisations. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in\-vitro diagnostic products.


In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to 65,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of over 950 laboratories in 60 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.


In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6,95 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

Croatia, Spain or the Netherlands

title: Platform Engineer
description:
**Platform Engineer**


Job Description


**1\. Objective**
=================


Deliver a multi\-cloud and edge platform on which Holcim's business products are developed and run, at enterprise quality and startup efficiency.


The measurable outcome is product teams building, deploying and operating independently, on infrastructure that is secure, reliable, compliant and cost\-effective.


The role sits within Group IT and delivers through the organisation, not around it: in close collaboration with product teams, corporate security, legal and data privacy, finance, and regional and global IT, and aligned with Holcim policies, standards and legal framework.


**2\. Scope**
=============


**Cloud**  

GCP (primary), AWS  

  

**Edge**  

Industrial plant sites worldwide  

  

**Platform estate**  

\~100 platform services across 10 technical domains, \~30 environments  

  

**Consumers**  

\~55 business products, 30\+ product teams operating in self\-service  

  

**Platform framework**  

In\-house engineering platform: policy\-as\-code provisioning across all managed services, self\-service interfaces for product teams, safety gates, state verification and immutable audit evidence  

  

**Operating model**  

Architecture principles and reference designs, engineering standards and naming policy, specification and peer\-review process, verification and validation records, document taxonomy, master data registries, multi\-jurisdiction legal and compliance framework  

  

**Team**  

6 engineers  

  

**Technical domains:** compute, networking, data storage, data pipelines, edge infrastructure, identity and access, security, secrets management, CI/CD, developer tooling, observability, cost engineering, platform framework.


**3\. Professional Standard**
=============================


The role is defined for experienced engineers who work to a professional standard focused on results not tasks. These expectations apply at both levels and are assessed during selection and in the annual review.


**Results**
-----------


* Delivers a predictable volume of work across the year, and holds it under pressure.
* Measured by outcomes delivered, not activity performed.
* Reduces the team's total workload through simplification and automation.
* Unblocks colleagues rather than becoming a dependency.

**Quality**
-----------


* Work is correct, verifiable and maintainable. Rework is the exception.
* Non\-trivial work is specified in writing and peer\-reviewed before implementation.
* Documented to the standard another engineer needs to operate and extend it.
* Root causes are fixed in code and configuration. Alerts, workarounds and manual procedures are not permanent solutions.

**Customer orientation**
------------------------


* Product teams are the customer. Their ability to work independently is the measure of whether a service is finished.
* Understands the business purpose of the work and challenges requests that would not achieve it.
* Recurring support demand is a design defect to remove, not a workload to absorb.
* Commits to timeframes and flags slippage before the deadline, not after.

**Engineering practice**
------------------------


* Applies established practice by default: infrastructure as code, policy as code, version control, testing, peer review, least privilege, defence in depth, documented decisions.
* Keeps current with cloud platform and tooling evolution and brings improvements into the team.
* Works within the standards framework and improves it. Working around it is not an alternative.

**Original thinking**
---------------------


* Proposes new approaches where existing ones are inadequate, and challenges solutions that no longer fit.
* Ideas are anchored in the expected result, the real constraints and established practice — not novelty for its own sake.
* Simplification counts. Removing a system, a step or a dependency is worth as much as adding a capability.
* Innovation is delivered inside Holcim's standards and policy framework.

**Proactive planning**
----------------------


* Scopes ambiguous requirements, sequences the work, identifies dependencies and risks, and commits to deliverables and dates before starting.
* Estimates against real available capacity, not optimistic capacity.
* Raises capacity limits, expiring dependencies, security exposure and architectural risk before they become incidents.
* Identifies what needs improving and drives it, rather than waiting to be assigned.

**Professional maturity**
-------------------------


* Owns outcomes, not tasks. Where resolution depends on another team, drives it to closure there.
* Communicates facts early and accurately, including when the news is bad.
* Disagrees with reasoning, then commits to the decision taken.
* Remains composed and methodical during incidents.

None of this is unusual at senior level. It is stated explicitly because the team is small, flat, and has no supervisory layer to compensate when any of it is missing.


**4\. Key Responsibilities**
============================


**Platform Framework and Automation**
-------------------------------------


* Provision and manage cloud and edge infrastructure end to end as code — networking, compute, storage, databases, identity, secrets.
* Develop and extend the in\-house platform framework that provisions, configures and governs every platform service: policy enforcement at authoring time, safety gates and dry\-run control ahead of destructive operations, verification of intended against actual state, and immutable audit evidence.
* Encode standards and procedures as executable controls, so non\-compliant configurations cannot be created rather than being detected afterwards.
* Build and maintain the self\-service interfaces through which product teams provision and configure their own resources, without a ticket and without platform\-team involvement.
* Contribute reusable tooling, templates and shared components that other engineers and product teams adopt.
* Peer\-review other engineers' specifications and code.

**Architecture**
----------------


* Design platform architecture and capacity across cloud and edge.
* Design network architecture: VPC, DNS, load balancing, NAT, VPN, interconnect, private connectivity, firewall rules.
* Design identity and access architecture: IAM model, service account governance, access enforcement.
* Design security architecture: WAF, key management, secrets, endpoint protection, vulnerability management.
* Evaluate and select cloud services and technologies; maintain the platform technology stack.
* Produce and maintain architecture documentation and decision records.

**Operations**
--------------


* Operate the services you design and build, across their full lifecycle.
* Lead infrastructure incident response: diagnosis, root cause analysis, resolution, post\-incident review.
* Design and maintain monitoring, logging, tracing and alerting across all environments.
* Plan and execute preventive maintenance, patching, upgrades and security remediation.
* Manage platform cost: sizing, optimisation, cost reporting per product.

**Product Team Enablement**
---------------------------


* Act as technical contact for assigned product teams.
* Onboard product teams onto platform services and self\-service capabilities.
* Diagnose and resolve platform\-side integration issues.

**Standards, Governance and Compliance**
----------------------------------------


* Apply and maintain the engineering standards, procedures and templates that govern all platform work.
* Produce and maintain architecture documentation, runbooks, playbooks and service documentation.
* Maintain traceability from ticket to implementation to audit record.
* Support audit and compliance evidence across GDPR, NIS2, ISO 27001 and local regulatory requirements.
* Work with corporate security, legal, data privacy and global IT on controls that span organisational boundaries.

**5\. Additional Responsibilities — Lead Platform Engineer**
============================================================


The Lead level additionally carries the product\-facing engineering scope.


**Product Architecture and Standards**
--------------------------------------


* Define product architecture standards, patterns and reference implementations.
* Review and approve product architecture at the architecture review gate, before development starts.
* Own the approved technology catalogue for product teams: technologies, versions and configurations supported.
* Define coding standards, design patterns and CI/CD pipeline patterns used by product teams.
* Define and validate the resource and access model for each product workload.

**Technical Leadership**
------------------------


* Act as primary technical reference for platform architecture decisions.
* Set direction for platform operations, performance, security posture and cost.
* Coach product teams on engineering quality and secure development practice.
* Mentor engineers through architecture, worked example and peer review.

**6\. Required Qualifications**
===============================


* **Planning and foresight.** Takes an ambiguous requirement, determines what it actually requires, sequences the work, identifies dependencies and risks, and commits to deliverables and dates before starting. Assessed explicitly during selection.
* **Production software development in Python.** Maintained, peer\-reviewed modules that other engineers depend on.
* **Production ownership of cloud infrastructure,** including accountability for incident response and root cause resolution.
* **Infrastructure and policy as code** across the full delivery path — provisioning, configuration, deployment, verification, evidence.
* **Breadth across technical domains.** No single\-domain specialisation, and no second\-line team to escalate to.
* **Written technical communication** that product owners, security architects and peer reviewers can act on without rework.

**7\. Preferred Qualifications**
================================


* GCP at design depth: IAM, networking, data services, security and cost modelling.
* Network architecture: VPC design, DNS, load balancing, private connectivity, firewalling.
* Linux and container operations at diagnostic level.
* CI/CD pipeline design and implementation.
* AWS, edge computing, or industrial/OT environments.
* Manufacturing, plant or industrial context.
* Regulated or multi\-jurisdiction environments (GDPR, NIS2, ISO 27001\).
* Terraform, Ansible or equivalent infrastructure\-as\-code tooling.

title: Sr. Identity and Access Management Engineer
description:
### **Strength in Trust**



OneTrust's mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn't slow teams down—it should accelerate what's possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016\. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.

### **The Challenge**



As a Senior IAM Engineer, you will design, build, and operate core identity security capabilities across the enterprise. This includes **Identity Governance \& Administration (IGA) architecture**, **Privileged Access Management (PAM)**, and **secrets management**, as well as the automation and integrations that enable secure access at scale.



This role is responsible for **multiple areas of IAM** (not just a single platform), and will contribute at a strategy, design, and execution level—partnering with Security, IT, and Engineering teams to deliver secure, reliable identity services.


### **Your Mission**


**IAM / IGA Architecture \& Engineering**


* Architect and implement **IGA capabilities** including identity lifecycle (joiner/mover/leaver), access request workflows, approvals, provisioning/deprovisioning automation, certifications, and role/entitlement governance.
* Design and maintain the **identity lifecycle management (ILM) framework and controls** across the environment.
* Build and enhance IAM integrations (e.g., HR source, directories, SaaS apps) using industry standards (SCIM, SAML/OIDC, APIs) and automation patterns.

**Privileged Access Management (PAM) \& Secrets Management**


* Engineer and mature **PAM controls** and operating processes for privileged identities and activities, including access request/approval patterns, time\-bound elevation, auditing, and least privilege enforcement.
* Implement and manage **secrets management** capabilities (vaulting, rotation, access control, auditability) for human and non\-human identities, including service principals and automation identities.

**Scripting, Automation, and Development**


* Develop automation using **scripting and software engineering practices** (e.g., PowerShell/Python/Bash), including CI/CD\-friendly workflows and infrastructure\-as\-code patterns (e.g., Terraform).
* Create repeatable solutions for access governance, role engineering, connector onboarding, reporting/analytics, and operational runbooks.

**Operations, Incident Support, and Continuous Improvement**


* Respond to IAM operational work (tickets/requests) requiring engineering changes and enhancements.
* Assist in investigation and remediation of IAM incidents and issues, improving controls and automation to prevent recurrence.
* Conduct proofs\-of\-concept (POCs), partner with vendors, and recommend solutions aligned to security and business requirements.

**Collaboration, Advisory, and Documentation**


* Serve as a trusted advisor to stakeholders—translating complex IAM topics into clear recommendations and implementation plans.
* Produce and maintain technical documentation, standards, and procedures supporting audits and operational readiness.
* Mentor peers and positively influence the team's technical direction.

**Required Technical Skills (Must Have)**


* **IGA architecture \& engineering expertise** (identity lifecycle, RBAC/ABAC concepts, access reviews/certifications, entitlement modeling, SoD/least privilege).
* **Privileged Access Management (PAM)** concepts and hands\-on implementation (JIT/JEA, session controls, privileged identity separation, auditing).
* **Secrets management** (vaulting, rotation, access policies, non\-human identity security).
* **Scripting and development skills** (e.g., SQL, JavaScript, PowerShell, Python, Velocity, SOAPUI, ARC, Postman, Java/J2EE, Bash; API integration; Git\-based workflows).
* Experience designing and operating IAM controls in modern enterprise environments (cloud \+ SaaS) \- especially Azure, including authentication/authorization and identity governance patterns.

**Preferred Skills (Nice to Have)**


* Experience with IGA platforms (e.g., Saviynt, SailPoint, Omada) and IAM directories/IDPs (e.g., Entra ID/Azure AD).
* Experience with PAM and secrets tooling (e.g., CyberArk, Delinea, BeyondTrust, Akeyless, HashiCorp Vault, Azure Key Vault, AWS Secrets Manager).
* Familiarity with compliance frameworks and evidence collection for audits (SOX/SOC2/ISO27001\-style controls).

We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced Transfer Pricing Manager to join us and work in a truly global environment. The position will lead the implementation, governance, and ongoing management of the division’s Transactional Net Margin Method (TNMM) transfer pricing model, embedding the framework into daily operational processes, ensuring accurate execution within business systems, and establishing sustainable controls and monitoring procedures.


**Volcafe Ltd** is one of the world’s leading international green coffee trading companies, operating in over 20 countries globally. Our expertise spans green coffee procurement and preparation, sustainability, blending, quality control, risk management and export as well as importing and distribution. We supply the world’s major coffee roasters and retail distributors with their green coffee requirements, with significant strategic growth ambitions for the future.


Volcafe works across the whole green coffee supply chain to make coffee business better, together with our partners and employees. We have built and operate sustainable coffee supply chains across all our origins, addressing key economic, social and environmental issues in coffee farming communities. Our Volcafe Way farmer support programme engages with thousands of coffee farmers and provides a holistic response to the challenges they face.


This role can be located from various our European locations, including Winterthur Madrid, Bremen or Amsterdam**.**


We are part of **Hartree Partners, LP** a leading global merchant commodities firm facilitating the flow of energy, metals, agriculture, and environmental products across the full commodity supply chain, connecting producers and consumers. Hartree was founded in 1997, is jointly owned by senior management and funds managed by Oaktree Capital Management, LP, and employs around 5,000 individuals worldwide.


**Key Accountabilities**

* Lead the end\-to\-end implementation and ongoing management of the division’s TNMM transfer pricing model across multiple legal entities and jurisdictions, ensuring consistent and effective operational execution.
* Translate transfer pricing policies into practical operational processes and system requirements, working closely with Finance, Tax, IT and Commercial teams to embed transfer pricing mechanisms into ERP and reporting systems.
* Develop and implement automated solutions for transfer pricing calculations, monitoring and adjustments, reducing manual intervention and improving data quality, consistency and efficiency.
* Monitor financial performance against target margins and profitability ranges, identifying deviations and coordinating corrective actions, including periodic true\-up and true\-down calculations and related accounting entries.
* Establish robust governance, controls, monitoring procedures and audit trails to ensure alignment between transfer pricing policies, financial reporting and operational execution.
* Lead the development of transfer pricing functionality across ERP and Microsoft tools, collaborating with IT teams and external providers to deliver scalable, sustainable and fit\-for\-purpose solutions.
* Develop dashboards and management reporting to provide clear visibility of transfer pricing performance, profitability outcomes, adjustments and key areas requiring management attention.
* Act as the central point of contact for operational transfer pricing matters across the Coffee Division, providing guidance and support to local finance teams and ensuring consistent application of the transfer pricing framework.
* Coordinate closely with Group Tax, Divisional Finance, Local Finance, IT and Commercial stakeholders to drive effective implementation, resolve operational issues and ensure timely execution of required actions.
* Communicate transfer pricing impacts, performance and required actions clearly to senior stakeholders, translating complex technical concepts into practical business implications and recommendations.
* Support transfer pricing audits and documentation requirements where necessary, ensuring appropriate data, controls and supporting evidence are maintained across relevant entities and processes.
* Drive continuous improvement across transfer pricing processes, systems and controls, identifying opportunities to enhance automation, data governance, reporting quality and operational efficiency.
* Provide strategic and practical transfer pricing expertise across the business, balancing OECD requirements and transfer pricing policy with the realities of finance processes, systems and day\-to\-day commercial operations.
* Lead cross\-functional projects and transformation initiatives, applying strong project management, analytical and problem\-solving skills to deliver sustainable transfer pricing solutions in a complex international environment.

* Minimum of 8 years’ experience within a global commodity trading environment, with significant exposure to operational transfer pricing.
* Strong practical expertise in the Transactional Net Margin Method (TNMM), with proven experience implementing and managing TNMM models across multiple entities and jurisdictions.
* Strong understanding of the OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines, operational transfer pricing concepts, profitability monitoring, transfer pricing adjustments and policy implementation.
* Proven experience implementing transfer pricing solutions within ERP environments and translating transfer pricing requirements into practical, sustainable system and process solutions.
* Strong understanding of finance processes, management reporting and controlling, with the ability to connect transfer pricing requirements with broader finance and business processes.

* Comfortable working in a complex, international and matrix organisation, coordinating multiple stakeholders and delivering consistent outcomes across different markets and legal entities.

title: Remote Part-Time Senior General Manager - Operations & Growth
description:
Part\-Time Senior General Manager \- Operations \& Growth

Levels Education Ltd

Predominantly Remote / London

Part Time 3 Days per week

Estimated annual earnings: £28,000–£30,000

£29–£31 per hour \| PAYE employmentApprox. 3 days per week during term time, with substantially reduced school\-holiday hours

Levels Education is a growing extracurricular education company delivering specialist programmes to more than 30 schools across the UK and internationally.

We are looking for an experienced Part\-Time Senior General Manager in charge of Operations \& Growth to take genuine ownership of the day\-to\-day running and continued growth of the business.

This is not a traditional administrative role. We are looking for someone senior, highly capable and commercially minded who can independently oversee our operations, maintain excellent relationships with our schools and help drive the next stage of our growth.

The role

You will become the central operational point of contact for the business and take ownership of:

* Coach scheduling, timetables and cover
* Recruiting and onboarding coaches
* School timetables, term dates and programme launches
* Relationships with existing school clients
* Resolving day\-to\-day school and operational issues
* Onboarding new schools
* Safeguarding, compliance and operational administration
* Invoicing, payment reconciliation and day\-to\-day bookkeeping
* Maintaining accurate records in FreeAgent and liaising with our accountant
* Monitoring outstanding payments and coach invoices
* Managing our CRM and school outreach pipeline
* Following up prospective schools and arranging meetings and taster sessions
* Preparing proposals and supporting renewals
* Identifying opportunities to introduce additional programmes into existing schools
* Supporting expansion into new schools, regions and international markets
* Providing the Director with a concise weekly overview of operations, finances, opportunities and issues requiring escalation

Working pattern

Our business follows the academic calendar, so working hours vary throughout the year.

During school terms, the role will typically involve approximately 3 days per week.

Working hours are substantially reduced during school holidays.

Easter and July involve reduced hours, primarily focused on school renewals, onboarding, recruitment, business development and preparation for the following term.

Most of August has minimal working requirements, with activity increasing towards the end of the month as we prepare for September.

You will be paid for the hours worked each month at £29–£31 per hour through PAYE. Monthly pay will therefore naturally be lower during quieter school\-holiday periods and higher during term time.

Based on the anticipated working pattern, we estimate annual gross earnings of approximately £28,000–£30,000, although actual earnings will depend on the hours worked across the year.

The position is predominantly remote with some London onsite visits required and offers considerable flexibility in how working hours are arranged.

During term time, you should also be comfortable responding to occasional genuinely urgent operational matters outside your normal working days, such as a last\-minute coach absence or urgent school matter. This is not intended to be an always\-on role.

About you

We are looking for someone who is:

* Exceptionally organised and proactive
* Commercially minded
* Comfortable managing multiple moving parts simultaneously
* Confident communicating with senior school staff and clients
* Comfortable making sensible decisions independently
* Comfortable managing coaches, contractors and other team members
* Financially literate and comfortable with basic bookkeeping
* Confident using spreadsheets, CRM systems and cloud\-based business software
* Calm and effective when unexpected problems need resolving quickly
* Interested in helping improve systems and processes as the company grows

Ideally, you will have previous experience in general management, operations, education, children’s activities or another multi\-site service business.

Experience within education or extracurricular activities would be particularly valuable, although it is not essential.

Bonus points if you have a sporting or creative skill you are passionate about!

About Levels Education

Levels Education was founded by former professional parkour athlete Barry He and has grown into a multi\-school extracurricular education provider working with leading independent and international schools.

We deliver specialist sporting and alternative creative activities including Parkour and Magic and are continuing to expand across the UK and internationally.

For the right person, this is an opportunity to become a genuinely important part of a growing business rather than filling a narrow administrative position.

We are looking for someone who wants genuine responsibility, autonomy and flexibility while helping run and grow the company.

Contact Clubs@Levelseducation.co.uk

Estimated annual earnings: £28,000–£30,000 \| £29–£31 per hour \| PAYE employment

title: Mid-level Artist - Architectural Visualisation
description:
#### **About Us**


For over two decades, The Boundary has been at the forefront of digital excellence. With a global team of 150\+ experts across London, New York, Dubai, and Auckland, we partner with the world's leading developers to deliver unparalleled architectural storytelling.


Founded by award\-winning architects, our work sits at the intersection of design intuition and technical mastery. From pioneering digital twin infrastructure to the seamless integration of AI and real\-time technology, we don’t just anticipate the future of the industry; we are already building it.

#### **The Opportunity**


You know that feeling when a scene finally clicks? The composition settles, the light does exactly what it needs to do, and the image becomes more than a technically accurate model. It becomes a place people can believe in.


For over two decades, we've been making images of places that don't exist yet \- and making people feel them. Stills, films, VR experiences. Work that helps architects, developers and brands turn an idea into something people understand, remember and want to be part of.


That's the standard. That's what keeps us interested.


We're a studio of artists, directors, technical pioneers and obsessives. People who care about the fall of light at 4pm. Or whether a material feels touched by real life. Or the fine line between an image that's polished and one that's genuinely convincing.

#### **What we're really looking for**


We need someone who's moved beyond the basics and is ready to own their part of the work.


You can take a brief, drawings and references and turn them into a strong visual response. You understand composition, light, materials and atmosphere \- and you know that technical skill only matters when it serves the story.


You can work with minimal supervision, manage a project component from setup through delivery and spot problems before they become blockers. You know when to solve something yourself and when asking the right question will move the whole team forward faster.


You're comfortable with feedback because you know it makes the work better. And you're beginning to give useful feedback too \- sharing what you know with junior artists without ego or fuss.


You're reliable when timelines tighten and priorities shift. You stay organised, communicate clearly and keep the quality high without losing sight of the deadline.

#### **What You'll Do**

**Create work with impact.** You'll deliver high\-quality architectural visualisation across stills, animation and VR, translating creative direction and technical information into images that feel clear, compelling and real.

**Own your part of the project.** You'll independently manage assigned scenes, sequences or project components \- planning your time, tracking milestones and taking the work through review to final delivery.

**Solve the problems in front of you.** You'll identify and resolve technical and creative issues efficiently, self\-check your work and escalate early when a decision or extra support is needed.

**Keep everyone connected.** You'll work closely with senior leads, project managers, artists, clients and external partners, communicating progress, blockers and handovers clearly.

**Make the team stronger.** You'll support junior artists and interns, share techniques and pipeline knowledge, and contribute thoughtful feedback in critiques and peer reviews.

**Protect the process.** You'll maintain clean files and scenes, follow best\-practice workflows and help improve consistency across the production pipeline.

#### **What You'll Bring**

**A portfolio that shows your judgement.** Not just polished images, but work that demonstrates composition, light, materials, atmosphere and your ability to translate a brief into a visual story.

**Proven production experience.** You'll have delivered work for 3D environments and understand the end\-to\-end CGI workflow well enough to manage your own tasks and support others.

**Strong technical skills.** A confident working knowledge of Autodesk 3ds Max, Corona Renderer and Adobe Creative Cloud, along with the general technical fluency to learn new tools as projects evolve.

**Independent thinking.** You can work through complex tasks with minimal supervision, anticipate issues and turn difficult projects into useful learning.

**Clear communication.** You can explain progress, decisions and technical concepts to colleagues, clients and external stakeholders \- and adapt your approach to the person in front of you.

**Leadership without the title.** You're happy to guide junior artists, share what you know and help a small team deliver under the direction of senior leads.

**That thing you can't teach.** You care about the work, the people around you and getting the details right. It matters to you.

#### **What we'll give you**

**The setup to do your best work.** Clear creative direction, capable production support and experienced senior artists and leads who share your standards.

**More ownership.** Real responsibility for meaningful parts of ambitious projects, with the backing to make decisions, solve problems and see your work through.

**Support to evolve.** Space to deepen your craft, test better approaches and build the creative and leadership skills that will take you to the next level.

**Open conversations.** Kind, specific feedback and fast decisions that keep the work moving and help you keep improving.

**A global creative community.** Access to brilliant people across our studios, bringing different perspectives, specialist skills and new ways of working.

**Trust.** You'll have autonomy over your work, accountability for the outcome and support when you need it.

#### **Benefits**

* Mental Health \& Wellbeing support through HealthShield and SpectrumLife
* Great learning \& development opportunities
* Fun and collaborative office environment in Camden
* Long service leave policy (one extra day of leave for every year of service)
* ️‍️ Corporate Gym Scheme
* Monthly health and wellness allowance
* ️ Remote working policy
* Regular team events and social activities
* Dog friendly office
