title: Director, Creative Services - Pottery Barn
description:
**Job Description**
**About the Photo Direction Team**
 Housed within Pottery Barn’s Creative department, the Photo Direction team translates the brand’s creative
   

  

 vision into compelling photography and videography that inspires our customers to decorate, entertain, and
   

  

 live beautifully in a home that reflects their individual style.
   

  

 Supporting Pottery Barn’s omni\-channel business, the team concepts, develops and executes the photographic vision for each season, creating beautiful, distinctive and consistently on\-brand imagery across digital, social, print, marketing, advertising and in\-store channels. We foster a highly collaborative, creative and positive environment and partner closely across Creative, Product Development, Merchandising, E\-Commerce, Video and Social Media.
   

  

**Overview Of The Creative Director Role**
 The Creative Director is a senior creative leader responsible for driving and creating Pottery Barn’s seasonal
   

  

 photographic vision, ensuring that the brand’s visual expression is distinctive, inspiring and consistent
   

  

 across every customer touchpoint.
   

  

 Working closely with the Senior Vice President of Creative and Vice President of Creative and Photography,
   

  

 the Creative Director translates brand, product and seasonal direction into compelling visual concepts and
   

  

 establishes the creative framework that guides photography, video and related content.
   

  

 This role sees the big picture and is also responsible for executing the details. You are a
   

  

 sophisticated visual storyteller with a strong point of view on interiors, decorating, photography, styling and
   

  

 culture—and understand where Pottery Barn sits in that intersection.
   

  

 You also understand how to translate product and brand ideas into imagery that creates emotion,
   

  

 communicates a clear point of view and ultimately builds desire for the Pottery Barn brand. You have the ability to
   

  

 create compelling individual images while simultaneously knowing how to create cohesive images that form a campaign.
   

  

 The Creative Director leads and inspires Art Directors and extended creative teams while partnering with
   

  

 photographers, stylists, producers, set designers and cross\-functional leaders to bring seasonal campaigns
   

  

 and ongoing brand storytelling to life.
   

  

 You will report to the Vice President, Creative and Photography and work closely with the Senior Vice
   

  

 President of Creative.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Partner with the SVP and VP of Creative to establish the overarching photographic and visual direction for seasonal campaigns, brand initiatives and key storytelling moments.

* Translate seasonal product and brand direction into a clear creative vision that establishes the overall mood, storytelling approach, visual language and photographic point of view.
* With oversight from Vice President, Creative and Photography, lead the development and review of seasonal Creative Briefs, ensuring concepts reflect the intended brand vision and provide clear direction for Art Directors, photographers, stylists, producers and other creative partners.
* Establish and maintain Pottery Barn's photographic standards and overall visual "look and feel," ensuring consistency while continually evolving the brand's imagery.
* Provide creative leadership across multiple campaigns, shoots and seasonal chapters, maintaining a holistic view of how individual assets work together to create a cohesive customer experience.
* Guide Art Directors in developing decorating concepts, styling direction, camera approaches, lighting, set design and other visual elements that bring the approved creative direction to life.
* Partner with the VP Creative on photographer, stylist and creative talent selection based on the needs and visual objectives of each campaign.
* Review and guide set concepts and environmental storytelling to ensure rooms and spaces communicate a strong Pottery Barn point of view and appropriately showcase product.
* Provide senior\-level creative direction during key photography and video shoots, guiding mood, tone, composition, lighting, styling and overall visual execution.
* Inspire and develop Art Directors and broader creative teams, providing clear feedback, mentorship and creative guidance while fostering a collaborative and high\-performing environment.
* Build productive creative partnerships with photographers, stylists, producers, digital artists, set builders and other external and internal creative talent.
* Partner closely with Merchandising and Product Development to ensure creative storytelling and product representation are aligned while maintaining the integrity of the creative vision.
* Collaborate with E\-Commerce, Social, Video, Marketing and other channel partners to ensure the photographic vision translates effectively across customer touchpoints.
* Partner with Pagination and Creative teams to ensure imagery supports compelling layouts, storytelling and seasonal content needs.
* Review photography and video throughout the creative process, providing senior\-level direction on image selection, color, retouching, backgrounds, cropping, layouts and overall visual consistency.
* Anticipate creative challenges and proactively identify solutions that balance brand vision, product priorities, production realities and business needs.
* Champion a culture of creativity, collaboration, curiosity and excellence while helping evolve Pottery Barn's visual expression and brand relevance.


**Criteria**
* Undergraduate or graduate degree in a visual or creative discipline such as advertising, interior design, interior architecture, graphic design, fine art or photography.
* Significant progressive creative leadership experience within photography, art direction, styling, editorial, advertising or related visual disciplines.
* Deep experience within home furnishings, lifestyle, interiors, retail, editorial or a similarly design\-driven industry strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and communicate an overarching creative vision and translate brand\-level concepts into compelling visual storytelling.
* Exceptional visual judgment with a sophisticated understanding of interiors, decorating, styling, composition, photography, color and design.
* Proven ability to lead, inspire and develop Art Directors and multidisciplinary creative teams.
* Experience directing photographers, stylists, producers, digital artists, set builders and other creative partners.
* Strong conceptual thinker who can move fluidly between high\-level creative strategy and detailed visual execution.
* Ability to articulate creative ideas clearly and persuasively to creative teams, cross\-functional partners and senior executives.
* Highly collaborative, with demonstrated success partnering across Product Development, Merchandising, E\-Commerce, Social, Video and other functions.
* Resourceful and solutions\-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple creative initiatives and changing priorities while maintaining a consistently high visual standard.
* Strong understanding of the home furnishings and décor landscape with knowledge of current and emerging trends in interiors, photography, design and culture.
* Proven proficiency working within a digital\-first creative environment, including familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite and contemporary creative workflows.
* Above all, you bring exceptional taste, strong creative instincts and a clear point of view, paired with the leadership skills to inspire others and translate Pottery Barn's brand vision into imagery that feels relevant, beautiful and unmistakably Pottery Barn.


**Our Culture \& Values**
 We believe that taking care of our people is vital to our success, and we strive to offer equitable and transparent practices for all. We prioritize connection, growth, and wellbeing.
   

  

**People First**
 Putting People First means investing in overall well\-being and opportunities to grow and advance within the organization. Depending on the position and location, here are a few highlights of what benefits may be available:
   

  

**Benefits**
* A generous discount on all WSI brands
* A 401(k) plan and other investment opportunities
* Paid vacations, holidays, and time off to volunteer
* Health benefits, dental and vision insurance, including same\-sex domestic partner benefits
* Tax\-free commuter benefits
* A wellness program that supports your physical, financial and emotional health


**Continued Learning**
* In\-person and online learning opportunities through WSI University
* Cross\-brand and cross\-function career opportunities
* Resources for self\-development
* Advisor (Mentor) program
* Career development workshops, learning programs, and speaker series

 Williams\-Sonoma, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Williams\-Sonoma, Inc. will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, or other applicable state or local laws and ordinances.
   

  

 The expected starting pay range for this position is $140,000\-$175,000\. Applicable pay ranges may differ across markets. Actual pay will be determined based on experience and other job\-related factors permitted by law. In addition to competitive pay, compensation may include a variety of other components like benefits, paid time off, merit, and bonus opportunities.
   

  

**About Us**
 Our Company
   

  

 Founded in 1956, Williams\-Sonoma, Inc. is the premier specialty retailer of high\-quality products for the kitchen and home in the United States. Our family of brands are Williams Sonoma, Williams Sonoma Home, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teen, Rejuvenation, West Elm, Mark \& Graham, Outward, and GreenRow. These brands are among the best known and most respected in the industry. We offer beautifully\-designed, stylish and functional products for every area of the home, including the kitchen, living room, bedroom, home office, closet, laundry room and even outdoor spaces. We've seen some big changes since our first brick\-and\-mortar store opened more than half of a century ago. Today, we're a multi\-brand, multi\-channel, global enterprise supported by state\-of\-the\-art technology and some of the most talented teams in retailing \- and we're always looking for new energy and ideas.

They visit to studios, interview owners, film sessions and events, create challenges and activations, and turn all of it into content that studio owners want to watch and share.
 



 It is a hands\-on role. You concept it, you present it, you film it, you edit it, you publish it, and you answer the comments.
 



 In short: you help turn Fitune into the most valuable brand for fitness studio owners in LATAM.
 



  





**\-\-What you'll do: On\-ground execution and community building** 




 Visit to top studios to interview owners, cover live training sessions and events, and capture testimonials. Create challenges and activations that bring studios and their communities into the Fitune orbit. Build real relationships with partner studios, coaches, and end users — the kind where people text you before they text support.
 



  





**\-\-Premium video production** 




 Own video end to end, from concept to published cut. Short\-form and long\-form, both edited to a standard that matches a premium brand. You are comfortable being the only person on set.
 



  





**\-\-Product representation** 




 Star in and produce product videos that translate technical features into content people actually finish watching. You make software feel useful and human.
 



  





**\-\-Be the face of Fitune Academy** 




 You are the image of Fitune Academy, our educational platform for fitness and wellness studios. You present the courses, tutorials and masterclasses that teach owners and coaches how to run and grow their business, and over time your face becomes the one people associate with learning at Fitune. That means holding a consistent on\-camera identity across every lesson, keeping the material clear and practical rather than promotional, and working with product and marketing to decide what the community needs to learn next.
 



  





**\-\-Channel and community management** 




 Manage day\-to\-day publishing across Facebook (including Facebook groups like Pilates coaches groups, etc) , Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and LinkedIn. Own the content calendar, adapt formats per platform, optimise captions and descriptions, monitor performance, and reply to comments and DMs so the community stays responsive.
 



  





**\-\-Content strategy and growth** 




 Work with marketing, product and sales to turn launches into content, share studio success stories, educate owners on growing their business, test new formats, and improve performance based on what the numbers say.
 



  





**\-\-AI\-accelerated workflow** 




 Use generative AI tools (Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, plus video and audio automation) to move faster on scripting, brainstorming, social listening and post\-production.
 



  





**\-\-Authenticity safeguard** 




 Know exactly where AI efficiency ends and human connection begins. Every final script, cut and comment reply should feel organic and specific to the culture of the fitness community it is speaking to.
 



  





**\-\-Types of content you'll create** 




**Short\-form social content** 



* https://www.instagram.com/p/DVObFk\-Ebut/
* https://www.instagram.com/p/DU500q7DlVb/

**Long\-form interviews with studio owners**

**Educational, tutorial and webinar content** 



* https://www.youtube.com/watch?v\=XnsxSHQefvk



 Plus Fitune Academy videos, product feature highlights, event coverage, community challenges and activations.
 



 \-\-
 



  





**Who you are** 



* You are active in the fitness or wellness world. You train, you know the vocabulary, you understand what a studio owner's Monday looks like.
* Your energy is the point. You are warm, enthusiastic, and inviting on camera and off it, and people relax around you.
* You love making things. High standards on craft, and you would rather reshoot than publish something you are not proud of.
* You genuinely enjoy people. Meeting them, interviewing them, remembering their names, building something they want to be part of.
* You are hands\-on and autonomous. You pitch your own hooks, run your own days, and do not need a producer to get something shipped.
* You are comfortable in a room with a high\-profile studio owner and equally comfortable with the coaches and members on the floor.
* You are curious and constantly generating ideas.



 \-\-Skills and experience
 



  





**Must have** 



* Proven experience creating video content for social media
* Comfortable presenting on camera as the face of a brand
* Experience with short\-form content (Reels, TikTok, Shorts)
* Ability to film and edit your own content end to end, short and long form
* Strong storytelling for digital platforms
* Strong understanding of social media trends and formats
* Exceptional interpersonal skills, with the confidence to network with business owners



  





**Technical skills** 



* Video editing tools
* Basic design tools (Canva, Figma)
* Camera and lighting basics
* Social media publishing and scheduling tools
* Generative AI tools for scripting, ideation and post\-production



  





**Language** 



* Native or fluent Spanish. Content will be in Spanish
* Professional English for internal communication



  





**Bonus points** 



* Background working in fitness, wellness or sports
* Experience producing interview\-style content
* Experience creating educational or tutorial content
* Experience growing a social media audience from a standing start
* Existing network among studio owners or coaches in Mexico



 \-\-What success looks like
 



**First 30 days.** 
 You have visited your first studios, published your first short\-form pieces, and know the product well enough to demo it on camera.
 



**First 90 days.** 
 A consistent publishing rhythm across channels, a recognisable on\-camera presence, the first long\-form interviews live, and a growing set of studio relationships.
 



**First 6 months.** 
 Measurable growth in audience and engagement, a repeatable content engine, and a community where studio owners and coaches participate rather than just watch.

description:
**Company Description**
**Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.**
 Hey, hello, hiya, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!
   

  

 Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Where and how you can work**
 Our headquarters is in sunny Sydney, Australia, but our team spans the globe. Since we don’t have a physical campus in Argentina, this role is fully remote—giving you the flexibility to do your best work from wherever you thrive.
   

  

**What You’d Be Doing In This Role**
 As Canva scales change continues to be part of our DNA. But we like to think that's all part of the fun. So this will give you the flavour of the type of things you'll be working on when you start, but this will likely evolve.
   

  

**At The Moment, This Role Is Focused On**
* Strategy. Act as the main leadership point of contact with responsibility for overall user and revenue growth in Argentina. You'll bring together local and global teams across marketing, sales, product, content and finance to create and execute a cohesive multi\-year growth strategy, and own the KPIs including MAUs and ARR.
* Localisation. Work closely with the regional team to optimise our product, content, pricing and packaging to meet the needs of local users, informed by a deep understanding of local market dynamics and cultural nuances across a range of audiences, including knowledge workers, SMBs, students, startup ecosystems, NGOs, and other emerging sectors.
* Leadership. Hire, inspire, drive and in some cases coach the in\-market team, ensuring a high quality bar for impact and working closely with local speciality leads on performance management.
* Budget. Partner closely with the regional team and marketing lead to shape the marketing strategy and deployment of budget.
* Sponsorship. Build and support high value relationships by acting as a local sponsor for enterprise sales, education, government, partnerships, etc.
* Public face. Represent Canva as a local figurehead across press, PR, events and community.


**You're probably a match if**
* You are strongly entrepreneurial. Founder\-style appetite for growing something big from a small start and working across everything from education to press.
* You possess experience growing a market. For example, as the regional GM or brand lead for a global SaaS company, or as a proven founder or growth lead in a startup in a high growth environment.
* You are a proven leader. Ability to grow, inspire, and coach high\-performing teams. You have high emotional intelligence and empathy, and are a deeply collaborative teammate.
* You are a strong communicator. Fully proficient in spoken and written English, and with the interpersonal skills to influence global and local stakeholders.
* You are keenly analytical. Deeply focused on KPIs and obsessive about driving actionable insights from disparate datasets and able to think about a market’s performance holistically.
* you are product oriented. Passion for improving the experience of users and the ability to translate local insights into product requirements with experience localising a global product for a particular market.
* You are values aligned. Genuinely excited by Canva’s mission and deeply aligned with our values, and with exceptional references to prove it.
* You are publicity savvy. Experience doing public speaking and acting as a public face to the press and other stakeholders.
* You are well networked. Ideally with routes into some combination of government departments, corporates, influencers, journalists and local talent

 Canva’s International supergroup is a diverse, distributed team of marketers, strategists, and growth leaders focused on expanding Canva's presence in key global markets. Our team partners with functions across Marketing, Growth, Product, Sales, Partnerships, Content, Finance, and Strategy to drive sustainable user and revenue growth in international markets.
   

  

 As the Country Manager for Argentina, you will be the main point of contact and the driving force behind Canva’s success in the country. You will own and implement a multi\-year strategic roadmap, leading cross\-functional efforts to grow the user base and scale revenue.
   

  

 This role requires deep market knowledge, a growth mindset, and strong leadership capabilities to bring together local and global teams across marketing, sales, and product in a cohesive strategy.
   

  

**What's in it for you?**
 Achieving our crazy big goals motivates us to work hard \- and we do \- but you'll experience lots of moments of magic, connectivity and fun woven throughout life at Canva, too. We also offer a range of benefits to set you up for every success in and outside of work.
   

  

**Here's a Taste Of What's On Offer**
* Equity packages \- we want our success to be yours too
* Inclusive parental leave policy
* An annual Vibe \& Thrive package to support your wellbeing, social connection, office setup \& more
* Flexible leave options that empower you to be a force for good, take time to recharge and supports you personally


 Check out lifeatcanva.com for more info.
   

  

**Other Stuff To Know**
 We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion, as well as how you can enhance Canva and our culture. When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.
   

  

 We celebrate all types of skills and backgrounds at Canva so even if you don’t feel like your skills quite match what’s listed above \- we still want to hear from you!

title: Account Director - GCC
description:
#### **About Us**


For over two decades, The Boundary has been at the forefront of digital excellence. With a global team of 150\+ experts across London, New York, Dubai, and Auckland, we partner with the world's leading developers to deliver unparalleled architectural storytelling.


Founded by award\-winning architects, our work sits at the intersection of design intuition and technical mastery. From pioneering digital twin infrastructure to the seamless integration of AI and real\-time technology, we don’t just anticipate the future of the industry; we are already building it.

#### **The Opportunity**


The strongest client relationships do more than sustain great work. They create the trust, clarity and commercial confidence that allow ambitious ideas to move forward.


At The Boundary, we partner with leading developers, architects, real estate businesses and global brands to bring places and ideas to life. Our Account Directors sit at the centre of those partnerships \- understanding what matters to the client, aligning the right internal teams and ensuring that every interaction strengthens the relationship.


We are looking for an experienced Account Director to lead a portfolio of high\-value accounts across the GCC region. This is a senior client leadership role with clear accountability for relationship health, retention, account growth and service excellence.

#### **What we're looking for**


You are a strategic account leader who combines excellent judgement with strong commercial instincts. You understand how to build trusted, long\-term relationships while identifying the opportunities that create genuine value for both the client and the business.


You are comfortable working across complex, multi\-service accounts and high\-profile projects. You can move confidently between long\-range account planning, commercial discussions, delivery oversight and urgent issue resolution without losing sight of the wider relationship.


Clients trust you because you listen carefully, communicate clearly and follow through. Internal teams trust you because you translate client priorities into focused, achievable plans and advocate for the relationship without compromising delivery quality, capacity or process.


You are also an experienced people leader. You know how to mentor client\-service professionals, give useful feedback and raise standards while creating the confidence and clarity people need to perform at their best.

#### **What You'll Do**

**Lead strategic client relationships.** Act as the senior strategic lead and primary point of contact for a portfolio of key accounts, developing a detailed understanding of each client's objectives, stakeholders, priorities and long\-term opportunities.

**Build account plans that deliver growth.** Own relationship planning, support client tiering and identify well\-timed opportunities to retain, expand, cross\-sell and upsell services within existing accounts.

**Shape commercial opportunities.** Partner with Business Development and regional leadership on proposals, pitches and commercial discussions, ensuring opportunities are well scoped and aligned with client needs and business priorities.

**Provide delivery governance.** Work with Project Management, Production and Creative leaders to ensure briefs are translated into clear, achievable plans, risks are identified early and strategic deliverables remain aligned with expectations.

**Resolve issues with pace and judgement.** Take ownership of client concerns and escalations, establish clear resolution plans and maintain trust through professional, transparent communication.

**Create continuity from pitch to delivery.** Support the onboarding of high\-value projects and ensure the Client Services function is properly represented in project timelines, resourcing and creative\-development conversations.

**Develop the Client Services team.** Mentor Senior Managers and Managers across multiple accounts, contribute to onboarding and training, and provide clear feedback that strengthens commercial awareness and service quality.

**Improve how we work.** Champion consistent use of systems, SOPs and shared templates; identify process gaps; and lead post\-mortems or service audits that turn project experience into practical improvement.

**Maintain accurate account intelligence.** Track account health, engagement, feedback, opportunities and risks, ensuring information is complete, current and visible to the relevant leadership teams.

#### **What You'll Bring**

**Substantial senior client\-services experience.** Typically eight or more years in strategic account management or a comparable client leadership role, with responsibility for significant, complex accounts.

**A proven record of account growth.** Evidence of retaining and expanding key relationships, identifying commercially sound opportunities and contributing to successful proposals or pitches.

**Experience in a relevant environment.** A background in a creative, advertising, architectural, real estate, SaaS or related professional\-services business. Agency or creative\-production experience would be particularly valuable.

**Strong commercial acumen.** Confidence discussing scope, budgets, value and delivery trade\-offs, with the judgement to balance client priorities against operational and commercial realities.

**Executive\-level communication.** Excellent presentation, negotiation and stakeholder\-management skills, including the ability to lead high\-stakes conversations and build credibility with senior decision\-makers.

**Delivery understanding.** A practical knowledge of project\-delivery workflows and the ability to work effectively with Project Management, Production, Creative and Finance teams.

**People leadership.** Experience mentoring colleagues, providing performance feedback and improving capability across a client\-services team.

**A proactive, solutions\-focused approach.** You are tenacious, organised and accountable, absorb new technical and industry knowledge quickly, and respond constructively to feedback.

**Relevant education or equivalent experience.** A bachelor's degree in Management, Marketing, Real Estate or a related field is preferred, but substantial relevant experience is equally important.

title: Director of Training and Workforce Development
description:
Job Summary:  



People are at the heart of our business. We lead by example in promoting and ensuring we maintain a strong safety culture, where strict adherence to risk mitigation and safety/security protocols of our employees, passengers, clients, and communities is critical.

  


The **Director of Training \& Workforce Development** serves as the strategic leader for employee


development, workforce readiness, leadership growth, and training excellence within the Safety \& Training


Department. Reporting to the Vice President of Safety \& Security, this position is responsible for


developing and executing enterprise\-wide training and workforce development strategies that strengthen


safety culture, reduce operational risk, improve workforce performance, and support organizational


excellence.

  


The Director provides leadership and oversight for training, professional development, leadership


development, instructor qualification, onboarding, and employee career progression programs.


Working collaboratively with Operations, Maintenance, Safety, Human Resources, executive leadership and


the global L\&D team, the position ensures employees at all levels possess the knowledge, skills, and


competencies necessary to perform their duties safely, effectively, and consistently.

  


A key responsibility of this role is integrating safety principles, accountability, risk awareness, and


operational discipline throughout the employee lifecycle—from recruitment and onboarding through


leadership development and succession planning. The Director leads safety awareness campaigns,


workforce development initiatives, and leadership programs that promote continuous learning, employee


engagement, and a strong safety culture.

  


Through data\-driven decision\-making and continuous improvement, this position develops training and


workforce development solutions that enhance employee performance, strengthen leadership capability,


improve safety outcomes, and support RATP Dev's commitment to safety, security, service, and operational


excellence.

  


Critical components:
**A highly conscientious leader who:**


* Promotes a diverse and inclusive, positive, respectful, and healthy work environment.


* Has accountability


* Excels in Communications


* Promotes Safety


* Has expertise and technical knowledge


* Has Trust and Credibility


* Is Result Driven


* Decision Making

  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**


The following duties are normal for this position. These are not to be construed as exclusive or all inclusive. Other duties may be required and assigned.

  


**Training Strategy, Curriculum \& Organizational Learning**


* Develop and execute an enterprise\-wide training and workforce development strategy aligned with safety, operational, and organizational goals.


* Design and maintain standardized training frameworks, competency models, certification requirements, and qualification standards across all functions.


* Design, implement, and continuously improve operator, supervisor, and leadership development curricula to ensure responsiveness to evolving industry standards, regulatory requirements, and operational challenges.


* Oversee the development, delivery, and continuous improvement of training programs for Operations, Maintenance, Safety, Customer Service, and Leadership.


* Ensure all training content is current, compliant, and aligned with industry best practices and regulatory and global training requirements


* Measure training effectiveness using performance metrics, audits, employee performance indicators, and operational outcomes.

  


**Workforce Development, Leadership \& Succession Planning**


* Design and implement workforce development programs that strengthen employee engagement, retention, career advancement, and workforce readiness.


* Establish structured career pathways, mentorship programs, and leadership pipelines for frontline employees, supervisors, managers, and emerging leaders.


* Lead leadership development programs focused on supervisory readiness, management capability, accountability, coaching, and high\-potential employee growth.


* Partner with Human Resources and Operations to support succession planning, talent development, and workforce capability planning.


* Develop programs that prepare employees for advancement opportunities and strengthen organizational bench strength.

  


**Safety Training, Culture \& Campaigns**


* Partner with Safety leadership to integrate safety principles into all training and workforce development initiatives.


* Develop training programs focused on hazard recognition, risk reduction, incident prevention, defensive driving, securement proficiency, regulatory compliance, and operational safety practices.


* Lead enterprise safety campaigns, awareness initiatives, employee engagement programs, and promotional activities that reinforce a strong safety culture.


* Analyze safety trends, audit findings, investigations, and incident data to identify training needs and drive corrective action strategies.


* Ensure lessons learned from incidents, near misses, and operational events are incorporated into training and workforce development programs.

  


**Recruitment Support, Onboarding \& Workforce Readiness**


* Partner with Human Resources and Operations to support recruitment, onboarding, and workforce attraction initiatives.


* Support workforce readiness programs including new hire onboarding, orientation, and early\-career development.


* Assist with employer branding efforts, career fairs, community outreach, workforce partnerships, and recruitment campaigns.


* Develop programs that improve new hire retention, engagement, and job readiness.


* Support initiatives that position RATP Dev as an employer of choice committed to safety, employee development, and career growth.

  


**Instructor Development \& Training Quality**


* Establish and maintain instructor qualification, certification, and performance standards.


* Lead train\-the\-trainer programs to ensure consistency and quality in instructional delivery.


* Evaluate training effectiveness and ensure continuous improvement across classroom, field, virtual, and on\-the\-job learning environments.


* Promote innovative learning solutions and instructional best practices throughout the organization.

  


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Organizational Support**


* Serve as a strategic partner to Operations, Maintenance, Safety, Security, and Human Resources.


* Support organizational initiatives related to employee engagement, operational performance, risk reduction, and change management.


* Lead or support special projects that improve workforce capability, safety performance, regulatory compliance, and organizational effectiveness.


* Collaborate with leaders across the organization to identify emerging workforce, operational, and safety challenges requiring training or development solutions.

  


**Leadership Responsibilities**


* Provide leadership, coaching, mentoring, and direction to training and workforce development staff.


* Set departmental goals, performance expectations, strategic priorities, and development plans.


* Foster a culture of accountability, learning, professionalism, safety, and continuous improvement.


* Champion RATP Dev's mission, values, and commitment to safety, security, service, and operational excellence.


* Promote collaboration and partnership across departments to support organizational objectives and workforce development initiatives.

 **Qualifications:**

  


**Required**


* Bachelor’s degree in Education, Organizational Development, Business Administration, Human Resources, Safety Management, Transportation, or a related field.


* Seven (7\) or more years of progressive experience in training, workforce development, leadership development, organizational development, or safety training environments.


* Three (3\) or more years of leadership experience managing training, workforce development, or employee development programs.


* Demonstrated experience developing and implementing enterprise\-wide training and workforce development initiatives.


* Strong knowledge of adult learning principles, instructional design methodologies, and workforce development practices.


* Excellent communication, facilitation, presentation, leadership, and relationship\-building skills.


**Preferred**


* Experience in public transportation, paratransit, fleet operations, maintenance, logistics, or other safety\-sensitive industries.


* Experience with Learning Management Systems (LMS) and enterprise learning platforms.


* Experience developing leadership development, mentorship, and succession planning programs.


* Professional certifications related to training, organizational development, workforce development, coaching, safety, or leadership development.


**Knowledge**


* Knowledge of adult learning principles, instructional design methodologies, training program development, and workforce development practices.


* Knowledge of leadership development, employee engagement, succession planning, and organizational development strategies.


* Knowledge of safety management systems, safety culture principles, risk mitigation practices, and regulatory compliance requirements.


* Knowledge of public transportation, paratransit, fleet operations, maintenance operations, or other safety\-sensitive industries preferred.


* Knowledge of Learning Management Systems (LMS), e\-learning platforms, and modern training technologies.


* Knowledge of project management principles, change management methodologies, and performance improvement processes.


**Skills**


* Exceptional leadership, coaching, mentoring, and team development skills.


* Strong verbal, written, presentation, facilitation, and public speaking skills.


* Excellent curriculum development, instructional design, and training program management skills.


* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities with the capability to evaluate data, identify trends, and implement effective solutions.


* Skilled in workforce planning, talent development, employee engagement, leadership development, and organizational effectiveness initiatives.


* Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.


* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, learning management systems, and training technologies.


**Abilities**


* Ability to develop and execute strategic training and workforce development initiatives aligned with organizational objectives.


* Ability to influence and collaborate effectively with executive leadership, operations management, maintenance personnel, human resources professionals, safety personnel, global teams and external stakeholders.


* Ability to assess organizational needs and translate them into practical and effective learning solutions.


* Ability to design, implement, and continuously improve operator, supervisor, and leadership development curricula to ensure responsiveness to evolving industry standards, regulatory requirements, and operational challenges.


* Ability to lead organizational change and drive continuous improvement initiatives.


* Ability to develop productive working relationships across multiple departments and geographically dispersed operating locations.


* Ability to analyze operational, safety, and workforce data to identify performance gaps and development opportunities.


* Ability to maintain confidentiality, exercise sound judgment, and manage sensitive information appropriately.


* Ability to travel extensively and work effectively in a fast\-paced operational environment.

  


**WORK ENVIRONMENT**


The work environment includes a mix of remote and corporate office settings, training facilities, maintenance


locations, operating sites, and field environments. This position regularly engages with employees at all levels of the


organization, including supervisors, managers, executives, customers, contractors, and external stakeholders. In the


course of work, the role may occasionally be exposed to operational environments involving moving vehicles,


maintenance equipment, and varying weather conditions commonly associated with public transportation operations.

  


Travel is an essential function of this position and is expected to range between **50–75%** of the time.

  


Leadership Model for Success:
* **Leadership**

Safety, Building Teams, Performance Management, Developing Talent

* Business

Business Acumen, Strategic Visionary, Decision Making, Profitable Growth · Interpersonal


Trustworthiness, Building Relationships, Influencing Others, Communication · Wellbeing


Managing Stress, Work\-Life Harmony, Mental Wellness

  


Professional and Personal Development
Start here and grow here. RATP Dev USA believes in promoting from within and providing learning and development opportunities for our team members. We take pride in preparing and developing future and existing leaders through our Grow Our Own Development and Mentorship Programs.


When you join RATP Dev USA, you will have the ability to build your skills and knowledge in various areas through continuous learning (eLearning included) and leadership workshops.

  


* Leadership Development


* Mentorship \& Coaching


* Safety, Security, \& Compliance Training


* Technical and Soft Skill Training


* And much more...

  


Benefits
We offer competitive compensation and benefits (which vary based on role, location, and business), including medical/dental/vision, 401(k), and paid holiday/vacation.


**We are an Equal Opportunity Employer \& We Welcome Diversity to our Teams!**

**Job Description**


The Director, Academic Strategy leads the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of portfolio\-wide academic strategies designed to strengthen student outcomes and school performance. The role translates academic and accountability data into clear priorities, scalable practices, and proactive supports; serves as the strategic owner of the K12 School Playbook; and provides oversight for national academic and school counseling priorities.


The Director ensures that annual school planning is coherent, rigorous, and increasingly informed by evidence of what works across the portfolio. This role also partners across functions and with school leaders to strengthen Tier 1 academic practices, improve implementation, identify emerging needs, and scale effective approaches across schools.

**Essential Functions:** Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties.

* Develop, refine, and execute K12's academic strategy in alignment with organizational priorities, student outcomes, and state accountability expectations.

* Own and manage the budget and staffing plan for the Academic Strategy function, including resource allocation to support Playbook execution and academic strategy priorities.
* Ensure coherence across Playbook areas, including synchronous and asynchronous instruction, assessment and MTSS, training and observation, and graduation strategy, so schools develop one integrated academic plan.
* Design and lead a rigorous Playbook review and feedback process that strengthens plan quality, increases consistency and rigor, and provides schools with actionable guidance.
* Use the Playbook process to identify strong practices, common implementation challenges, and emerging needs; codify and scale effective practices across schools and continuously improve national guidance and support.

* Partner with school and portfolio leaders to understand implementation challenges, strengthen execution, and ensure national strategies and Playbook expectations are rigorous, practical, and responsive to school context.
* Provide strategic oversight for national school counseling priorities, including graduation planning, on\-track monitoring, course completion and credit attainment, postsecondary planning, student engagement, and accountability outcomes.
* Direct the Program Manager, Academics and School Counseling Program Manager in translating strategic priorities into implementation plans, tools, resources, professional learning, and school\-facing supports.

* Proven ability to develop scalable frameworks, tools, resources, and continuous improvement processes.

title: Senior Director Clinic Operations
description:
**Description**

**Calling All Esteemed Leaders!** Are you a healthcare operations leader who excels at building high\-performing ambulatory teams, advancing clinical service lines, and translating strategy into operational results? Do you thrive in complex, multidisciplinary environments where collaboration, accountability, and patient\-centered care drive success? If so, we invite you to explore this leadership opportunity with Swedish Neuroscience Institute.


**The Role**

In collaboration with SMG administration, Swedish Neuroscience Institute medical directors, physician leaders, and enterprise partners, the Senior Director Clinic Operations provides strategic and operational leadership for the ambulatory functions of the institute and related care continuum partnerships. This role is responsible for translating institute and organizational strategy into executable operational plans that advance quality, access, growth, patient experience, workforce engagement, and financial performance across SNI programs and sites.


The Senior Director has direct accountability for outpatient clinic operations and indirect influence across the broader neuroscience continuum, including coordination with inpatient, procedural, diagnostic, rehabilitation, and support services. The role leads through senior managers, clinic managers, and other operational leaders to ensure consistent standards, strong local execution, and alignment across multiple clinics, providers, and subspecialty programs. A critical expectation of this position is the development of clinic leadership infrastructure, including clear role expectations for managers, operational governance, communication cadence, performance accountability, and escalation pathways that support reliable day\-to\-day clinic performance and long\-term strategic growth.


This leader serves as a key integrator between physicians, clinic operations, nursing, and enterprise support functions. The Senior Director is expected to foster timely, bidirectional communication across departments; reduce fragmentation between sites and services; and ensure clinic managers are equipped to communicate priorities, escalate risks, and implement change effectively. The role is accountable for building a high\-performing management structure that supports caregiver engagement, standardization where appropriate, responsiveness to local clinic needs, and coordinated decision\-making across the institute.


The Senior Director contributes to effective and efficient operations in support of high\-quality, cost\-effective patient care and is responsible for implementing organizational philosophy, goals, and policies in a manner consistent with Swedish's mission and values. This position requires advanced leadership judgment, strong financial and operational acumen, and the ability to drive multidisciplinary collaboration while ensuring compliance with applicable federal, state, accreditation, and organizational standards.


**What You’ll Do**

* Lead and manage strategic and operational initiatives across the SNI with a focus on advancing neuroscience service line excellence, including neurology, neurosurgery, stroke, spine, and subspecialty programs.
* Provide leadership to ensure achievement of goals related to clinical quality, patient outcomes, access, growth, financial performance, and patient experience across the neuroscience continuum of care.
* Serve as a trusted leader and mentor to direct reports, ensuring alignment of operational priorities with neuroscience institute strategy, physician engagement, and multidisciplinary care delivery models.
* Partner closely with neuroscience medical directors, physician leaders, and inpatient/outpatient teams to design, implement, and optimize integrated care models across ambulatory, procedural, and acute care settings.
* Identify operational, clinical, and structural barriers that impact neuroscience patient flow, access, and outcomes, and implement sustainable solutions to improve coordination and efficiency.
* Oversee development and execution of neuroscience program growth strategies, including expansion of specialty services, new care models, and market differentiation initiatives.
* Define and operationalize clear expectations for senior managers and clinic managers, including accountability for daily clinic performance, access, staffing, provider support, and patient experience outcomes.
* Establish and maintain a standardized communication cadence across clinic operations, including routine leadership alignment, structured performance review, and clear escalation pathways with defined ownership and follow\-through.
* Design and implement consistent clinic operating models and management infrastructure, including performance accountability frameworks, standardized workflows, and mechanisms to ensure reliable execution across sites.
* Establish and monitor neuroscience\-specific performance metrics, including quality indicators (e.g., stroke, epilepsy, spine outcomes), access, throughput, and patient experience, driving continuous improvement efforts.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory, accreditation, and certification standards relevant to neuroscience programs (e.g., stroke center certification, specialty registries, and national benchmarking organizations).
* Collaborate with executive leadership to prioritize and advance high\-impact neuroscience initiatives, ensuring alignment with organizational strategy and community health needs.
* Build and sustain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including physicians, advanced practice providers, hospital partners, and community organizations, to enhance neuroscience service delivery.
* Lead cross\-functional collaboration to support care continuum integration, including transitions between ambulatory, inpatient, rehabilitation, and post\-acute neuroscience services.
* Direct and administer operations to ensure delivery of high\-quality, cost\-effective neuroscience care, including development and oversight of policies, procedures, and clinical workflows.
* Evaluate organizational structure, staffing models, and resource allocation to support complex neuroscience clinical programs and subspecialty growth, ensuring high performance and scalability.
* Facilitate effective communication and alignment across stakeholders to support implementation of neuroscience initiatives and system\-wide priorities.
* Provide executive oversight of high\-profile neuroscience projects and service line innovations, ensuring timely execution and measurable outcomes.
* Serve as an active member of the SMG Leadership Team, contributing to region\-wide strategy while representing neuroscience priorities and opportunities.
* Apply a strategic, forward\-looking approach to planning, balancing short\- and long\-term neuroscience program needs, workforce planning, and capital/resource investments.

**What You’ll Bring**

**Education \& Credentials**

* Bachelor's Degree in Business, Information Systems, or related field.
* Master's Degree in Business, Information Systems, or related field (preferred).

**Experience \& Expertise**

* 5 years of experience in project management roles within large/complex healthcare organizations.
* 5 years of experience in healthcare operations leadership role.
* 5 years of experience in financial business management and strategic development.
* Progressive leadership experience in multi\-site ambulatory operations with demonstrated accountability for clinic\-level execution, performance management, and operational standardization.
* Successful program/initiative development, execution and optimization.
* Successful management of complex issues and matters, with a sensitivity for building strong relationships, buy\-in and stakeholder investment.
* Provide executive\-level support to top decision\-makers and project managers **.**

**Professional \& Leadership Capabilities**

* Highly developed leadership, management, interpersonal, team and communication skills necessary to interact effectively with key executives, physicians and other personnel.
* Change management capabilities and consulting/project management/coordination capabilities.
* Proven track record of building successful and sustaining important relationships and influencing stakeholder groups.
* Proven ability to communicate with diverse audiences around highly confidential/sensitive information. Ability to effectively communicate (written/verbal).
* Assertive and creative in problem solving, self\-directed and able to work under pressure and continuing change.
* Ability to independently plan and organize to meet long term (6 months – 1 year) scheduling and logistical needs.
* Ability to work in a high volume environment while maintaining high quality standards.

**Why Join Us?**

* **Neuroscience Leadership Opportunity:** Provide strategic and operational leadership for the ambulatory functions of the Swedish Neuroscience Institute and related care continuum partnerships.
* **Broad Operational Impact:** Advance quality, access, growth, patient experience, workforce engagement, and financial performance across SNI programs and sites.
* **Integrated Care Leadership:** Partner with medical directors, physician leaders, clinic operations, nursing, and enterprise support functions to drive coordination across the neuroscience continuum.
* **Strategic Growth \& Innovation:** Support neuroscience service line excellence through program growth, integrated care models, operational standardization, and service line innovation.

**Ready to Shape the Future of Healthcare?**

If you are a collaborative healthcare operations leader with experience advancing ambulatory performance, multidisciplinary partnerships, and complex clinical programs, we encourage you to apply and help shape the future of neuroscience care at Swedish Neuroscience Institute.

title: Coordinator, Security Operations Center BAT
description:
**Coordinator, Security Operations Center BAT \- South Campus**


**PRIMARY FUNCTION:** The SOC Coordinator (Coordinator) provides leadership and coordination for San Jacinto College’s (SJC) embedded Security Operations Center (SOC) that supports the Cybersecurity AAS and BAT academic programs and the San Jacinto College Office of Cybersecurity. This position bridges instruction and workforce training with live cybersecurity operations by coordinating student\-engaged SOC activities, supporting faculty, and building employer and industry relationships that connect students to internships, certifications, and employment.  

  

The Coordinator ensures that SOC operations align with SJC’s NSA Center of Academic Excellence in Cyber Defense designation, institutional mission, and regional workforce needs by advancing hands\-on learning, student skill development, and sustainable employer partnerships. The Coordinator leads workforce development efforts by transforming live SOC operations into structured training and career\-building experiences. This role ensures that every student’s engagement in the SOC contributes to skill development, credential attainment, and direct pathways to employment in cybersecurity roles within industry.  

  

**Essential Job Functions:**
* Supervise students performing coursework in the SOC, along with work\-study students, student employees, and interns assigned to the SOC.
	+ Provide daily direction, oversight, and feedback to students completing course\-based labs, rotations, and assignments in the SOC.
	+ Monitor student work in the live SOC environment for quality, accuracy, and adherence to operational and security procedures.
* Coordinate day\-to\-day operations of the embedded College SOC to ensure alignment with cybersecurity course outcomes, labs, and program\-level learning objectives.
* Provide technical guidance and just\-in\-time training to students working in the SOC.
	+ Reinforce best practices in incident response, log analysis, threat hunting, and documentation.
	+ Develop and deliver training sessions, workshops, and simulations such as tabletop exercises and cyber ranges for students, faculty, and College staff using SOC infrastructure.
* Collaborate with cybersecurity faculty on curriculum\-connected SOC work.
	+ Design and schedule student rotations, lab assignments, practicums, and capstone projects that use live SOC tools, data, and procedures.
	+ Integrate SOC experience into course outcomes, certificates, and degree programs so that students earn academic credit and professional value for SOC participation.
* Develop, implement, and oversee a structured workforce development framework for SOC students so that every operational activity supports employability and career readiness.
	+ Coordinate student progression pathways from classroom to live SOC operations, including skills mapping, role assignments, and competency tracking aligned with national cybersecurity workforce frameworks.
	+ Facilitate student access to industry\-recognized certifications, workshops, and professional mentoring that enhance their readiness for cybersecurity careers.
* Build and maintain strong, ongoing relationships with employers, industry partners, workforce boards, professional organizations, and workforce development agencies to support long\-term engagement and student opportunity.
	+ Schedule and conduct regular check\-ins and reviews with employer partners, capturing hiring needs, skill gaps, and feedback on student readiness.
	+ Connect students to internships, apprenticeships, and employment opportunities.
* Coordinate student participation in workforce programs such as Texas Workforce Commission internships, apprenticeships, and grant\-funded experiential learning opportunities.
	+ Work with institutional leadership to formalize agreements such as MOUs, internship and apprenticeship agreements, and statements of roles and responsibilities, and help ensure alignment with SJC policies and NSA CAE expectations.
* Represent SJC and the SOC externally to advance partnerships and awareness.
	+ Attend regional meetings, advisory boards, conferences, and workforce and industry events.
	+ Participate in regional and state\-level workforce development initiatives, ensuring alignment with Texas workforce goals and cybersecurity talent pipelines.
	+ Participate in program advisory committee meetings, providing SOC updates and gathering industry input to inform curriculum and program direction.
* Track, analyze, and report SOC and student performance data.
	+ Track and manage SOC operational metrics such as tickets, incidents, response times, and student hours.
	+ Track and report key student workforce metrics, including hands\-on hours, certifications earned, internships secured, and post\-graduation employment rates.
	+ Collect and analyze assessment data and employer feedback to evaluate the effectiveness of SOC operations and student learning outcomes.
	+ Use data and dashboards to inform improvements in processes, tools, training, and the student experience, and prepare summary reports for College leadership.
	+ Use data\-driven analysis to improve workforce development outcomes, adjusting student engagement strategies and training methods based on performance and feedback.
	+ Support NSA CAE compliance and reporting by helping faculty gather evidence of hands\-on learning, knowledge units, and workforce\-aligned activities delivered through the SOC.
* Coordinate daily operations and strategic planning with College IT, cybersecurity faculty, division leadership, and workforce development staff.
	+ Help ensure that SOC operations support institutional compliance, including information security policies, data privacy, and regulatory requirements.

**Additional Job Functions:**
* Teach one cybersecurity course section per academic year as assigned by the program director, in support of the Cybersecurity AAS and BAT programs.
* Develop and execute outreach and marketing strategies to promote SOC student engagement opportunities and cybersecurity awareness campaigns across SJC and the Texas Gulf Coast.
	+ Collaborate with College marketing, workforce, and community engagement offices to highlight student success stories, regional impact, and employer partnerships connected to the SOC.
* Support or lead community\-facing events, such as Cybersecurity Month activities, K\-12 outreach, and student\-led cybersecurity awareness workshops for the College community.
* Identify emerging cybersecurity trends, threats, and technologies, and recommend enhancements to SOC capabilities and student training.
Assist with grant implementation and reporting when SOC activities are tied to externally funded projects or workforce initiatives.
Perform other job\-related duties as assigned to support the mission of the College and the success of students.  
* +

  

  

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**
* Ability to demonstrate the College values
* Knowledge of information security risk management, cybersecurity best practices, and common frameworks.
* Familiarity with cybersecurity tools and concepts, such as SIEM, log analysis, incident response workflows, vulnerability management, and ticketing systems.
* Proficiency with IT infrastructure and common software, including Microsoft Office and collaboration platforms.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical audiences.
* Demonstrated leadership abilities, including experience in coordinating projects, guiding teams, or training and mentoring others.
* Ability to work collaboratively across departments and with external organizations.
* Ability to work under stress, manage multiple priorities, and maintain professionalism in direct contact with students, colleagues, and external partners.
  

  

**Required Education:**
* Bachelor’s degree or higher from a regionally accredited institution in Cybersecurity, Computer Information Systems, Information Technology, or a closely related discipline.
  

  

**Preferred Education:**
* Master’s degree or higher from a regionally accredited institution in Cybersecurity, Computer Information Systems, Information Technology, or a closely related discipline.
  

  

**Required Experience:**
* Minimum of three (3\) years of related experience in cybersecurity operations, security monitoring, incident response, information security, risk management, or a closely related field; or
* Experience working in or with a Security Operations Center, Network Operations Center, or similar environment.
  

  

**Preferred Experience:**
* Minimum of five (5\) years of related experience in cybersecurity operations, security monitoring, incident response, information security, risk management, or a closely related field.
* Experience with SOC or security monitoring operations in public\-sector or education environments.
* Experience working in or with Texas community colleges, K\-12 school districts, or local government entities.
  

  

**Required Licenses/Certifications:**
* Criminal background check may be required in accordance with institutional and partner policies.
* Valid driver’s license may be required, along with the ability to travel to partner sites.
  

  

**Preferred Licenses/Certifications:**
* Industry\-recognized cybersecurity certifications, such as Security\+, CySA\+, CEH, CISSP, GSEC, or similar.
  

  

  

**Note: This position has limited opportunity for remote work arrangements with appropriate approvals and in accordance with the policies, procedures, and needs of the College.**

 DIRECTOR OF DESIGN:

 With its corporate office located in Orange County, California, Our Client owns and operates fitness clubs throughout the United States and Canada. The Development Department is responsible for evaluating, designing, entitling and constructing new fitness clubs across the portfolio, with a typical development year producing approximately 45–50 new locations.
   

  

* Architectural licensure is preferred.


 Our Client is seeking a
 **DIRECTOR OF DESIGN** 
 to provide hands\-on architectural and design leadership for its newest generation of high\-end fitness and wellness environments. These are sophisticated, highly programmed facilities combining fitness, boutique studios, wellness, recovery and hospitality\-oriented amenities within a single development.
   

  

**DIRECTOR OF DESIGN – LUXURY FITNESS CLUB DEVELOPMENT**
**Orange County, California \| Corporate Office \| Not Remote**
 Experienced architectural professionals with demonstrated design leadership who are ready to grow into a broader Director\-level position are encouraged to apply.
   

  

**THE POSITION**
 The Director of Design will lead projects from the earliest schematic concept. This is a hands\-on architectural leadership role for someone who can oversee the development of original designs and work with outside architectural consultants to produce a completed product.
   

  

 The Director is involved with the Real Estate Team before a project even begins, participating in the evaluation of prospective acquisitions and real estate opportunities. This person will assist in evaluations of potential sites and existing buildings to determine how effectively the club program can be accommodated, identify architectural and construction constraints, and provide design input that helps inform the viability of a deal.
   

  

 Once a project moves forward, the Director oversees the development of the initial schematic design concept, site plan, building configuration, floor plan. CAD is a daily part of the position—not simply a review function. The Director will personally develop and modify drawings to explore ideas, solve problems and communicate clear design direction.
   

  

 From there, the Director will work with the company development managers to lead outside architectural firms and specialty consultants through design development and construction documents, ensuring that the original concept is carried through to production and ultimately the completed club.
   

  

 Projects incorporate a wide range of specialized fitness, wellness and hospitality environments with different structural, HVAC, electrical, plumbing, lighting, acoustic, waterproofing and operational requirements. The Director must understand how these systems affect the architecture and be able to coordinate the appropriate disciplines without compromising the overall design.
   

  

 With approximately 45–50 new clubs developed during a typical year, this position requires someone who can maintain consistent design and quality standards across a significant development pipeline while adapting the product to different sites, buildings, jurisdictions and project conditions.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Ability to integrate the company’s visual brand identity into the architecture and built environment is key to the role
* Advanced understanding of the seamless integration of signage, environmental graphics, wayfinding, lighting and building materials is preferred.
* Lead projects from initial concepts through design development, construction documents and production.
* Personally develop initial concept designs, site plans, building configurations, floor plans and schematic designs.
* Participate in the evaluation of potential acquisitions, development sites and existing buildings, identifying architectural opportunities, limitations, and potential construction challenges.
* Use CAD as a daily design and communication tool to develop ideas and provide clear direction to internal teams and outside consultants.
* Direct and coordinate third\-party architectural firms throughout the United States and Canada.
* Manage the integration of interior design, MEP, structural, lighting, landscape and specialty consultants into the overall architectural vision.
* Review design development and construction documents for design intent, technical coordination, constructability and consistency with established development standards.
* Provide architectural oversight for environments involving specialized HVAC, acoustical, structural, electrical, plumbing and waterproofing requirements.
* Evaluate materials, finishes and architectural details for design quality, durability, performance and long\-term operational demands.
* Work closely with development and construction teams to resolve design and constructability issues as projects advance.
* Maintain established design standards while adapting the club program to different properties, site conditions and real estate opportunities.
* Manage numerous active projects and consultant teams simultaneously while maintaining schedule, consistency and design quality.


**Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of progressive architectural experience with a strong background in high\-quality commercial, retail, hospitality, resort, wellness, fitness or similarly design\-intensive projects.
* Professional Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Architecture.
* Architectural licensure is preferred.
* Strong experience in conceptual design, schematic design, site planning, building design and space planning.
* Demonstrated ability to direct outside architectural firms, engineers and specialty consultants.
* Strong construction knowledge with the ability to review detailed construction documents for technical coordination and constructability.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD and/or Vectorworks, with the ability and willingness to remain personally involved in daily design work.
* SketchUp, Photoshop and other visualization/presentation capabilities are a plus.
* Working knowledge of the architectural and building\-system demands associated with high\-performance commercial, hospitality, wellness or fitness environments.
* Ability to manage a high volume of projects and design issues simultaneously in a fast\-paced development environment.


**THE IDEAL CANDIDATE**
 This position fits an architect who can start with a new real estate deal and stay engaged through production. Someone who still enjoys designing, drawing and solving architectural problems, but who also has the experience and confidence to lead outside design professionals and hold them accountable for execution. Creativity is important, but so are constructability, execution and consistency. The objective is to create
 **best\-in\-class fitness and wellness environments** 
 and maintain that level of design and quality as the portfolio continues to grow.
